    private var historyList: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                HStack {
                    Text("Search History")
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    Spacer()
                    Button("Done") {
                        showHistory = false
                    }
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                .padding(.top, 12)

                ForEach(searchHistory.reversed(), id: \.self) { query in
                    Button {
                        searchText = query
                        showHistory = false
                        performSearch()
                    } label: {
                        HStack(spacing: 8) {
                            Image(systemName: "clock.arrow.circlepath")
                                .font(.system(size: 12))
                                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.3))
                            Text(query)
                                .font(CFFont.body)
                                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
                            Spacer()
                        }
                        .padding(.vertical, 8)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func searchResultRow(_ entry: SearchEntryContent) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            Text(entry.headline)
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
            Text(entry.excerpt)
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
                .lineLimit(2)
            HStack {
                if let factID = entry.factID {
                    if gameState.isFactDiscovered(factID) {
                        Text("Evidence on file")
                            .font(.system(size: 8))
                            .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255))
                    } else {
                        Text("New evidence available")
                            .font(.system(size: 8))
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                    }
                }
                Spacer()
                Text(entry.keyword)
                    .font(.system(size: 8))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.4))
            }
        }
        .padding(12)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
        .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10).stroke(CFColor.ink, lineWidth: 1))
    }

    private func resultDetail(_ entry: SearchEntryContent) -> some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                Text(entry.headline)
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Text(entry.excerpt)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.8))

                if let factID = entry.factID, !gameState.isFactDiscovered(factID) {
                    Button("Save as Evidence") {
                        try? gameState.commitFact(factID)
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
                    .padding(.top, 8)
                }
            }
            .padding(16)
        }
    }

    private func detailOverlay(_ entry: SearchEntryContent) -> some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.95).ignoresSafeArea()
                .onTapGesture { selectedEntry = nil }

            VStack(spacing: 16) {
                Text(entry.headline)
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)

                ScrollView {
                    Text(entry.excerpt)
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 24)
                }
                .frame(maxHeight: 200)

                if let factID = entry.factID {
                    if gameState.isFactDiscovered(factID) {
                        HStack(spacing: 6) {
                            Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                                .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255))
                            Text("Evidence saved")
                                .font(CFFont.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255))
                        }
                    } else {
                        Button("Save Evidence") {
                            try? gameState.commitFact(factID)
                        }
                        .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
                        .padding(.horizontal, 48)
                    }
                }

                Button("Close") { selectedEntry = nil }
                    .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.ink))
                    .padding(.horizontal, 60)
            }
        }
    }

    private var availableBookmarks: [SearchEntryContent] {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }
        let discovered = run.discoveredFactIDs
        return ContentStore.shared.allSearchEntries(availableByDay: run.currentDay)
            .filter { entry in
                guard let factID = entry.factID else { return false }
                return discovered.contains(factID)
            }
    }

    private func performSearch() {
        guard !searchText.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty else { return }
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return }
        hasSearched = true
        showHistory = false
        selectedEntry = nil
        searchResults = ContentStore.shared.searchEntries(matching: searchText, currentDay: run.currentDay)
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Apps/Mail/MailInboxView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct MailInboxView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    @Query private var notifications: [MailNotification]

    init() {
        _notifications = Query(
            sort: [SortDescriptor(\MailNotification.createdAt, order: .reverse)]
        )
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            if runNotifications.isEmpty {
                emptyState
            } else {
                notificationList
            }
        }
    }

    private var runNotifications: [MailNotification] {
        guard let runID = gameState.run?.id else { return [] }
        return notifications.filter { $0.run?.id == runID }
    }

    private var emptyState: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            Image(systemName: "tray")
                .font(.system(size: 52))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
            Text("No mail yet.")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Text("Start swiping!")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
        }
    }

    private var notificationList: some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVStack(spacing: 12) {
                ForEach(runNotifications) { notif in
                    MailRow(notification: notif)
                        .onTapGesture {
                            notif.isRead = true
                            try? context.save()
                        }
                }
            }
            .padding()
        }
    }
}

struct MailRow: View {
    let notification: MailNotification

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: iconName)
                .font(.system(size: 24))
                .foregroundStyle(iconColor)
                .frame(width: 40, height: 40)
                .background(iconColor.opacity(0.15))
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text(notification.title)
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                Text(notification.body)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
                    .lineLimit(2)

                Text(formatDate(notification.createdAt))
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.6))
            }

            Spacer()

            if !notification.isRead {
                Circle()
                    .fill(CFColor.primary)
                    .frame(width: 8, height: 8)
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .background(notification.isRead ? CFColor.ink.opacity(0.4) : CFColor.ink.opacity(0.7))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12)
                .stroke(notification.isRead ? Color.clear : CFColor.primary.opacity(0.3), lineWidth: 1)
        )
    }

    private var iconName: String {
        switch notification.notificationType {
        case .match: return "heart.fill"
        case .factDiscovery: return "magnifyingglass"
        case .dateReminder: return "calendar"
        case .accusationDeadline: return "exclamationmark.triangle.fill"
        case .message: return "envelope.fill"
        case .dateResult: return "heart.text.square.fill"
        }
    }

    private var iconColor: Color {
        switch notification.notificationType {
        case .match: return CFColor.primary
        case .factDiscovery: return CFColor.cyan
        case .dateReminder: return CFColor.cyanDim
        case .accusationDeadline: return CFColor.warning
        case .message: return CFColor.cream
        case .dateResult: return CFColor.primary
        }
    }

    private func formatDate(_ date: Date) -> String {
        let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()
        formatter.unitsStyle = .abbreviated
        return formatter.localizedString(for: date, relativeTo: Date())
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Apps/Phone/VoicemailView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct VoicemailView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    @State private var voicemails: [VoicemailMessage] = []
    @State private var playingVoicemailID: UUID?
    @State private var currentPlaybackProgress: Double = 0

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                header
                voicemailList
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            loadVoicemails()
        }
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack {
            Image(systemName: "voicemail")
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
            Text("Voicemail")
                .font(CFFont.title)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Spacer()
        }
        .padding()
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.7))
    }

    private var voicemailList: some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVStack(spacing: 12) {
                if voicemails.isEmpty {
                    emptyState
                } else {
                    ForEach(voicemails) { voicemail in
                        VoicemailRow(
                            voicemail: voicemail,
                            isPlaying: playingVoicemailID == voicemail.id,
                            onPlay: {
                                playVoicemail(voicemail)
                            },
                            onSaveEvidence: {
                                saveAsEvidence(voicemail)
                            },
                            onMarkAsHeard: {
                                markAsHeard(voicemail)
                            }
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            .padding(16)
        }
    }

    private var emptyState: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            Image(systemName: "voicemail.slash")
                .font(.system(size: 48))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.3))
            Text("No voicemails yet")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.6))
            Text("When you miss calls or people leave messages, they'll appear here.")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.4))
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        }
        .padding(.top, 60)
    }

    private func loadVoicemails() {
        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<VoicemailMessage>(
            sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.timestamp, order: .reverse)]
        )

        if let fetched = try? context.fetch(descriptor) {
            voicemails = fetched.filter { $0.run?.id == gameState.run?.id }
        }
    }

    private func playVoicemail(_ voicemail: VoicemailMessage) {
        playingVoicemailID = voicemail.id

        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + Double(voicemail.duration)) {
            playingVoicemailID = nil
        }
    }

    private func saveAsEvidence(_ voicemail: VoicemailMessage) {
        // Future: convert voicemail to discoverable fact
    }

    private func markAsHeard(_ voicemail: VoicemailMessage) {
        voicemail.isHeard = true
        try? context.save()
    }
}

struct VoicemailRow: View {
    let voicemail: VoicemailMessage
    let isPlaying: Bool
    let onPlay: () -> Void
    let onSaveEvidence: () -> Void
    let onMarkAsHeard: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Button(action: onPlay) {
                    Image(systemName: isPlaying ? "pause.circle.fill" : "play.circle.fill")
                        .font(.system(size: 36))
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    HStack {
                        Text(characterName)
                            .font(CFFont.headline)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                        if !voicemail.isHeard {
                            Circle()
                                .fill(CFColor.cyan)
                                .frame(width: 8, height: 8)
                        }
                    }

                    Text(formatDate(voicemail.timestamp))
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
                }

                Spacer()

                Text("\(voicemail.duration)s")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.7))
            }

            Text(voicemail.transcript)
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.8))
                .lineLimit(4)

            if !voicemail.isHeard {
                Button(action: onMarkAsHeard) {
                    Text("Mark as Heard")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(12)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
        .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10).stroke(CFColor.ink, lineWidth: 1))
    }

    private var characterName: String {
        if let characterID = CharacterID(rawValue: voicemail.fromCharacterID) {
            return characterID.displayName
        }
        if voicemail.fromCharacterID == "dev" {
            return "Dev"
        }
        if voicemail.fromCharacterID == "nia" {
            return "Nia"
        }
        return voicemail.fromCharacterID
    }

    private func formatDate(_ date: Date) -> String {
        let formatter = DateFormatter()
        formatter.dateStyle = .short
        formatter.timeStyle = .short
        return formatter.string(from: date)
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Apps/Photos/PhotosGalleryView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct PhotosGalleryView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    @Query private var allFacts: [Fact]
    @Query(sort: \DiscoveredFact.discoveredAt) private var allDiscovered: [DiscoveredFact]

    @State private var selectedFact: Fact? = nil

    private var discoveredFactIDs: Set<String> {
        Set(allDiscovered.filter { $0.run?.id == gameState.run?.id }.map { $0.factID })
    }

    private var photosWithImages: [Fact] {
        allFacts
            .filter { $0.run?.id == gameState.run?.id && discoveredFactIDs.contains($0.id) }
            .filter { $0.payload.imageAssetID != nil }
            .sorted { $0.day < $1.day }
    }

    init() {
        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<Fact>(sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\Fact.day)])
        _allFacts = Query(descriptor)
    }

    private let columns = [
        GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 4),
        GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 4),
        GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 4),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            if photosWithImages.isEmpty {
                emptyState
            } else {
                ScrollView {
                    LazyVGrid(columns: columns, spacing: 4) {
                        ForEach(photosWithImages, id: \.id) { fact in
                            thumbView(fact)
                        }
                    }
                    .padding(8)
                }
            }

            if let fact = selectedFact {
                detailOverlay(fact)
                    .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .scale(scale: 0.95)))
            }
        }
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.85), value: selectedFact?.id)
    }

    private var emptyState: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            Image(systemName: "photo.on.rectangle.angled")
                .font(.system(size: 48, weight: .heavy))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.3))
            Text("No evidence photos yet.")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
            Text("Keep investigating.")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.6))
        }
    }

    private func thumbView(_ fact: Fact) -> some View {
        let payload = fact.payload
        return Group {
            if let imageID = payload.imageAssetID {
                AssetImage(imageID)
                    .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fill)
                    .clipped()
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 100)
        .background(CFColor.ink)
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4)
                .stroke(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.4), lineWidth: 1)
        )
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4))
        .onTapGesture { selectedFact = fact }
    }

    private func detailOverlay(_ fact: Fact) -> some View {
        let payload = fact.payload

        return ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.92).ignoresSafeArea()
                .onTapGesture { selectedFact = nil }

            VStack(spacing: 14) {
                if let imageID = payload.imageAssetID {
                    AssetImage(imageID)
                        .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)
                        .frame(maxHeight: 280)
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
                        .overlay(
                            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8)
                                .stroke(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.4), lineWidth: 2)
                        )
                }

                if let text = payload.text {
                    Text(text)
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 24)
                }

                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    sourceLabel(for: fact)
                    Spacer()
                    Text("Day \(fact.day)")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.7))
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 24)

                Button("Close") { selectedFact = nil }
                    .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.ink))
                    .padding(.horizontal, 60)
            }
        }
    }

    private func sourceLabel(for fact: Fact) -> some View {
        let source = fact.source
        let label: String
        switch source {
        case .directMessage(let char):
            label = "DM from \(char.displayName)"
        case .socialPost(let char):
            label = "Post by \(char.displayName)"
        case .friendText(let friend):
            label = "Text from \(friend.rawValue == "dev" ? "Dev" : "Nia")"
        case .dateScene(let char):
            label = "Date with \(char.displayName)"
        case .profileBio(let char):
            label = "\(char.displayName)'s profile"
        case .investigation:
            label = "Investigation"
        }

        return Text(label)
            .font(CFFont.caption)
            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5))
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Cutscenes/CutscenePlayerView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SpriteKit

struct CutscenePlayerView: View {
    @State private var player = CutscenePlayer()
    @State private var scene = CutsceneSpriteScene()
    @State private var showSkipConfirm = false
    @State private var isPresented = false
    @State private var activeCutscene: CutsceneDefinition?

    var cutsceneID: String
    var onComplete: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            if isPresented {
                cutsceneView
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            loadCutscene()
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var cutsceneView: some View {
        ZStack {
            CutsceneContainerView(scene: scene)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack {
                Spacer()

                if let line = player.currentDialogueLine {
                    dialogueOverlay(for: line)
                        .transition(.opacity)
                }

                Spacer()

                if showSkipConfirm {
                    skipConfirmButton
                        .transition(.opacity)
                }
            }
        }
        .onTapGesture {
            handleTap()
        }
        .onChange(of: player.skipConfirmPending) { _, pending in
            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.3)) {
                showSkipConfirm = pending
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: player.isComplete) { _, complete in
            if complete {
                withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.5)) {
                    isPresented = false
                }
                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.6) {
                    onComplete()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func dialogueOverlay(for line: DialogueLine) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            Text(line.speakerName)
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(line.speakerName == "System" || line.speakerName == "Narrator" ? CFColor.cyan : CFColor.primary)

            Text(line.text)
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 32)
        .padding(.vertical, 14)
        .frame(maxWidth: 600)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.75))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.bottom, 40)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var skipConfirmButton: some View {
        Text("Tap again to skip")
            .font(CFFont.caption)
            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.7))
            .padding(.bottom, 40)
            .onTapGesture {
                player.confirmSkip()
            }
    }

    private func handleTap() {
        if player.skipConfirmPending {
            player.confirmSkip()
        } else if player.isPlaying {
            player.requestSkip()
        }
    }

    private func loadCutscene() {
        guard let cutscene = SpriteManager.shared.cutscene(for: cutsceneID) else {
            onComplete()
            return
        }

        activeCutscene = cutscene
        player.load(cutscene) { [self] in
            Task { @MainActor in
                player.confirmSkip()
            }
        }

        isPresented = true

        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.1) {
            player.play()
            scene.setActive(true)
            if let firstShot = cutscene.shots.first {
                scene.prepareShot(
                    firstShot,
                    character: firstShot.character,
                    onComplete: { [self] in
                        advanceToNextShot()
                    },
                    cutsceneComplete: {
                        Task { @MainActor in
                            player.confirmSkip()
                        }
                    }
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private func advanceToNextShot() {
        guard let cutscene = activeCutscene else { return }

        let nextIndex = player.currentShotIndex + 1
        if nextIndex < cutscene.shots.count {
            let shot = cutscene.shots[nextIndex]
            Task { @MainActor in
                player.advanceToNextShot()
            }
            scene.prepareShot(
                shot,
                character: shot.character,
                onComplete: { [self] in
                    advanceToNextShot()
                },
                cutsceneComplete: {
                    Task { @MainActor in
                        player.confirmSkip()
                    }
                }
            )
        } else {
            Task { @MainActor in
                player.confirmSkip()
            }
        }
    }
}

private struct CutsceneContainerView: UIViewRepresentable {
    let scene: CutsceneSpriteScene

    func makeUIView(context: Context) -> SKView {
        let view = SKView()
        view.ignoresSiblingOrder = true
        view.preferredFramesPerSecond = 60
        scene.backgroundColor = .black
        view.presentScene(scene)
        return view
    }

    func updateUIView(_ uiView: SKView, context: Context) {
        if uiView.scene !== scene {
            uiView.presentScene(scene)
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Cutscenes/CutsceneSpriteScene.swift">
import SpriteKit

final class CutsceneSpriteScene: SKScene {
    private let backgroundNode = SKSpriteNode()
    private let characterSprite = AnimatedSpriteNode()
    private let secondCharacterSprite = AnimatedSpriteNode()
    private let letterboxTop = SKSpriteNode()
    private let letterboxBottom = SKSpriteNode()

    private var cameraNode: SKCameraNode!
    private var onShotComplete: (() -> Void)?
    private var onCutsceneComplete: (() -> Void)?
    private var isActive: Bool = false

    private var currentCharacter: String?
    private var currentAnimationID: String?
    private var shotDuration: TimeInterval = 0
    private var shotTimer: TimeInterval = 0
    private var fadeInDuration: TimeInterval = 0
    private var fadeOutDuration: TimeInterval = 0
    private var isFadingOut: Bool = false

    override init() {
        super.init()
    }

    required init?(coder aDecoder: NSCoder) {
        super.init(coder: aDecoder)
    }

    func prepareShot(_ shot: CutsceneShot, character: String?, onComplete: @escaping () -> Void, cutsceneComplete: @escaping () -> Void) {
        self.onShotComplete = onComplete
        self.onCutsceneComplete = cutsceneComplete
        self.currentCharacter = shot.character
        self.currentAnimationID = shot.animationID
        self.shotDuration = TimeInterval(shot.durationMS) / 1000.0
        self.shotTimer = 0
        self.fadeInDuration = TimeInterval(shot.fadeInMS) / 1000.0
        self.fadeOutDuration = TimeInterval(shot.fadeOutMS) / 1000.0
        self.isFadingOut = false

        backgroundNode.alpha = 1
        characterSprite.alpha = 1

        if shot.letterboxed {
            letterboxTop.isHidden = false
            letterboxBottom.isHidden = false
        } else {
            letterboxTop.isHidden = true
            letterboxBottom.isHidden = true
        }

        if let char = shot.character, let animID = shot.animationID {
            characterSprite.isHidden = false
            loadCharacterAnimation(character: char, animationID: animID)
        } else if shot.shotType == .wide, let env = extractEnvironment(from: shot) {
            characterSprite.isHidden = true
            loadEnvironmentAnimation(env)
        } else {
            characterSprite.isHidden = true
        }

        if let camera = shot.camera as CameraInstruction?, camera.durationMS > 0 {
            applyCamera(camera)
        }

        if fadeInDuration > 0 {
            backgroundNode.alpha = 0
            characterSprite.alpha = 0
            runFadeIn()
        }
    }

    private func extractEnvironment(from shot: CutsceneShot) -> String? {
        if let animID = shot.animationID, animID.hasPrefix("env_") {
            let parts = animID.split(separator: "_")
            if parts.count >= 2 {
                return String(parts[1])
            }
        }
        return nil
    }

    private func loadCharacterAnimation(character: String, animationID: String) {
        if let anim = SpriteManager.shared.animation(for: animationID),
           let textures = SpriteManager.shared.texturesForAnimation(anim) {
            characterSprite.setTextures(textures, loop: anim.loop, frameMS: anim.frameMS)
            characterSprite.startAnimation()
            let centerY = size.height * 0.48
            characterSprite.setPortraitPosition(CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: centerY))
            characterSprite.setPortraitScale(1.0)
        }
    }

    private func loadEnvironmentAnimation(_ environment: String) {
        if let anim = SpriteManager.shared.animation(for: "env_\(environment)_wide"),
           let textures = SpriteManager.shared.texturesForAnimation(anim),
           let first = textures.first {
            backgroundNode.texture = first
            backgroundNode.size = first.size()
        }
    }

    private func runFadeIn() {
        let fadeAction = SKAction.fadeAlpha(to: 1.0, duration: fadeInDuration)
        backgroundNode.run(fadeAction)
        characterSprite.run(fadeAction)
    }

    private func runFadeOut(completion: @escaping () -> Void) {
        isFadingOut = true
        let fadeAction = SKAction.fadeAlpha(to: 0.0, duration: fadeOutDuration)
        backgroundNode.run(fadeAction)
        characterSprite.run(fadeAction)
        run(SKAction.sequence([
            .wait(forDuration: fadeOutDuration),
            .run(completion)
        ]))
    }

    func applyCamera(_ instruction: CameraInstruction) {
        let duration = TimeInterval(instruction.durationMS) / 1000.0

        if let panX = instruction.panX {
            let targetX = size.width / 2 + CGFloat(panX) * size.width * 0.3
            cameraNode.run(.move(to: CGPoint(x: targetX, y: cameraNode.position.y), duration: duration))
        }
        if let panY = instruction.panY {
            let targetY = size.height / 2 + CGFloat(panY) * size.height * 0.3
            cameraNode.run(.move(to: CGPoint(x: cameraNode.position.x, y: targetY), duration: duration))
        }
        if let zoom = instruction.zoom {
            let targetScale = 1.0 / CGFloat(zoom)
            cameraNode.run(.customAction(withDuration: duration, actionBlock: { [weak self] _, elapsed in
                let t = elapsed / duration
                let currentScale = 1.0 / (self?.cameraNode.yScale ?? 1.0)
                let newScale = currentScale + (targetScale - currentScale) * t
                self?.cameraNode.setScale(newScale)
            }))
        }
        if let tilt = instruction.tiltDegrees {
            cameraNode.run(.rotate(toAngle: CGFloat(tilt) * .pi / 180, duration: duration))
        }
    }

    func fireAudioCue(_ cue: AudioCue) {
        let engine = AudioEngine.shared
        let gain = cue.gain ?? 1.0
        switch cue.type {
        case .sting:
            if let sting = AudioAsset.Sting(rawValue: cue.assetID) {
                engine.play(sting)
            }
        case .ambience:
            if let amb = AudioAsset.Ambience(rawValue: cue.assetID) {
                engine.startAmbience(amb)
            }
        case .sfx:
            if let sfx = AudioAsset.UISfx(rawValue: cue.assetID) {
                engine.play(sfx)
            }
        }
    }

    func skipToEnd() {
        characterSprite.stopAnimation()
        runFadeOut { [weak self] in
            self?.onCutsceneComplete?()
        }
    }

    override func didMove(to view: SKView) {
        scaleMode = .resizeFill
        backgroundColor = .black

        cameraNode = SKCameraNode()
        camera = cameraNode
        addChild(cameraNode)

        backgroundNode.zPosition = -10
        backgroundNode.position = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: size.height / 2)
        backgroundNode.size = size
        addChild(backgroundNode)

        characterSprite.zPosition = 0
        characterSprite.isHidden = true
        addChild(characterSprite)

        secondCharacterSprite.zPosition = 1
        secondCharacterSprite.isHidden = true
        addChild(secondCharacterSprite)

        letterboxTop.color = .black
        letterboxTop.alpha = 1
        letterboxTop.isHidden = true
        addChild(letterboxTop)

        letterboxBottom.color = .black
        letterboxBottom.alpha = 1
        letterboxBottom.isHidden = true
        addChild(letterboxBottom)

        layoutLetterboxes()
    }

    override func didChangeSize(_ oldSize: CGSize) {
        super.didChangeSize(oldSize)
        backgroundNode.size = size
        layoutLetterboxes()
    }

    private func layoutLetterboxes() {
        let barHeight: CGFloat = size.height * 0.1
        letterboxTop.size = CGSize(width: size.width, height: barHeight)
        letterboxTop.position = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: size.height - barHeight / 2)

        letterboxBottom.size = CGSize(width: size.width, height: barHeight)
        letterboxBottom.position = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: barHeight / 2)
    }

    override func update(_ currentTime: TimeInterval) {
        guard isActive, !isFadingOut else {
            characterSprite.update(currentTime)
            return
        }

        shotTimer += 1.0 / 60.0

        characterSprite.update(currentTime)

        if shotTimer >= shotDuration - fadeOutDuration && fadeOutDuration > 0 && !isFadingOut {
            isFadingOut = true
            runFadeOut { [weak self] in
                self?.onShotComplete?()
            }
        } else if shotTimer >= shotDuration {
            onShotComplete?()
        }
    }

    func setActive(_ active: Bool) {
        isActive = active
        if !active {
            characterSprite.stopAnimation()
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Ending/EndingOverlay.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct EndingOverlay: View {
    let ending: CaseEnding
    let killer: CharacterID
    let narrativeBeat: String
    let evidenceStrength: Double
    let discoveredFactCount: Int
    let daysPlayed: Int
    let onPlayAgain: () -> Void

    @State private var revealPhase = 0
    @State private var showDetails = false

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.ignoresSafeArea()

            if revealPhase == 0 {
                revealPulse
            } else {
                endingContent
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            AudioEngine.shared.play(.endingRevealBreath)
            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 1.5) {
                withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.8)) {
                    revealPhase = 1
                }
            }
            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 3.0) {
                withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.6)) {
                    showDetails = true
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var revealPulse: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 24) {
            Image(systemName: outcomeIcon)
                .font(.system(size: 80))
                .foregroundStyle(outcomeColor)
                .symbolEffect(.pulse, options: .repeating, value: revealPhase)

            Text(outcomeHeadline)
                .font(CFFont.title)
                .foregroundStyle(outcomeColor)
                .tracking(3)
        }
    }

    private var endingContent: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 32) {
                headerSection

                if showDetails {
                    killerRevealSection

                    evidenceSummarySection

                    narrativeBeatSection

                    playAgainButton
                }
            }
            .padding(32)
        }
    }

    private var headerSection: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            Image(systemName: outcomeIcon)
                .font(.system(size: 60))
                .foregroundStyle(outcomeColor)

            Text(outcomeHeadline)
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(outcomeColor)
                .tracking(3)

            Text(outcomeSubheadline)
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        }
    }

    private var killerRevealSection: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            Text("THE KILLER WAS")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                .tracking(2)

            HStack(spacing: 16) {
                AssetImage(killer.portraitAssetID)
                    .frame(width: 72, height: 72)
                    .clipShape(Circle())
                    .overlay(
                        Circle()
                            .stroke(outcomeColor, lineWidth: 3)
                    )

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    Text(killer.displayName)
                        .font(CFFont.title)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                    Text("Days active: \(daysPlayed)")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5))
                }
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .padding(20)
        .background(CFColor.ink)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14))
    }

    private var evidenceSummarySection: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            Text("EVIDENCE REVIEW")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                .tracking(2)

            HStack(spacing: 24) {
                statBlock(value: "\(discoveredFactCount)", label: "Facts Found")
                statBlock(value: "\(Int(evidenceStrength * 100))%", label: "Strength")
                statBlock(value: "\(daysPlayed)/7", label: "Days")
            }

            GeometryReader { geo in
                ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4)
                        .fill(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.6))
                        .frame(height: 8)

                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4)
                        .fill(evidenceStrength >= 0.6 ? CFColor.cyan : CFColor.warning)
                        .frame(width: geo.size.width * evidenceStrength, height: 8)
                }
            }
            .frame(height: 8)
        }
        .padding(16)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
    }

    private var narrativeBeatSection: some View {
        Text(narrativeBeat)
            .font(CFFont.body)
            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            .padding(20)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.3))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
    }

    private var playAgainButton: some View {
        Button(action: onPlayAgain) {
            Text("Play Again")
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        }
        .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
        .padding(.top, 16)
    }

    private func statBlock(value: String, label: String) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 4) {
            Text(value)
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Text(label)
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5))
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
    }

    private var outcomeIcon: String {
        switch ending {
        case .caughtThem: return evidenceStrength < 0.3 ? "sparkles" : "checkmark.shield.fill"
        case .wrongfulAccusation: return "xmark.shield.fill"
        case .metKiller: return "eye.fill"
        case .killerEscaped: return "figure.run"
        }
    }

    private var outcomeColor: Color {
        switch ending {
        case .caughtThem: return CFColor.cyan
        case .wrongfulAccusation: return CFColor.warning
        case .metKiller: return CFColor.primary
        case .killerEscaped: return CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5)
        }
    }

    private var outcomeHeadline: String {
        switch ending {
        case .caughtThem:
            return evidenceStrength < 0.3 ? "CASE CLOSED" : "CASE CLOSED"
        case .wrongfulAccusation:
            return "WRONG ACCUSATION"
        case .metKiller:
            return "FACE TO FACE"
        case .killerEscaped:
            return "TIME'S UP"
        }
    }

    private var outcomeSubheadline: String {
        switch ending {
        case .caughtThem:
            return evidenceStrength < 0.3
                ? "Case closed... but was it luck or instinct?"
                : "The evidence was overwhelming."
        case .wrongfulAccusation:
            return "\(killer.displayName) was innocent. The real killer walks free."
        case .metKiller:
            return "You came face to face with the killer."
        case .killerEscaped:
            return "7 days passed. \(killer.displayName) disappeared."
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Journal/EvidenceChainBuilder.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct EvidenceChainBuilder: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    @Query private var allDiscovered: [DiscoveredFact]
    @Query private var allFacts: [Fact]

    @State private var selectedFactIDs: Set<String> = []
    @State private var showSuccessToast = false
    @State private var showFailToast = false
    @State private var toastMessage = ""
    @State private var completedChainIDs: Set<String> = []

    private var discoveredForRun: Set<String> {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }
        return Set(allDiscovered.filter { $0.run?.id == run.id }.map(\.factID))
    }

    private var discoveredFactsForRun: [Fact] {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }
        let ids = discoveredForRun
        return allFacts
            .filter { $0.run?.id == run.id && ids.contains($0.id) }
            .sorted { $0.day < $1.day }
    }

    private var availableChains: [EvidenceChainContent] {
        ContentStore.shared.allEvidenceChains
    }

    private func completedChains() -> [EvidenceChainContent] {
        let discovered = discoveredForRun
        return availableChains.filter { chain in
            chain.factIDs.allSatisfy { discovered.contains($0) }
        }
    }

    private func tryLinkFacts() {
        guard selectedFactIDs.count == 2 else { return }
        let selected = selectedFactIDs

        for chain in availableChains {
            let chainSet = Set(chain.factIDs)
            if chainSet.isSubset(of: selected) || chainSet == selected {
                if !completedChainIDs.contains(chain.id) {
                    completedChainIDs.insert(chain.id)
                    toastMessage = chain.summary
                    showSuccessToast = true
                }
                selectedFactIDs = []
                return
            }

            if !chainSet.isDisjoint(with: selected), chainSet.count == 2 {
                let wrongSet = selected.subtracting(chainSet)
                if wrongSet.count == 1 {
                    toastMessage = "These facts don't connect."
                    showFailToast = true
                    selectedFactIDs = []
                    return
                }
            }
        }

        toastMessage = "These facts don't connect."
        showFailToast = true
        selectedFactIDs = []
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
            header

            if discoveredFactsForRun.count < 2 {
                emptyState
            } else {
                factPicker
                linkButton
                completedSection
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            let discovered = discoveredForRun
            completedChainIDs = Set(availableChains.filter { chain in
                chain.factIDs.allSatisfy { discovered.contains($0) }
            }.map(\.id))
        }
        .overlay {
            if showSuccessToast {
                toastView(isSuccess: true)
                    .transition(.move(edge: .top).combined(with: .opacity))
            }
            if showFailToast {
                toastView(isSuccess: false)
                    .transition(.move(edge: .top).combined(with: .opacity))
            }
        }
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.3), value: showSuccessToast)
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.3), value: showFailToast)
    }

    private var header: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
            Text("EVIDENCE CHAINS")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                .tracking(2)

            Text("Select two facts to link them into a chain.")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
        }
    }

    private var emptyState: some View {
        Text("Discover more facts to start building chains.")
            .font(CFFont.body)
            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
            .padding()
    }

    private var factPicker: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            ScrollView {
                LazyVStack(spacing: 6) {
                    ForEach(discoveredFactsForRun) { fact in
                        factPickerRow(fact: fact)
                    }
                }
            }
            .frame(maxHeight: 200)
        }
    }

    private func factPickerRow(fact: Fact) -> some View {
        let isSelected = selectedFactIDs.contains(fact.id)
        let payload = fact.payload

        return Button {
            if isSelected {
                selectedFactIDs.remove(fact.id)
            } else if selectedFactIDs.count < 2 {
                selectedFactIDs.insert(fact.id)
            }
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Image(systemName: isSelected ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : "circle")
                    .font(.system(size: 16))
                    .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? CFColor.primary : CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.3))

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    if let text = payload.text {
                        Text(text)
                            .font(CFFont.body)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                            .lineLimit(2)
                    }

                    if let character = fact.aboutCharacter {
                        Text(character.displayName)
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                    }
                }

                Spacer()
            }
            .padding(8)
            .background(isSelected ? CFColor.primary.opacity(0.15) : CFColor.ink.opacity(0.3))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private var linkButton: some View {
        Button {
            tryLinkFacts()
        } label: {
            Text(selectedFactIDs.count == 2 ? "LINK FACTS" : "SELECT \(2 - selectedFactIDs.count) MORE")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .padding()
                .background(selectedFactIDs.count == 2 ? CFColor.primary : CFColor.ink.opacity(0.6))
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
        }
        .disabled(selectedFactIDs.count < 2)
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private var completedSection: some View {
        Group {
            if !completedChainIDs.isEmpty {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                    Text("COMPLETED CHAINS")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                        .tracking(2)

                    ForEach(availableChains.filter { completedChainIDs.contains($0.id) }, id: \.id) { chain in
                        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 8) {
                            Image(systemName: "link.circle.fill")
                                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                                .font(.system(size: 14))

                            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                                Text(chain.summary)
                                    .font(CFFont.body)
                                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                                if let character = CharacterID(rawValue: chain.impliedKiller) {
                                    Text("Points toward: \(character.displayName)")
                                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning.opacity(0.8))
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        .padding(8)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.3))
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func toastView(isSuccess: Bool) -> some View {
        VStack {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Image(systemName: isSuccess ? "checkmark.seal.fill" : "xmark.seal.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 20))
                    .foregroundStyle(isSuccess ? CFColor.primary : CFColor.warning)

                Text(toastMessage)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            }
            .padding()
            .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.95))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10)
                    .stroke(isSuccess ? CFColor.primary : CFColor.warning, lineWidth: 1.5)
            )
            .padding(.horizontal)

            Spacer()
        }
        .padding(.top, 8)
    }
}
</file>

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct FactDetailView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    @Query private var allDiscovered: [DiscoveredFact]
    @Query private var allFacts: [Fact]

    let fact: Fact

    @State private var noteText: String = ""
    @State private var linkedFacts: [Fact] = []

    private var discoveredForRun: Set<String> {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }
        return Set(allDiscovered.filter { $0.run?.id == run.id }.map(\.factID))
    }

    private var payload: FactPayload { fact.payload }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
                    headerSection
                    factContentSection
                    sourceSection
                    linkedFactsSection
                    relatedFactsSection
                    notesSection
                }
                .padding()
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            loadLinkedFacts()
            loadNote()
        }
    }

    private var headerSection: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            HStack {
                kindBadge
                Spacer()
                Text("Day \(fact.day)")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.7))
            }

            if let character = fact.aboutCharacter {
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    AssetImage(character.portraitAssetID)
                        .frame(width: 20, height: 20)
                        .clipShape(Circle())
                    Text(character.displayName)
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var kindBadge: some View {
        Text(fact.kind.rawValue.uppercased())
            .font(.system(size: 8, weight: .bold))
            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
            .padding(.horizontal, 6)
            .padding(.vertical, 2)
            .background(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.15))
            .clipShape(Capsule())
    }

    private var factContentSection: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            if let text = payload.text {
                Text(text)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            }

            if let imageID = payload.imageAssetID {
                AssetImage(imageID)
                    .frame(maxHeight: 160)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.4))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
    }

    private var sourceSection: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            Image(systemName: sourceIcon)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.6))
                .font(.system(size: 14))

            sourceLabel
        }
        .font(CFFont.caption)
        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.6))
    }

    private var sourceIcon: String {
        switch fact.source {
        case .profileBio: return "person.crop.square"
        case .socialPost: return "photo.on.rectangle"
        case .directMessage: return "bubble.left"
        case .friendText: return "person.wave.2"
        case .dateScene: return "heart.text.square"
        case .investigation: return "magnifyingglass"
        }
    }

    private var sourceLabel: Text {
        switch fact.source {
        case .profileBio(let c):
            Text("Profile: \(c.displayName)")
        case .socialPost(let c):
            Text("Social: \(c.displayName)")
        case .directMessage(let c):
            Text("DM: \(c.displayName)")
        case .friendText(let f):
            Text("Friend: \(f.rawValue.capitalized)")
        case .dateScene(let c):
            Text("Date: \(c.displayName)")
        case .investigation:
            Text("Investigation")
        }
    }

    private var linkedFactsSection: some View {
        Group {
            if !linkedFacts.isEmpty {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                    Text("LINKED FACTS")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                        .tracking(2)

                    ForEach(linkedFacts) { linked in
                        linkedFactRow(linked)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func linkedFactRow(_ linked: Fact) -> some View {
        NavigationLink(value: linked) {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Image(systemName: "link")
                    .font(.system(size: 10))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)

                if let text = linked.payload.text {
                    Text(text)
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                        .lineLimit(2)
                }

                Spacer()

                Image(systemName: "chevron.right")
                    .font(.system(size: 10))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.3))
            }
            .padding(8)
            .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.3))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private var relatedFactsSection: some View {
        let related = relatedFacts
        return Group {
            if !related.isEmpty {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                    Text("RELATED FACTS")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                        .tracking(2)

                    ForEach(related) { relatedFact in
                        NavigationLink(value: relatedFact) {
                            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                                Image(systemName: "arrow.triangle.branch")
                                    .font(.system(size: 10))
                                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.secondary)

                                if let text = relatedFact.payload.text {
                                    Text(text)
                                        .font(CFFont.body)
                                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                                        .lineLimit(2)
                                }

                                Spacer()

                                Image(systemName: "chevron.right")
                                    .font(.system(size: 10))
                                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.3))
                            }
                            .padding(8)
                            .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.3))
                            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
                        }
                        .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var relatedFacts: [Fact] {
        let discovered = discoveredForRun
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }

        let sameCharacter = allFacts
            .filter { $0.run?.id == run.id && $0.id != fact.id && $0.aboutCharacter == fact.aboutCharacter && discovered.contains($0.id) }

        let sameSource: [Fact] = {
            switch (fact.source, fact.source) {
            case (.dateScene(let a), .dateScene(let b)) where a == b:
                return allFacts.filter { $0.run?.id == run.id && $0.id != fact.id && discovered.contains($0.id) && $0.source == fact.source }
            default:
                return []
            }
        }()

        let seen = Set((sameCharacter + sameSource).map(\.id))
        return Array((sameCharacter + sameSource).filter { seen.contains($0.id) }).uniqued(by: \.id)
    }

    private var notesSection: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text("YOUR NOTES")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                .tracking(2)

            ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
                if noteText.isEmpty {
                    Text("Tap to add a note...")
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.3))
                        .padding(.horizontal, 12)
                        .padding(.vertical, 8)
                }

                TextEditor(text: $noteText)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .scrollContentBackground(.hidden)
                    .frame(minHeight: 60)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                    .padding(.vertical, 4)
            }
            .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.3))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
        }
        .onChange(of: noteText) { _, newValue in
            saveNote(newValue)
        }
    }

    private func loadLinkedFacts() {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return }
        let runID = run.id

        guard let discovered = allDiscovered.first(where: { $0.factID == fact.id && $0.run?.id == runID }) else { return }

        linkedFacts = allFacts.filter { f in
            f.run?.id == runID && discovered.linkedFactIDs.contains(f.id)
        }
    }

    private func loadNote() {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return }
        let runID = run.id
        if let discovered = allDiscovered.first(where: { $0.factID == fact.id && $0.run?.id == runID }) {
            noteText = discovered.playerNote ?? ""
        }
    }

    private func saveNote(_ text: String) {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return }
        let runID = run.id
        guard let discovered = allDiscovered.first(where: { $0.factID == fact.id && $0.run?.id == runID }) else { return }
        discovered.playerNote = text.isEmpty ? nil : text
    }
}

extension Array {
    func uniqued<T: Hashable>(by keyPath: KeyPath<Element, T>) -> [Element] {
        var seen = Set<T>()
        return filter { seen.insert($0[keyPath: keyPath]).inserted }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Journal/SuspectBoardView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct SuspectBoardView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    @Query private var allDiscovered: [DiscoveredFact]
    @Query private var allFacts: [Fact]

    let onSelectCharacter: (CharacterID?) -> Void

    private var discoveredForRun: Set<String> {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }
        return Set(allDiscovered.filter { $0.run?.id == run.id }.map(\.factID))
    }

    private var factsForRun: [Fact] {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }
        let ids = discoveredForRun
        return allFacts.filter { $0.run?.id == run.id && ids.contains($0.id) }
    }

    private func evidenceCounts(for character: CharacterID) -> (incriminating: Int, clearing: Int) {
        let chains = ContentStore.shared.allEvidenceChains
        let discovered = discoveredForRun

        var incriminating = 0
        var clearing = 0

        for chain in chains {
            let allDiscovered = chain.factIDs.allSatisfy { discovered.contains($0) }
            guard allDiscovered else { continue }

            if chain.impliedKiller == character.rawValue {
                if chain.weight >= 0.6 {
                    incriminating += 1
                }
            } else {
                let chainChar = CharacterID(rawValue: chain.impliedKiller)
                if let chainChar = chainChar, chainChar != character, chain.weight >= 0.3 {
                    clearing += 1
                }
            }
        }

        let factsAbout = factsForRun.filter { $0.aboutCharacter == character }
        incriminating += factsAbout.filter { $0.kind != .staticFact }.count

        return (incriminating, clearing)
    }

    private func statusColor(for character: CharacterID) -> Color {
        let counts = evidenceCounts(for: character)
        if counts.clearing > counts.incriminating, counts.incriminating == 0 {
            return Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255)
        } else if counts.incriminating >= 3 {
            return CFColor.warning
        } else if counts.incriminating > 0 {
            return Color(red: 0xFF/255, green: 0xD7/255, blue: 0x00/255)
        }
        return CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5)
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
            Text("SUSPECTS")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                .tracking(2)

            ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) {
                HStack(spacing: 12) {
                    ForEach(CharacterID.allCases) { character in
                        suspectCard(for: character)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func suspectCard(for character: CharacterID) -> some View {
        let counts = evidenceCounts(for: character)
        let statusCol = statusColor(for: character)
        let discovered = discoveredForRun
        let hasEvidence = counts.incriminating > 0 || counts.clearing > 0

        return Button {
            onSelectCharacter(character)
        } label: {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                AssetImage(character.portraitAssetID)
                    .frame(width: 56, height: 56)
                    .clipShape(Circle())
                    .overlay(
                        Circle()
                            .stroke(statusCol, lineWidth: hasEvidence ? 2.5 : 1)
                    )

                Text(character.displayName)
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .lineLimit(1)

                if hasEvidence {
                    HStack(spacing: 4) {
                        if counts.incriminating > 0 {
                            Text("\(counts.incriminating)")
                                .font(.system(size: 8, weight: .bold))
                                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                                .padding(.horizontal, 4)
                                .padding(.vertical, 2)
                                .background(CFColor.warning.opacity(0.2))
                                .clipShape(Capsule())
                        }
                        if counts.clearing > 0 {
                            Text("\(counts.clearing)")
                                .font(.system(size: 8, weight: .bold))
                                .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255))
                                .padding(.horizontal, 4)
                                .padding(.vertical, 2)
                                .background(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255).opacity(0.2))
                                .clipShape(Capsule())
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    Text("—")
                        .font(.system(size: 8))
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.3))
                }
            }
            .frame(width: 80)
            .padding(.vertical, 8)
            .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.4))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Onboarding/AppIconHighlight.swift">
import SwiftUI

struct AppIconHighlight: View {
    @Environment(PhoneOSState.self) private var os
    @Environment(OnboardingManager.self) private var onboarding

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            ForEach(Array(onboarding.phoneTourHighlights.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, app in
                iconTooltip(for: app, index: index)
            }
        }
    }

    private func iconTooltip(for app: AppID, index: Int) -> some View {
        GeometryReader { geo in
            let iconPosition = position(for: app, in: geo.size)
            let isCurrentHighlight = onboarding.phoneTourHighlights.firstIndex(of: app) == 0

            ZStack {
                if isCurrentHighlight {
                    Circle()
                        .stroke(CFColor.primary, lineWidth: 2)
                        .frame(width: 72, height: 72)
                        .position(iconPosition)
                        .scaleEffect(onboarding.phoneTourPulse ? 1.15 : 1.0)
                        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.8).repeatForever(autoreverses: true), value: onboarding.phoneTourPulse)
                }

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    Text(app.teaser)
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)
                }
                .padding(8)
                .background(CFColor.ink)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
                .position(x: iconPosition.x + 80, y: iconPosition.y)
                .opacity(isCurrentHighlight ? 1 : 0)
            }
        }
    }

    private func position(for app: AppID, in size: CGSize) -> CGPoint {
        let appIndex = AppID.allCases.firstIndex(of: app) ?? 0
        let row = appIndex / 3
        let col = appIndex % 3
        let iconWidth = (size.width - 48) / 3
        let startY: CGFloat = 60
        let x: CGFloat = 16 + CGFloat(col) * (iconWidth + 24) + iconWidth / 2
        let y: CGFloat = startY + CGFloat(row) * (iconWidth + 28) + iconWidth / 2
        return CGPoint(x: x, y: y)
    }
}

import SwiftUI

/// Single home-screen app tile: chunky tinted square with glyph + label below.
/// Tapping calls `onTap`, which the home screen uses to launch the app.
struct AppIcon: View {
    let app: AppID
    var badgeCount: Int = 0
    var onTap: () -> Void

    @State private var pressed = false

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: onTap) {
            VStack(spacing: 8) {
                ZStack(alignment: .topTrailing) {
                    Image(systemName: app.glyph)
                        .font(.system(size: 30, weight: .heavy))
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream)
                        .appIconChrome(tint: app.tint)

                    if badgeCount > 0 {
                        Text("\(min(badgeCount, 99))")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream)
                            .padding(.horizontal, 6)
                            .padding(.vertical, 2)
                            .background(CFColor.warning)
                            .clipShape(Capsule())
                            .overlay(
                                Capsule().stroke(CFColor.cream, lineWidth: 1)
                            )
                            .offset(x: 6, y: -6)
                    }
                }

                Text(app.displayName)
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream)
                    .lineLimit(1)
                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.8)
            }
            .scaleEffect(pressed ? 0.94 : 1.0)
            .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.1), value: pressed)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .simultaneousGesture(
            DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0)
                .onChanged { _ in pressed = true }
                .onEnded { _ in pressed = false }
        )
    }
}

#Preview {
