<file path="catfish/Features/Settings/SettingsManager.swift">
import Foundation
import SwiftUI
import Observation

@Observable
@MainActor
final class SettingsManager {
    static let shared = SettingsManager()

    var bgmVolume: Float {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(bgmVolume, forKey: Keys.bgmVolume) }
    }
    var sfxVolume: Float {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(sfxVolume, forKey: Keys.sfxVolume) }
    }
    var voiceVolume: Float {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(voiceVolume, forKey: Keys.voiceVolume) }
    }
    var isMuted: Bool {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(isMuted, forKey: Keys.isMuted) }
    }
    var crtScanlines: Bool {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(crtScanlines, forKey: Keys.crtScanlines) }
    }
    var screenShake: Bool {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(screenShake, forKey: Keys.screenShake) }
    }
    var reduceMotion: Bool {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(reduceMotion, forKey: Keys.reduceMotion) }
    }
    var highContrastText: Bool {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(highContrastText, forKey: Keys.highContrastText) }
    }

    private enum Keys {
        static let bgmVolume = "catfish.settings.bgmVolume"
        static let sfxVolume = "catfish.settings.sfxVolume"
        static let voiceVolume = "catfish.settings.voiceVolume"
        static let isMuted = "catfish.settings.isMuted"
        static let crtScanlines = "catfish.settings.crtScanlines"
        static let screenShake = "catfish.settings.screenShake"
        static let reduceMotion = "catfish.settings.reduceMotion"
        static let highContrastText = "catfish.settings.highContrastText"
    }

    private init() {
        let defaults = UserDefaults.standard
        self.bgmVolume = defaults.object(forKey: Keys.bgmVolume) as? Float ?? 0.45
        self.sfxVolume = defaults.object(forKey: Keys.sfxVolume) as? Float ?? 0.85
        self.voiceVolume = defaults.object(forKey: Keys.voiceVolume) as? Float ?? 1.0
        self.isMuted = defaults.bool(forKey: Keys.isMuted)
        self.crtScanlines = defaults.object(forKey: Keys.crtScanlines) as? Bool ?? true
        self.screenShake = defaults.object(forKey: Keys.screenShake) as? Bool ?? true
        self.reduceMotion = defaults.bool(forKey: Keys.reduceMotion)
        self.highContrastText = defaults.bool(forKey: Keys.highContrastText)
    }

    func applyToAudioEngine() {
        let engine = AudioEngine.shared
        engine.bgmVolume = bgmVolume
        engine.sfxVolume = sfxVolume
        engine.voiceVolume = voiceVolume
        engine.isMuted = isMuted
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Settings/SettingsView.swift">
import SwiftUI

struct SettingsView: View {
    @State private var settings = SettingsManager.shared
    @Environment(PhoneOSState.self) private var os

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 28) {
                audioSection
                displaySection
                accessibilitySection
                aboutSection
            }
            .padding(20)
        }
        .background(CFColor.background)
        .onChange(of: settings.bgmVolume) { _, _ in settings.applyToAudioEngine() }
        .onChange(of: settings.sfxVolume) { _, _ in settings.applyToAudioEngine() }
        .onChange(of: settings.voiceVolume) { _, _ in settings.applyToAudioEngine() }
        .onChange(of: settings.isMuted) { _, _ in settings.applyToAudioEngine() }
        .onChange(of: settings.crtScanlines) { _, newValue in os.crtMode = newValue }
    }

    private var audioSection: some View {
        settingsSection("Audio", icon: "speaker.wave.2.fill") {
            volumeSlider("BGM", value: $settings.bgmVolume)
            volumeSlider("SFX", value: $settings.sfxVolume)
            volumeSlider("Voice", value: $settings.voiceVolume)
            toggleRow("Mute All", isOn: $settings.isMuted)
        }
    }

    private var displaySection: some View {
        settingsSection("Display", icon: "display") {
            toggleRow("CRT Scanlines", isOn: $settings.crtScanlines)
            toggleRow("Screen Shake", isOn: $settings.screenShake)
        }
    }

    private var accessibilitySection: some View {
        settingsSection("Accessibility", icon: "accessibility") {
            toggleRow("Reduce Motion", isOn: $settings.reduceMotion)
            toggleRow("High Contrast Text", isOn: $settings.highContrastText)
        }
    }

    private var aboutSection: some View {
        settingsSection("About", icon: "info.circle") {
            HStack {
                Text("Version")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Spacer()
                Text(appVersion)
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.6))
            }

            HStack {
                Text("Credits")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Spacer()
                Text("Catfish Team")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.6))
            }

            Link(destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/privacy")!) {
                HStack {
                    Text("Privacy Policy")
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                    Spacer()
                    Image(systemName: "arrow.up.right.square")
                        .font(.system(size: 12))
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var appVersion: String {
        let version = Bundle.main.infoDictionary?["CFBundleShortVersionString"] as? String ?? "0"
        let build = Bundle.main.infoDictionary?["CFBundleVersion"] as? String ?? "0"
        return "\(version) (\(build))"
    }

    private func settingsSection<Content: View>(_ title: String, icon: String, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
            Label(title, systemImage: icon)
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)

            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                content()
            }
            .padding(14)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .background(CFColor.ink)
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10)
                    .stroke(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.2), lineWidth: 1)
            )
        }
    }

    private func volumeSlider(_ label: String, value: Binding<Float>) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            HStack {
                Text(label)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Spacer()
                Text("\(Int(value.wrappedValue * 100))%")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.6))
            }
            Slider(value: value, in: 0...1, step: 0.05)
                .tint(CFColor.primary)
        }
    }

    private func toggleRow(_ label: String, isOn: Binding<Bool>) -> some View {
        HStack {
            Text(label)
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Spacer()
            Toggle("", isOn: isOn)
                .labelsHidden()
                .tint(CFColor.primary)
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Sprites/AnimatedSpriteNode.swift">
import SpriteKit

final class AnimatedSpriteNode: SKNode {
    let portraitNode = SKSpriteNode()
    private let mouthNode = SKSpriteNode()
    private let glitchOverlay = SKSpriteNode()
    private let uneasyOverlay = SKSpriteNode()

    private var textures: [SKTexture] = []
    private var frameMS: Int = 83
    private var loopAnimation: Bool = true
    private var frameTimer: TimeInterval = 0
    private var lastUpdateTime: TimeInterval = 0
    private var isAnimating: Bool = false
    private var currentFrameIndex: Int = 0
    private var glitchLevel: CGFloat = 0

    override init() {
        super.init()
        setupNodes()
    }

    required init?(coder aDecoder: NSCoder) {
        super.init(coder: aDecoder)
        setupNodes()
    }

    private func setupNodes() {
        portraitNode.zPosition = 0
        addChild(portraitNode)

        mouthNode.zPosition = 1
        mouthNode.alpha = 0.6
        addChild(mouthNode)

        uneasyOverlay.color = .black
        uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        uneasyOverlay.zPosition = 2
        uneasyOverlay.size = CGSize(width: 320, height: 180)
        uneasyOverlay.position = CGPoint(x: 0, y: 70)
        addChild(uneasyOverlay)

        glitchOverlay.color = .magenta
        glitchOverlay.alpha = 0
        glitchOverlay.zPosition = 100
        addChild(glitchOverlay)
    }

    func setTextures(_ textures: [SKTexture], loop: Bool, frameMS: Int) {
        self.textures = textures
        self.frameMS = frameMS
        self.loopAnimation = loop
        if let first = textures.first {
            portraitNode.texture = first
            portraitNode.size = first.size()
        }
    }

    func setFrame(_ index: Int) {
        guard index < textures.count else { return }
        currentFrameIndex = index
        portraitNode.texture = textures[index]
    }

    func startAnimation() {
        isAnimating = true
        frameTimer = 0
        lastUpdateTime = 0
    }

    func stopAnimation() {
        isAnimating = false
        removeAction(forKey: "frameAnimation")
    }

    func update(_ currentTime: TimeInterval) {
        guard isAnimating, !textures.isEmpty else { return }

        if lastUpdateTime == 0 {
            lastUpdateTime = currentTime
            return
        }

        let deltaTime = currentTime - lastUpdateTime
        lastUpdateTime = currentTime

        frameTimer += deltaTime
        let frameDuration = TimeInterval(frameMS) / 1000.0

        if frameTimer >= frameDuration {
            frameTimer -= frameDuration
            var nextFrame = currentFrameIndex + 1
            if nextFrame >= textures.count {
                if loopAnimation {
                    nextFrame = 0
                } else {
                    isAnimating = false
                    return
                }
            }
            setFrame(nextFrame)
        }
    }

    func setMouthShape(_ shape: MouthShape) {
        let alpha: CGFloat
        switch shape {
        case .closed, .narrow: alpha = 0.2
        case .half: alpha = 0.5
        case .open: alpha = 0.9
        case .auto: alpha = 0.6
        }
        mouthNode.alpha = alpha
    }

    func setMouthTexture(_ texture: SKTexture?) {
        mouthNode.texture = texture
        if let t = texture {
            mouthNode.size = t.size()
        }
    }

    func setUneasy(_ active: Bool) {
        if active {
            uneasyOverlay.run(.repeatForever(.sequence([
                .fadeAlpha(to: 0.12, duration: 0.08),
                .fadeAlpha(to: 0.20, duration: 0.08)
            ])))
        } else {
            uneasyOverlay.removeAllActions()
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        }
    }

    func setGlitchLevel(_ level: CGFloat) {
        glitchLevel = level
        if level > 0 {
            runGlitchPulse()
        } else {
            glitchOverlay.removeAllActions()
            glitchOverlay.alpha = 0
        }
    }

    func runGlitchPulse() {
        glitchOverlay.removeAllActions()
        glitchOverlay.run(.sequence([
            .fadeAlpha(to: glitchLevel * 0.34, duration: 0.08),
            .fadeOut(withDuration: 0.22)
        ]))
    }

    func crossFadeTo(textures newTextures: [SKTexture], duration: TimeInterval) {
        guard let first = newTextures.first else { return }

        let oldNode = portraitNode.copy() as! SKSpriteNode
        oldNode.zPosition = 0
        addChild(oldNode)

        portraitNode.texture = first
        portraitNode.size = first.size()
        portraitNode.alpha = 0

        let fadeOut = SKAction.fadeOut(withDuration: duration)
        let fadeIn = SKAction.fadeIn(withDuration: duration)
        oldNode.run(.sequence([fadeOut, .removeFromParent()]))
        portraitNode.run(fadeIn)

        self.textures = newTextures
    }

    func applyExpression(_ expression: DateSpriteExpression) {
        switch expression {
        case .neutral, .neutralSaintmask:
            setUneasy(false)
        case .uneasy:
            setUneasy(true)
        default:
            setUneasy(false)
        }
    }

    func setPortraitScale(_ scale: CGFloat) {
        portraitNode.setScale(scale)
        mouthNode.setScale(scale)
    }

    func setPortraitPosition(_ position: CGPoint) {
        portraitNode.position = position
        mouthNode.position = CGPoint(x: position.x, y: position.y - 84 * portraitNode.yScale)
    }

    var portraitSize: CGSize {
        portraitNode.size
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Sprites/DateSceneSpriteHost.swift">
import SpriteKit

final class DateSceneSpriteHost: SKScene {
    private let backgroundNode = SKSpriteNode()
    private let parallaxNode = SKSpriteNode()
    private let characterSprite = AnimatedSpriteNode()
    private let secondCharacterSprite = AnimatedSpriteNode()
    private let uneasyOverlay = SKSpriteNode()
    private let glitchOverlay = SKSpriteNode()

    private var cameraNode: SKCameraNode!
    private var mouthNode: SKSpriteNode!
    private(set) var mode: DateSpriteMode = .standard
    private weak var spriteController: SpriteAnimationController?

    override init() {
        super.init()
    }

    override init(size: CGSize) {
        super.init(size: size)
    }

    required init?(coder aDecoder: NSCoder) {
        super.init(coder: aDecoder)
    }

    func configure(
        sceneID: String,
        partner: String,
        environment: String,
        controller: SpriteAnimationController
    ) {
        self.spriteController = controller

        if let portraitAnim = SpriteManager.shared.animation(for: "\(partner)_idle_neutral"),
           let textures = SpriteManager.shared.texturesForAnimation(portraitAnim) {
            characterSprite.setTextures(textures, loop: true, frameMS: portraitAnim.frameMS)
        }

        if let bgAnim = SpriteManager.shared.animation(for: "env_\(environment)_wide"),
           let bgTextures = SpriteManager.shared.texturesForAnimation(bgAnim),
           let first = bgTextures.first {
            backgroundNode.texture = first
            backgroundNode.size = first.size()
        } else {
            applyEnvironmentColors(environment)
        }

        applyMode(mode, animated: false)
    }

    private func applyEnvironmentColors(_ environment: String) {
        let env = environment.lowercased()
        let bg: UIColor
        let parallax: UIColor

        switch env {
        case let e where e.contains("coffee"):
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.12, green: 0.08, blue: 0.04, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.20, green: 0.14, blue: 0.08, alpha: 1)
        case let e where e.contains("park"):
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.04, green: 0.10, blue: 0.06, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.08, green: 0.18, blue: 0.10, alpha: 1)
        case let e where e.contains("bar"):
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.10, green: 0.04, blue: 0.12, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.18, green: 0.06, blue: 0.20, alpha: 1)
        case let e where e.contains("restaurant"):
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.10, green: 0.06, blue: 0.04, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.16, green: 0.10, blue: 0.06, alpha: 1)
        case let e where e.contains("apartment"):
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.06, green: 0.06, blue: 0.10, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.10, green: 0.10, blue: 0.16, alpha: 1)
        default:
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.06, green: 0.08, blue: 0.20, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.10, green: 0.12, blue: 0.30, alpha: 1)
        }

        backgroundNode.color = bg
        parallaxNode.color = parallax
    }

    override func didMove(to view: SKView) {
        scaleMode = .resizeFill
        backgroundColor = .black

        cameraNode = SKCameraNode()
        camera = cameraNode
        addChild(cameraNode)

        configureNodes()
        layoutNodes(for: size)
    }

    override func didChangeSize(_ oldSize: CGSize) {
        super.didChangeSize(oldSize)
        layoutNodes(for: size)
    }

    private func configureNodes() {
        addChild(backgroundNode)
        addChild(parallaxNode)
        addChild(characterSprite)
        addChild(secondCharacterSprite)
        secondCharacterSprite.isHidden = true

        mouthNode = SKSpriteNode(color: .black, size: CGSize(width: 52, height: 12))
        mouthNode.alpha = 0.6
        mouthNode.zPosition = 1
        characterSprite.addChild(mouthNode)

        uneasyOverlay.color = .black
        uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        uneasyOverlay.zPosition = 2
        uneasyOverlay.size = CGSize(width: 320, height: 180)
        uneasyOverlay.position = CGPoint(x: 0, y: 70)
        characterSprite.addChild(uneasyOverlay)

        glitchOverlay.color = .magenta
        glitchOverlay.alpha = 0
        glitchOverlay.zPosition = 100
        addChild(glitchOverlay)
    }

    private func layoutNodes(for newSize: CGSize) {
        backgroundNode.size = newSize
        backgroundNode.position = CGPoint(x: newSize.width / 2, y: newSize.height / 2)
        backgroundNode.zPosition = -10

        parallaxNode.size = CGSize(width: newSize.width * 1.15, height: newSize.height * 1.1)
        parallaxNode.position = CGPoint(x: newSize.width / 2 + 10, y: newSize.height / 2 + 4)
        parallaxNode.zPosition = -5
        parallaxNode.alpha = 0.45

        glitchOverlay.size = newSize
        glitchOverlay.position = CGPoint(x: newSize.width / 2, y: newSize.height / 2)

        let targetY: CGFloat = mode == .firstPerson ? newSize.height * 0.56 : newSize.height * 0.48
        let targetScale: CGFloat = mode == .firstPerson ? 1.45 : 1.0
        characterSprite.setPortraitPosition(CGPoint(x: newSize.width / 2, y: targetY))
        characterSprite.setPortraitScale(targetScale)
    }

    func applyMode(_ newMode: DateSpriteMode, animated: Bool) {
        mode = newMode
        let targetScale: CGFloat = newMode == .firstPerson ? 1.45 : 1.0
        let targetY: CGFloat = newMode == .firstPerson ? size.height * 0.56 : size.height * 0.48

        if animated {
            characterSprite.run(.group([
                .move(to: CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: targetY), duration: 0.4),
                .scale(to: targetScale, duration: 0.4)
            ]))
            runGlitchPulse()
        } else {
            characterSprite.setPortraitPosition(CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: targetY))
            characterSprite.setPortraitScale(targetScale)
        }
    }

    func setExpression(_ expression: DateSpriteExpression) {
        guard let controller = spriteController,
              let partner = controller.currentPartner else {
            applyFallbackExpression(expression)
            return
        }

        if let anim = controller.animationForExpression(expression, character: partner),
           let textures = SpriteManager.shared.texturesForAnimation(anim) {
            characterSprite.crossFadeTo(textures: textures, duration: 0.15)
        }

        applyExpressionOverlay(expression)
    }

    private func applyFallbackExpression(_ expression: DateSpriteExpression) {
        switch expression {
        case .neutral:
            characterSprite.portraitNode.color = .white
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        case .neutralSaintmask:
            characterSprite.portraitNode.color = UIColor(red: 0.88, green: 0.94, blue: 0.96, alpha: 1)
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        case .smile:
            characterSprite.portraitNode.color = .systemTeal
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        case .flirty:
            characterSprite.portraitNode.color = .systemPink
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        case .curious:
            characterSprite.portraitNode.color = .systemBlue
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        case .uneasy:
            characterSprite.portraitNode.color = .systemOrange
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0.20
            uneasyOverlay.run(.repeatForever(.sequence([
                .fadeAlpha(to: 0.12, duration: 0.08),
                .fadeAlpha(to: 0.20, duration: 0.08)
            ])))
        case .sinister:
            characterSprite.portraitNode.color = .systemRed
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0.3
        }
    }

    private func applyExpressionOverlay(_ expression: DateSpriteExpression) {
        uneasyOverlay.removeAllActions()
        switch expression {
        case .neutral, .neutralSaintmask, .smile, .flirty, .curious:
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        case .uneasy:
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0.20
            uneasyOverlay.run(.repeatForever(.sequence([
                .fadeAlpha(to: 0.12, duration: 0.08),
                .fadeAlpha(to: 0.20, duration: 0.08)
            ])))
        case .sinister:
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0.3
        }
    }

    func setMouthOpenness(_ isActive: Bool, amplitude: CGFloat) {
        if isActive {
            mouthNode.xScale = 1 + max(0.05, amplitude * 0.15)
            mouthNode.yScale = 1 + max(0.1, amplitude * 0.7)
            mouthNode.alpha = 0.9
        } else {
            mouthNode.xScale = 1
            mouthNode.yScale = 1
            mouthNode.alpha = 0.2
        }
    }

    func playCharacterAnimation(_ animID: String) {
        guard let anim = SpriteManager.shared.animation(for: animID),
              let textures = SpriteManager.shared.texturesForAnimation(anim) else { return }
        characterSprite.setTextures(textures, loop: anim.loop, frameMS: anim.frameMS)
        characterSprite.startAnimation()
    }

    func showSecondCharacter(_ characterID: String, animID: String) {
        secondCharacterSprite.isHidden = false
        if let anim = SpriteManager.shared.animation(for: animID),
           let textures = SpriteManager.shared.texturesForAnimation(anim) {
            secondCharacterSprite.setTextures(textures, loop: false, frameMS: anim.frameMS)
            secondCharacterSprite.setPortraitPosition(CGPoint(x: size.width * 0.7, y: size.height * 0.48))
            secondCharacterSprite.setPortraitScale(1.0)
            secondCharacterSprite.startAnimation()
        }
    }

    func hideSecondCharacter() {
        secondCharacterSprite.isHidden = true
        secondCharacterSprite.stopAnimation()
    }

    func applyCamera(_ instruction: CameraInstruction) {
        let duration = TimeInterval(instruction.durationMS) / 1000.0

        if let panX = instruction.panX {
            let targetX = size.width / 2 + CGFloat(panX) * size.width * 0.3
            cameraNode.run(.move(to: CGPoint(x: targetX, y: cameraNode.position.y), duration: duration))
        }
        if let panY = instruction.panY {
            let targetY = size.height / 2 + CGFloat(panY) * size.height * 0.3
            cameraNode.run(.move(to: CGPoint(x: cameraNode.position.x, y: targetY), duration: duration))
        }
        if let zoom = instruction.zoom {
            let targetScale = 1.0 / CGFloat(zoom)
            cameraNode.run(.customAction(withDuration: duration, actionBlock: { [weak self] _, elapsed in
                let t = elapsed / duration
                let currentScale = 1.0 / (self?.cameraNode.yScale ?? 1.0)
                let newScale = currentScale + (targetScale - currentScale) * t
                self?.cameraNode.setScale(newScale)
            }))
        }
        if let tilt = instruction.tiltDegrees {
            cameraNode.run(.rotate(toAngle: CGFloat(tilt) * .pi / 180, duration: duration))
        }
    }

    func fadeIn(duration: TimeInterval) {
        backgroundNode.alpha = 0
        parallaxNode.alpha = 0
        characterSprite.alpha = 0
        backgroundNode.run(.fadeIn(withDuration: duration))
        parallaxNode.run(.fadeIn(withDuration: duration))
        characterSprite.run(.fadeIn(withDuration: duration))
    }

    func fadeOut(duration: TimeInterval, completion: @escaping () -> Void) {
        let fade = SKAction.sequence([
            .fadeOut(withDuration: duration),
            .run(completion)
        ])
        backgroundNode.run(fade)
        parallaxNode.run(fade)
        characterSprite.run(fade)
    }

    private func runGlitchPulse() {
        glitchOverlay.removeAllActions()
        glitchOverlay.run(.sequence([
            .fadeAlpha(to: 0.34, duration: 0.08),
            .fadeOut(withDuration: 0.22)
        ]))
    }

    override func update(_ currentTime: TimeInterval) {
        characterSprite.update(currentTime)
        secondCharacterSprite.update(currentTime)
    }
}

<file path="catfish/Features/Sprites/FaceTimeSpriteNode.swift">
import SpriteKit

final class FaceTimeSpriteNode: SKNode {
    private let portraitNode = SKSpriteNode()
    private let scanlineOverlay = SKSpriteNode()
    private let glitchOverlay = SKSpriteNode()
    private let ringPulseNode = SKSpriteNode()

    private var glitchLevel: CGFloat = 0
    private var isRinging: Bool = false
    private var glitchActions: [SKAction] = []

    enum CallState {
        case idle
        case ringing
        case connected
        case glitched
    }

    private var callState: CallState = .idle

    override init() {
        super.init()
        setupNodes()
    }

    required init?(coder aDecoder: NSCoder) {
        super.init(coder: aDecoder)
        setupNodes()
    }

    private func setupNodes() {
        portraitNode.zPosition = 0
        portraitNode.color = .white
        addChild(portraitNode)

        let scanline = SKSpriteNode(color: .clear, size: CGSize(width: 640, height: 960))
        scanline.color = .cyan
        scanline.alpha = 0.03
        scanline.zPosition = 1
        scanlineOverlay.addChild(scanline)
        addChild(scanlineOverlay)

        glitchOverlay.color = .magenta
        glitchOverlay.alpha = 0
        glitchOverlay.zPosition = 2
        addChild(glitchOverlay)

        ringPulseNode.color = .cyan
        ringPulseNode.alpha = 0
        ringPulseNode.zPosition = 3
        addChild(ringPulseNode)
    }

    func loadPortrait(characterID: String) {
        let lower = characterID.lowercased()
        let anim = "\(lower)_facetime_idle"
        if let def = SpriteManager.shared.animation(for: anim),
           let textures = SpriteManager.shared.texturesForAnimation(def) {
            portraitNode.texture = textures.first
            portraitNode.size = textures.first?.size() ?? CGSize(width: 640, height: 960)
        } else if let charID = CharacterID(rawValue: lower) {
            if let image = UIImage(named: charID.portraitAssetID) {
                portraitNode.texture = SKTexture(image: image)
                portraitNode.size = CGSize(width: 640, height: 960)
            }
        }
    }

    func setCallState(_ state: CallState) {
        callState = state

        switch state {
        case .idle:
            stopAllEffects()
        case .ringing:
            startRingAnimation()
        case .connected:
            stopAllEffects()
            startIdleAnimation()
        case .glitched:
            startGlitchEffect()
        }
    }

    func setGlitchLevel(_ level: CGFloat) {
        glitchLevel = level
        switch callState {
        case .glitched:
            startGlitchEffect()
        default:
            break
        }
    }

    private func startRingAnimation() {
        isRinging = true
        ringPulseNode.removeAllActions()
        ringPulseNode.run(.repeatForever(.sequence([
            .fadeAlpha(to: 0.15, duration: 0.4),
            .fadeAlpha(to: 0.0, duration: 0.4)
        ])))
    }

    private func startIdleAnimation() {
        isRinging = false
        ringPulseNode.removeAllActions()
        ringPulseNode.alpha = 0

        guard let texture = portraitNode.texture else { return }
        let texSize = texture.size()
        portraitNode.size = texSize
    }

    private func startGlitchEffect() {
        glitchOverlay.removeAllActions()
        portraitNode.removeAllActions()

        let baseGlitch = SKAction.sequence([
            .run { [weak self] in self?.performGlitchFrame() },
            .wait(forDuration: 0.05)
        ])
        let glitchLoop = SKAction.repeatForever(baseGlitch)
        glitchOverlay.run(glitchLoop)

        let flicker = SKAction.sequence([
            .fadeAlpha(to: glitchLevel * 0.3, duration: 0.04),
            .fadeAlpha(to: 0.0, duration: 0.06)
        ])
        glitchOverlay.run(SKAction.repeatForever(flicker))
    }

    private func performGlitchFrame() {
        let offsetX = CGFloat.random(in: -4...4) * glitchLevel
        let offsetY = CGFloat.random(in: -2...2) * glitchLevel
        portraitNode.position = CGPoint(x: offsetX, y: offsetY)

        if Int.random(in: 0...10) < 3 {
            portraitNode.color = .cyan
            portraitNode.colorBlendFactor = CGFloat.random(in: 0.1...0.3)
        } else if Int.random(in: 0...10) < 2 {
            portraitNode.color = .magenta
            portraitNode.colorBlendFactor = CGFloat.random(in: 0.1...0.2)
        } else {
            portraitNode.color = .white
            portraitNode.colorBlendFactor = 0
        }
    }

    private func stopAllEffects() {
        isRinging = false
        glitchOverlay.removeAllActions()
        glitchOverlay.alpha = 0
        portraitNode.removeAllActions()
        portraitNode.position = .zero
        portraitNode.color = .white
        portraitNode.colorBlendFactor = 0
        ringPulseNode.removeAllActions()
        ringPulseNode.alpha = 0
    }

    func fadeOutPortrait(duration: TimeInterval, completion: @escaping () -> Void) {
        portraitNode.run(.sequence([
            .fadeOut(withDuration: duration),
            .run(completion)
        ]))
    }

    func fadeInPortrait(duration: TimeInterval) {
        portraitNode.alpha = 0
        portraitNode.run(.fadeIn(withDuration: duration))
    }

    var portrait: SKSpriteNode {
        portraitNode
    }
}

<file path="catfish/Features/Sprites/FaceTimeSpriteScene.swift">
import SpriteKit

final class FaceTimeSpriteScene: SKScene {
    private let faceTimeNode = FaceTimeSpriteNode()
    private var cameraNode: SKCameraNode!

    override init() {
        super.init()
    }

    required init?(coder aDecoder: NSCoder) {
        super.init(coder: aDecoder)
    }

    func configure(characterID: String, callState: FaceTimeSpriteNode.CallState, glitchLevel: CGFloat) {
        faceTimeNode.loadPortrait(characterID: characterID)
        faceTimeNode.setCallState(callState)
        faceTimeNode.setGlitchLevel(glitchLevel)
    }

    func updateCallState(_ state: FaceTimeSpriteNode.CallState, glitchLevel: CGFloat) {
        faceTimeNode.setCallState(state)
        faceTimeNode.setGlitchLevel(glitchLevel)
    }

    func setGlitchLevel(_ level: CGFloat) {
        faceTimeNode.setGlitchLevel(level)
    }

    override func didMove(to view: SKView) {
        scaleMode = .resizeFill
        backgroundColor = .black

        cameraNode = SKCameraNode()
        camera = cameraNode
        addChild(cameraNode)

        faceTimeNode.position = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: size.height / 2)
        addChild(faceTimeNode)
    }

    override func didChangeSize(_ oldSize: CGSize) {
        super.didChangeSize(oldSize)
        faceTimeNode.position = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: size.height / 2)
    }
}

<file path="catfish/Features/Swipe/SwipeCard.swift">
import SwiftUI

/// A single swipeable profile card. Owns the drag gesture and the NOPE/MATCH
/// stamp reveals. Calls up via `onSwipe` when a commit threshold is crossed.
struct SwipeCard: View {
    let profile: CandidateProfile
    var onSwipe: (Direction) -> Void

    enum Direction { case left, right }

    // Drag state
    @State private var offset: CGSize = .zero
    @State private var rotation: Double = 0

    /// Horizontal distance required to commit the swipe.
    private let commitThreshold: CGFloat = 110

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { geo in
            ZStack {
                // Portrait fills the top ~75% of the card.
                cardBody(size: geo.size)
            }
            .frame(width: geo.size.width, height: geo.size.height)
            .rotationEffect(.degrees(rotation))
            .offset(offset)
            .gesture(dragGesture(cardWidth: geo.size.width))
            .animation(.interactiveSpring(response: 0.35, dampingFraction: 0.72),
                       value: offset)
            .overlay(alignment: .topLeading) { nopeStamp }
            .overlay(alignment: .topTrailing) { matchStamp }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Card body

    @ViewBuilder
    private func cardBody(size: CGSize) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            // Portrait region
            AssetImage(profile.portraitAssetID)
                .frame(height: size.height * 0.72)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .background(CFColor.navy)
                .clipped()

            // Name plate region
            nameplate
                .frame(height: size.height * 0.28)
        }
        .pixelChrome(fill: CFColor.surface, stroke: CFColor.primary, strokeWidth: 3, cornerRadius: 12)
    }

    private var nameplate: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline, spacing: 8) {
                Text(profile.displayName)
                    .font(CFFont.title)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Text("\(profile.age)")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                Spacer()
            }
            Text(profile.bioLine)
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.85))
                .lineLimit(2)
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                ForEach(profile.badges, id: \.self) { badge in
                    Text(badge)
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 8).padding(.vertical, 4)
                        .background(CFColor.navy)
                        .clipShape(Capsule())
                }
                Spacer()
            }
        }
        .padding(12)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(CFColor.ink)
    }

    // MARK: - Stamps

    private var nopeStamp: some View {
        stampImage(
            assetID: "A005_swipe_left_stamp",
            opacity: max(0, Double(-offset.width / commitThreshold))
        )
        .rotationEffect(.degrees(-18))
        .padding(24)
    }

    private var matchStamp: some View {
        stampImage(
            assetID: "A006_swipe_right_stamp",
            opacity: max(0, Double(offset.width / commitThreshold))
        )
        .rotationEffect(.degrees(18))
        .padding(24)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func stampImage(assetID: String, opacity: Double) -> some View {
        AssetImage(assetID)
            .frame(width: 160, height: 80)
            .opacity(min(opacity, 1.0))
    }

    // MARK: - Gesture

    private func dragGesture(cardWidth: CGFloat) -> some Gesture {
        DragGesture()
            .onChanged { value in
                offset = value.translation
                // Rotation scales with horizontal offset relative to card width.
                rotation = Double(value.translation.width / cardWidth) * 12
            }
            .onEnded { value in
                let w = value.translation.width
                if w > commitThreshold {
                    // Fling right off screen, then notify.
                    withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.25)) {
                        offset = CGSize(width: cardWidth * 1.5, height: value.translation.height)
                        rotation = 20
                    }
                    DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.22) {
                        onSwipe(.right)
                    }
                } else if w < -commitThreshold {
                    withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.25)) {
                        offset = CGSize(width: -cardWidth * 1.5, height: value.translation.height)
                        rotation = -20
                    }
                    DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.22) {
                        onSwipe(.left)
                    }
                } else {
                    // Snap back.
                    offset = .zero
                    rotation = 0
                }
            }
    }
}

/// Loads an image from the asset catalog (or bundle), falls back to a
/// labeled placeholder if the asset isn't present yet. Keeps the UI
/// wireable before all 107 images are generated.
struct AssetImage: View {
    let name: String

    init(_ name: String) { self.name = name }

    var body: some View {
        if UIImage(named: name) != nil {
            Image(name)
                .resizable()
                .interpolation(.none)           // keep pixel edges crisp
                .aspectRatio(contentMode: .fill)
        } else {
            ZStack {
                Rectangle().fill(CFColor.navy)
                VStack(spacing: 6) {
                    Image(systemName: "photo.fill")
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                        .font(.system(size: 36))
                    Text(name)
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.6))
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                        .lineLimit(2)
                }
                .padding(8)
            }
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Voice/CallVoiceGenerator.swift">
import Foundation
import os

private let voiceGenLog = Logger(subsystem: "com.catfish.app", category: "CallVoiceGenerator")

/// Generates and caches voice lines for phone calls using ElevenLabs.
@MainActor
final class CallVoiceGenerator {
    static let shared = CallVoiceGenerator()

    private let elevenLabsEndpoint: URL
    private let cache: NSCache<NSString, NSURL>
    private let voiceManifest: VoiceManifestStore

    private init() {
        self.elevenLabsEndpoint = URL(string: "https://voice.catfish.workers.dev/generate")!
        self.cache = NSCache()
        self.voiceManifest = VoiceManifestStore.shared
        self.cache.countLimit = 100
    }

    /// Get a voicemail greeting for a character (always pre-generated).
    func getVoicemailGreeting(for character: CharacterID) async -> URL? {
        guard let tree = DialogueTreeManager.shared.tree(for: character),
              let line = voiceManifest.line(tree.voicemailGreetingID) else {
            return nil
        }

        return await getVoiceLine(line)
    }

    /// Get a voicemail greeting for an NPC.
    func getNPCVoicemailGreeting(_ npc: NPCVoicemail) async -> URL? {
        guard let line = voiceManifest.line(npc.voicemailGreeting.voiceLineID) else {
            return nil
        }

        return await getVoiceLine(line)
    }

    /// Generate a voice line dynamically via ElevenLabs.
    func generateVoiceLine(
        text: String,
        character: CharacterID,
        emotionTag: String = "neutral"
    ) async throws -> URL {
        let cacheKey = "\(character.rawValue):\(text):\(emotionTag)" as NSString

        if let cached = cache.object(forKey: cacheKey) as? URL {
            return cached
        }

        guard let voiceInfo = getVoiceInfo(for: character) else {
            throw VoiceGenerationError.voiceNotFound(character: character.rawValue)
        }

        let url = try await fetchFromElevenLabs(
            text: text,
            voiceID: voiceInfo.voiceID,
            emotionTag: emotionTag
        )

        cache.setObject(url as NSURL, forKey: cacheKey)
        return url
    }

    /// Pre-generate happy path lines for a character (call during game init).
    func preloadHappyPathLines(for character: CharacterID) async {
        guard let tree = DialogueTreeManager.shared.tree(for: character) else { return }

        let happyPathNodes = tree.nodes.filter { $0.isHappyPath && $0.voiceLineID != nil }

        for node in happyPathNodes {
            guard let voiceLineID = node.voiceLineID,
                  let line = voiceManifest.line(voiceLineID) else { continue }

            _ = await getVoiceLine(line)
        }

        voiceGenLog.debug("Preloaded \(happyPathNodes.count) happy path lines for \(character.rawValue)")
    }

    private func getVoiceInfo(for character: CharacterID) -> (voiceID: String, provider: String)? {
        voiceManifest.manifest?.voices[character.rawValue].map { ($0.voiceID, $0.provider) }
    }

    private func getVoiceLine(_ line: VoiceManifest.Line) async -> URL? {
        let cacheKey = line.voiceLineID as NSString

        if let cached = cache.object(forKey: cacheKey) as? URL {
            return cached
        }

        let bundleURL = Bundle.main.url(forResource: line.bundlePath, withExtension: nil)

        if let bundleURL = bundleURL, FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: bundleURL.path) {
            cache.setObject(bundleURL as NSURL, forKey: cacheKey)
            return bundleURL
        }

        if let voiceInfo = getVoiceInfo(for: CharacterID(rawValue: line.targetVoice) ?? .kai) {
            do {
                let url = try await fetchFromElevenLabs(
                    text: line.text,
                    voiceID: voiceInfo.voiceID,
                    emotionTag: line.emotionTag
                )
                cache.setObject(url as NSURL, forKey: cacheKey)
                return url
            } catch {
                voiceGenLog.error("Failed to generate voice line \(line.voiceLineID): \(error)")
            }
        }

        return nil
    }

    private func fetchFromElevenLabs(
        text: String,
        voiceID: String,
        emotionTag: String
    ) async throws -> URL {
        var request = URLRequest(url: elevenLabsEndpoint)
        request.httpMethod = "POST"
        request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
        request.timeoutInterval = 30

        let payload: [String: Any] = [
            "text": text,
            "voiceId": voiceID,
            "model_id": "eleven_turbo_v2_5",
            "output_format": "mp44100_128"
        ]
        request.httpBody = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: payload)

        let (tempURL, response) = try await URLSession.shared.download(for: request)

        guard let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse,
              (200..<300).contains(httpResponse.statusCode) else {
            throw VoiceGenerationError.requestFailed
        }

        let cachesDir = FileManager.default.urls(for: .cachesDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first!
        let outputDir = cachesDir.appendingPathComponent("call_voice", isDirectory: true)

        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(
            at: outputDir,
            withIntermediateDirectories: true,
            attributes: nil
        )

        let outputURL = outputDir.appendingPathComponent("\(UUID().uuidString).m4a")

        if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: outputURL.path) {
            try FileManager.default.removeItem(at: outputURL)
        }

        try FileManager.default.copyItem(at: tempURL, to: outputURL)
        return outputURL
    }
}

enum VoiceGenerationError: Error {
    case voiceNotFound(character: String)
    case requestFailed
    case invalidResponse
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/EastworldCallService.swift">
import Foundation

/// Call-specific Eastworld integration with wrap-up logic and time limits.
@MainActor
final class EastworldCallService {
    private let chatClient: ProductionDateEastworldClient
    private let dialogueManager: DialogueTreeManager

    /// Maximum call duration in seconds (2 minutes)
    static let maxCallDuration = 120

    /// Soft wrap-up begins at this point (90 seconds)
    static let wrapUpThreshold = 90

    init(
        chatClient: ProductionDateEastworldClient,
        dialogueManager: DialogueTreeManager
    ) {
        self.chatClient = chatClient
        self.dialogueManager = dialogueManager
    }

    convenience init() {
        self.init(
            chatClient: ProductionDateEastworldClient(),
            dialogueManager: DialogueTreeManager.shared
        )
    }

    /// Generate a response for a call, considering dialogue tree state and call duration.
    func generateResponse(
        character: CharacterID,
        playerInput: String,
        callDuration: Int,
        exhaustedNodeIDs: [String],
        day: Int,
        discoveredFactIDs: [String],
        affinity: Int,
        completedDateSceneIDs: [String]
    ) async throws -> String {
        let isWrappingUp = callDuration >= Self.wrapUpThreshold

        if isWrappingUp {
            return try await generateWrapUpResponse(
                character: character,
                playerInput: playerInput,
                reason: callDuration >= Self.maxCallDuration ? "time_limit" : "natural"
            )
        }

        let node = dialogueManager.getNextNode(
            for: playerInput,
            character: character,
            day: day,
            discoveredFactIDs: discoveredFactIDs,
            affinity: affinity,
            completedDateSceneIDs: completedDateSceneIDs,
            exhaustedNodeIDs: exhaustedNodeIDs
        )

        if let node = node {
            return node.responseText
        }

        return try await generateDynamicResponse(
            character: character,
            playerInput: playerInput,
            context: buildCallContext(character: character, day: day)
        )
    }

    /// Generate a wrap-up response when the call is ending.
    func generateWrapUpResponse(
        character: CharacterID,
        playerInput: String,
        reason: String
    ) async throws -> String {
        let wrapUpPrompt = buildWrapUpPrompt(
            character: character,
            playerInput: playerInput,
            reason: reason
        )

        return try await generateDynamicResponse(
            character: character,
            playerInput: wrapUpPrompt,
            context: "This is a phone call that needs to end naturally."
        )
    }

    /// Check if the call should be forcibly ended.
    func shouldEndCall(callDuration: Int) -> Bool {
        callDuration >= Self.maxCallDuration
    }

    /// Check if wrap-up cues should begin.
    func shouldBeginWrapUp(callDuration: Int) -> Bool {
        callDuration >= Self.wrapUpThreshold && callDuration < Self.maxCallDuration
    }

    private func buildCallContext(character: CharacterID, day: Int) -> String {
        """
        You are \(character.displayName) on a phone call with the player.
        This is day \(day) of the investigation.
        Keep responses conversational and natural for a phone call.
        """
    }

    private func buildWrapUpPrompt(character: CharacterID, playerInput: String, reason: String) -> String {
        let reasonText: String
        switch reason {
        case "time_limit":
            reasonText = "You need to end the call because you have somewhere to be. Be warm but firm."
        case "natural":
            reasonText = "The conversation is naturally winding down. Acknowledge what they said and suggest talking again soon."
        default:
            reasonText = "End this call naturally."
        }

        return """
        \(buildCallContext(character: character, day: 0))

        The player just said: "\(playerInput)"

        \(reasonText)

        Keep it under 100 characters. Be warm and genuine.
        """
    }

    private func generateDynamicResponse(
        character: CharacterID,
        playerInput: String,
        context: String
    ) async throws -> String {
        let fullPrompt = """
        \(context)

        The player just asked/said: "\(playerInput)"

        Respond naturally in character. Keep it under 150 characters.
        """

        return try await chatClient.nextLine(
            sceneID: "phone_call",
            partnerID: character.rawValue,
            playerInput: fullPrompt
        )
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Resources/Dialogue/river_dialogue.json">
{
  "characterID": "river",
  "voicemailGreetingID": "river_vm_generic_01",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "river_d1_greeting",
      "prompt": "general greeting hey hello",
      "responseText": "You found it. The lighting is terrible for reading faces, but the risotto compensates.",
      "voiceLineID": "river_restaurant_greeting_warm",
      "isHappyPath": true,
      "prerequisites": [],
      "unlocksNextDay": 1,
      "leadsToVoicemail": false,
      "unlockConditions": null
    },
    {
      "id": "river_d1_work",
      "prompt": "work job what do you do",
      "responseText": "I investigate for a public defender's office. Mostly reading between lines other people wrote.",
      "voiceLineID": "river_restaurant_work_candid",
      "isHappyPath": true,
      "prerequisites": ["river_d1_greeting"],
      "unlocksNextDay": 1,
      "leadsToVoicemail": false,
      "unlockConditions": null
    },
    {
      "id": "river_d1_ambient",
      "prompt": "this place restaurant kitchen",
      "responseText": "I like restaurants where you can hear the kitchen. Tells you how honest the pacing is.",
      "voiceLineID": "river_restaurant_ambient_safe_01",
      "isHappyPath": true,
      "prerequisites": ["river_d1_greeting"],
      "unlocksNextDay": 1,
      "leadsToVoicemail": false,
      "unlockConditions": null
    },
    {
      "id": "river_d2_followup",
      "prompt": "dinner yesterday date followup",
      "responseText": "That dinner told me more than most people reveal in a month. That's a compliment, by the way.",
      "voiceLineID": "river_d3_follow_up",
      "isHappyPath": true,
      "prerequisites": ["river_d1_greeting", "river_d1_work"],
      "unlocksNextDay": 2,
      "leadsToVoicemail": false,
      "unlockConditions": null
    },
    {
      "id": "river_d3_concern",
      "prompt": "notes something doesn't add up",
      "responseText": "I've been keeping notes. Something about this group doesn't add up.",
      "voiceLineID": "river_d5_concern",
      "isHappyPath": true,
      "prerequisites": ["river_d2_followup"],
      "unlocksNextDay": 3,
      "leadsToVoicemail": false,
      "unlockConditions": null
    },
    {
      "id": "river_d5_inconsistency",
      "prompt": "cross-referencing inconsistency",
      "responseText": "I have been cross-referencing things people have said. There is an inconsistency I cannot explain yet.",
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_unease_hint",
      "isHappyPath": true,
      "prerequisites": ["river_d3_concern"],
      "unlocksNextDay": 5,
      "leadsToVoicemail": false,
      "unlockConditions": null
    },
    {
      "id": "river_killer_alibi",
      "prompt": "alibi last night where were you",
      "responseText": "I was home. Reading. Alone. Which I realize sounds like the least verifiable answer.",
      "voiceLineID": "river_killer_alibi_shaky",
      "isHappyPath": false,
      "prerequisites": [],
      "unlocksNextDay": 3,
      "leadsToVoicemail": true,
      "unlockConditions": null
    },
    {
      "id": "river_innocent_alibi",
      "prompt": "alibi last night where were you",

      "voiceLineID": "river_innocent_alibi_firm",
      "isHappyPath": false,
      "prerequisites": [],
      "unlocksNextDay": 3,
      "leadsToVoicemail": false,
      "unlockConditions": null

<file path="catfish/Resources/Voice/voice_manifest.schema.json">
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://catfish.game/schemas/voice_manifest.schema.json",
  "title": "Catfish Voice Manifest",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["version", "voices", "lines"],
  "properties": {
    "version": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "voices": {
      "type": "object",
      "minProperties": 1,
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": ["voiceID", "provider"],
        "properties": {
          "voiceID": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
          "provider": { "type": "string", "enum": ["elevenlabs"] },
          "description": { "type": "string" }
        },
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "lines": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "voiceLineID",
          "text",
          "targetVoice",
          "emotionTag",
          "bundlePath"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "voiceLineID": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[a-z0-9]+(_[a-z0-9]+)+$"
          },
          "text": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 1000
          },
          "targetVoice": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "emotionTag": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "bundlePath": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^Voice/.+\\.m4a$"
          },
          "sceneID": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "day": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 1,
            "maximum": 7
          }
        },
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Scripts/audit_voice_bundle.py">
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify scene-referenced voice lines exist in manifest + bundle output."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import pathlib
import sys
from typing import Any


def load_json(path: pathlib.Path) -> Any:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def iter_scene_files(scene_dir: pathlib.Path) -> list[pathlib.Path]:
    return sorted(scene_dir.glob("*.json"))


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--scene-dir", required=True, type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument("--manifest", required=True, type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument("--bundle-root", required=True, type=pathlib.Path)
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    manifest = load_json(args.manifest)
    lines = manifest.get("lines", [])
    by_id = {line["voiceLineID"]: line for line in lines}

    errors: list[str] = []

    for scene_file in iter_scene_files(args.scene_dir):
        scene = load_json(scene_file)
        entries = scene.get("entries", [])
        for idx, entry in enumerate(entries):
            voice_line_id = entry.get("voiceLineID")
            if not voice_line_id:
                continue
            line = by_id.get(voice_line_id)
            if not line:
                errors.append(
                    f"{scene_file.name} entries[{idx}] references unknown voiceLineID={voice_line_id}"
                )
                continue
            rel_path = pathlib.Path(line["bundlePath"])
            full_path = args.bundle_root / rel_path
            if not full_path.exists():
                errors.append(
                    f"{scene_file.name} entries[{idx}] missing bundle audio {full_path}"
                )

    if errors:
        print("Voice bundle audit failed:")
        for err in errors:
            print(f" - {err}")
        return 1

    print("Voice bundle audit passed.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
</file>

<file path="catfish/ContentView.swift">
//
//  ContentView.swift
//  catfish
//
//  Created by John Clem on 4/25/26.
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct ContentView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var modelContext
    @Query private var items: [Item]

    var body: some View {
        NavigationSplitView {
            List {
                ForEach(items) { item in
                    NavigationLink {
                        Text("Item at \(item.timestamp, format: Date.FormatStyle(date: .numeric, time: .standard))")
                    } label: {
                        Text(item.timestamp, format: Date.FormatStyle(date: .numeric, time: .standard))
                    }
                }
                .onDelete(perform: deleteItems)
            }
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .navigationBarTrailing) {
                    EditButton()
                }
                ToolbarItem {
                    Button(action: addItem) {
                        Label("Add Item", systemImage: "plus")
                    }
                }
            }
        } detail: {
            Text("Select an item")
        }
    }

    private func addItem() {
        withAnimation {
            let newItem = Item(timestamp: Date())
            modelContext.insert(newItem)
        }
    }

    private func deleteItems(offsets: IndexSet) {
        withAnimation {
            for index in offsets {
                modelContext.delete(items[index])
            }
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    ContentView()
        .modelContainer(for: Item.self, inMemory: true)
}
