<file path="catfish/Core/Sprites/SpriteManager.swift">
import Foundation
import SpriteKit
import os

@MainActor
final class SpriteManager {
    static let shared = SpriteManager()

    private var animations: [String: SpriteAnimationDef] = [:]
    private var cutscenes: [String: CutsceneDefinition] = [:]
    private var textureCache: [String: [SKTexture]] = [:]
    private var loadedAtlases: Set<String> = []
    private var cutsceneLoaded = false

    private init() {}

    func resetForTesting() {
        animations.removeAll()
        cutscenes.removeAll()
        textureCache.removeAll()
        loadedAtlases.removeAll()
        cutsceneLoaded = false
    }

    var loadedSheetNames: Set<String> {
        loadedAtlases
    }

    func loadManifests() async throws {
        try await loadSpriteManifest()
        try await loadCutsceneManifest()
    }

    private func loadSpriteManifest() async throws {
        guard let url = Bundle.main.url(forResource: "sprite_manifest", withExtension: "csv") else {
            spriteLog.debug("sprite_manifest.csv not found — sprite system disabled")
            return
        }

        let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
        guard let csvString = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else { return }

        let rows = parseCSV(csvString)
        guard rows.count > 1 else { return }

        let headers = rows[0]
        let animIDIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "anim_id") ?? 0
        let charIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "character") ?? 1
        let exprIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "expression") ?? 2
        let envIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "environment") ?? 3
        let sceneTypeIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "scene_type") ?? 4
        let sheetIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "spritesheet") ?? 5
        let prefixIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "frame_prefix") ?? 6
        let countIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "frame_count") ?? 7
        let msIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "frame_ms") ?? 8
        let mouthIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "mouth_override") ?? 9
        let loopIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "loop") ?? 10
        let descIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "description") ?? 11
        let condIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "trigger_condition") ?? 12
        let letterIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "cinematic_letterbox") ?? 13
        let voiceIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "voice_line_id") ?? 14

        for row in rows.dropFirst() {
            guard row.count > max(animIDIdx, charIdx, exprIdx, sceneTypeIdx, sheetIdx, prefixIdx, countIdx, msIdx, mouthIdx, loopIdx) else { continue }

            let mouthStr = row[mouthIdx]
            let mouth: MouthShape = MouthShape(rawValue: mouthStr) ?? .auto

            let loopStr = row[loopIdx].lowercased()
            let cinematicStr = letterIdx < row.count ? row[letterIdx].lowercased() : "false"
            let condStr = condIdx < row.count ? row[condIdx] : ""
            let voiceStr = voiceIdx < row.count ? row[voiceIdx] : ""

            let def = SpriteAnimationDef(
                animID: row[animIDIdx],
                character: row[charIdx],
                expression: row[exprIdx],
                environment: row[envIdx],
                sceneType: row[sceneTypeIdx],
                spritesheet: row[sheetIdx],
                framePrefix: row[prefixIdx],
                frameCount: Int(row[countIdx]) ?? 1,
                frameMS: Int(row[msIdx]) ?? 83,
                mouthOverride: mouth,
                loop: loopStr == "true",
                description: descIdx < row.count ? row[descIdx] : "",
                triggerCondition: condStr.isEmpty ? nil : condStr,
                cinematicLetterbox: cinematicStr == "true",
                voiceLineID: voiceStr.isEmpty ? nil : voiceStr
            )

            animations[def.animID] = def
        }

        spriteLog.debug("Loaded \(self.animations.count) sprite animations")
    }

    private func loadCutsceneManifest() async throws {
        guard let url = Bundle.main.url(forResource: "cutscene_definitions", withExtension: "csv") else {
            spriteLog.debug("cutscene_definitions.csv not found")
            return
        }

        let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
        guard let csvString = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else { return }

        let rows = parseCSV(csvString)
        guard rows.count > 1 else { return }

        let headers = rows[0]
        let cidIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "cutscene_id") ?? 0
        let shotIdxIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "shot_index") ?? 1
        let typeIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "shot_type") ?? 2
        let durIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "duration_ms") ?? 3
        let charIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "character") ?? 4
        let animIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "animation_id") ?? 5
        let panXIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "camera_pan_x") ?? 6
        let panYIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "camera_pan_y") ?? 7
        let zoomIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "camera_zoom") ?? 8
        let tiltIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "camera_tilt") ?? 9
        let fadeInIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "fade_in_ms") ?? 10
        let fadeOutIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "fade_out_ms") ?? 11
        let speakerIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "dialogue_speaker") ?? 12
        let textIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "dialogue_text") ?? 13
        let voiceIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "voice_line_id") ?? 14
        let audioTypeIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "audio_cue_type") ?? 15
        let audioIDIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "audio_cue_asset_id") ?? 16
        let audioGainIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "audio_cue_gain") ?? 17
        let letterIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "letterboxed") ?? 18
        let triggerIdx = headers.firstIndex(of: "trigger_event") ?? 19

        var cutsceneMap: [String: [CutsceneShot]] = [:]

        for row in rows.dropFirst() {
            guard row.count > max(cidIdx, shotIdxIdx, typeIdx, durIdx) else { continue }

            let cutsceneID = row[cidIdx]
            let shotIndex = Int(row[shotIdxIdx]) ?? 0
            let durationMS = Int(row[durIdx]) ?? 1000
            let fadeIn = fadeInIdx < row.count ? (Int(row[fadeInIdx]) ?? 0) : 0
            let fadeOut = fadeOutIdx < row.count ? (Int(row[fadeOutIdx]) ?? 0) : 0
            let letterboxed = letterIdx < row.count && row[letterIdx].lowercased() == "true"
            let triggerEvent = triggerIdx < row.count ? row[triggerIdx] : cutsceneID

            let camera = CameraInstruction(
                panX: panXIdx < row.count ? Double(row[panXIdx]) : nil,
                panY: panYIdx < row.count ? Double(row[panYIdx]) : nil,
                zoom: zoomIdx < row.count ? Double(row[zoomIdx]) : nil,
                tiltDegrees: tiltIdx < row.count ? Double(row[tiltIdx]) : nil,
                durationMS: durationMS
            )

            var dialogueLine: DialogueLine?
            if speakerIdx < row.count && textIdx < row.count && !row[speakerIdx].isEmpty {
                dialogueLine = DialogueLine(
                    speakerName: row[speakerIdx],
                    text: row[textIdx],
                    voiceLineID: voiceIdx < row.count && !row[voiceIdx].isEmpty ? row[voiceIdx] : nil
                )
            }

            var audioCue: AudioCue?
            if audioTypeIdx < row.count && audioIDIdx < row.count && !row[audioTypeIdx].isEmpty {
                audioCue = AudioCue(
                    type: AudioCue.AudioCueType(rawValue: row[audioTypeIdx]) ?? .sfx,
                    assetID: row[audioIDIdx],
                    gain: audioGainIdx < row.count ? Float(row[audioGainIdx]) : nil
                )
            }

            let shot = CutsceneShot(
                shotID: "\(cutsceneID)_shot_\(shotIndex)",
                cutsceneID: cutsceneID,
                shotIndex: shotIndex,
                shotType: CutsceneShot.ShotType(rawValue: row[typeIdx]) ?? .wide,
                durationMS: durationMS,
                character: charIdx < row.count && !row[charIdx].isEmpty ? row[charIdx] : nil,
                animationID: animIdx < row.count && !row[animIdx].isEmpty ? row[animIdx] : nil,
                camera: camera,
                dialogueLine: dialogueLine,
                audioCue: audioCue,
                fadeInMS: fadeIn,
                fadeOutMS: fadeOut,
                letterboxed: letterboxed
            )

            cutsceneMap[cutsceneID, default: []].append(shot)
        }

        for (cid, shots) in cutsceneMap {
            let def = CutsceneDefinition(
                cutsceneID: cid,
                triggerEvent: cid,
                shots: shots.sorted { $0.shotIndex < $1.shotIndex },
                bgmTrack: nil,
                ambienceTrack: nil
            )
            cutscenes[cid] = def
        }

        cutsceneLoaded = true
        spriteLog.debug("Loaded \(self.cutscenes.count) cutscenes")
    }

    private func parseCSV(_ string: String) -> [[String]] {
        var result: [[String]] = []
        var currentRow: [String] = []
        var currentField = ""
        var insideQuotes = false

        for char in string {
            if char == "\"" {
                insideQuotes.toggle()
            } else if char == "," && !insideQuotes {
                currentRow.append(currentField.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces))
                currentField = ""
            } else if (char == "\n" || char == "\r") && !insideQuotes {
                currentRow.append(currentField.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces))
                if !currentRow.allSatisfy({ $0.isEmpty }) {
                    result.append(currentRow)
                }
                currentRow = []
                currentField = ""
            } else {
                currentField.append(char)
            }
        }

        if !currentField.isEmpty || !currentRow.isEmpty {
            currentRow.append(currentField.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces))
            if !currentRow.allSatisfy({ $0.isEmpty }) {
                result.append(currentRow)
            }
        }

        return result
    }

    func preloadAtlases(for characters: [CharacterID], sceneType: String) async {
        let needed = animations.values.filter { anim in
            characters.contains { $0.rawValue == anim.character } && anim.sceneType == sceneType
        }.map { $0.spritesheet }

        let unique = Set(needed)
        for sheet in unique where !loadedAtlases.contains(sheet) {
            await loadAtlas(named: sheet)
        }
    }

    func loadAtlas(named sheet: String) async {
        guard !loadedAtlases.contains(sheet) else { return }
        loadedAtlases.insert(sheet)

        let baseName = (sheet as NSString).lastPathComponent
        guard let atlasURL = Bundle.main.url(forResource: baseName, withExtension: nil, subdirectory: "Sprites/spritesheets") else {
            spriteLog.debug("Atlas not found: \(sheet)")
            return
        }

        let fileManager = FileManager.default
        guard let contents = try? fileManager.contentsOfDirectory(at: atlasURL, includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isRegularFileKey]) else {
            return
        }

        let textureFiles = contents.filter { url in
            let ext = url.pathExtension.lowercased()
            return ["png", "jpg", "jpeg"].contains(ext)
        }.sorted { $0.lastPathComponent < $1.lastPathComponent }

        var textures: [SKTexture] = []
        for fileURL in textureFiles {
            textures.append(SKTexture(imageNamed: fileURL.path))
        }

        textureCache[sheet] = textures
        spriteLog.debug("Loaded atlas \(sheet) with \(textures.count) textures")
    }

    func animation(for animID: String) -> SpriteAnimationDef? {
        animations[animID]
    }

    func animationsFor(character: CharacterID, sceneType: String, expression: String) -> [SpriteAnimationDef] {
        animations.values.filter {
            $0.character == character.rawValue && $0.sceneType == sceneType && $0.expression == expression
        }
    }

    func animationsFor(character: CharacterID, sceneType: String) -> [SpriteAnimationDef] {
        animations.values.filter {
            $0.character == character.rawValue && $0.sceneType == sceneType
        }
    }

    func cutscene(for event: String) -> CutsceneDefinition? {
        cutscenes[event]
    }

    func allCutscenes() -> [CutsceneDefinition] {
        Array(cutscenes.values)
    }

    func textures(for spritesheet: String) -> [SKTexture]? {
        textureCache[spritesheet]
    }

    func texturesForAnimation(_ anim: SpriteAnimationDef) -> [SKTexture]? {
        textures(for: anim.spritesheet)
    }
}

private let spriteLog = Logger(subsystem: "com.catfish", category: "SpriteManager")
</file>

<file path="catfish/Core/AccusationResolver.swift">
import Foundation

struct AccusationResult {
    let correct: Bool
    let matchedDeduction: Deduction?
    let ending: CaseEnding
    let narrativeBeat: String
    let isLuckyGuess: Bool
}

enum AccusationResolver {
    static func resolve(
        accused: CharacterID,
        run: CaseRun,
        discoveredIDs: Set<String>
    ) -> AccusationResult {
        let truth = KillerRegistry.identity(for: run.killer)

        if accused == run.killer {
            let hasEvidence = truth.solvingDeduction.requiredFactIDs.isSubset(of: discoveredIDs)
            let evidenceStrength = evidenceStrengthFor(run: run, discoveredIDs: discoveredIDs)
            let isLucky = !hasEvidence && evidenceStrength < 0.3
            return AccusationResult(
                correct: true,
                matchedDeduction: hasEvidence ? truth.solvingDeduction : nil,
                ending: .caughtThem,
                narrativeBeat: hasEvidence
                    ? truth.solvingDeduction.narrativeBeat
                    : "You were right. You just got lucky.",
                isLuckyGuess: isLucky
            )
        }

        let matched = truth.redHerrings.first { rh in
            rh.impliedKiller == accused &&
            rh.requiredFactIDs.isSubset(of: discoveredIDs)
        }

        return AccusationResult(
            correct: false,
            matchedDeduction: matched,
            ending: .wrongfulAccusation,
            narrativeBeat: matched?.narrativeBeat
                ?? "You pointed at a stranger. The real one kept swiping.",
            isLuckyGuess: false
        )
    }

    private static func evidenceStrengthFor(run: CaseRun, discoveredIDs: Set<String>) -> Double {
        let truth = KillerRegistry.identity(for: run.killer)
        let requiredIDs = truth.solvingDeduction.requiredFactIDs
        let matchCount = discoveredIDs.intersection(requiredIDs).count
        return requiredIDs.isEmpty ? 0 : Double(matchCount) / Double(requiredIDs.count)
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/DesignSystem/Theme.swift">
import SwiftUI

/// Palette pulled from the generated brand assets — magenta primary,
/// cyan secondary, deep navy background. Keep saturation high, keep
/// grays desaturated cool, never pure black or pure white.
enum CFColor {
    static let magenta     = Color(red: 0xFF/255, green: 0x2A/255, blue: 0x9C/255)
    static let magentaDim  = Color(red: 0xC9/255, green: 0x1F/255, blue: 0x78/255)
    static let cyan        = Color(red: 0x23/255, green: 0xE5/255, blue: 0xFF/255)
    static let cyanDim     = Color(red: 0x1B/255, green: 0xAF/255, blue: 0xC7/255)
    static let navy        = Color(red: 0x0A/255, green: 0x0B/255, blue: 0x2E/255)
    static let navyDeep    = Color(red: 0x05/255, green: 0x05/255, blue: 0x1A/255)
    static let ink         = Color(red: 0x1A/255, green: 0x1B/255, blue: 0x3D/255)
    static let cream       = Color(red: 0xF0/255, green: 0xEB/255, blue: 0xE0/255)

    /// Semantic aliases so feature code reads well.
    static let primary     = magenta
    static let secondary   = cyan
    static let surface     = ink
    static let background  = navyDeep
    static let textOnDark  = cream
    static let warning     = Color(red: 0xFF/255, green: 0x5C/255, blue: 0x5C/255)
}

enum CFFont {
    /// Pixel font for UI labels. Requires a bundled pixel font;
    /// falls back to rounded system at the same weight.
    /// Add "PressStart2P-Regular" to Resources/Fonts and the Info.plist.
    static func pixel(_ size: CGFloat) -> Font {
        if UIFont(name: "PressStart2P-Regular", size: size) != nil {
            return .custom("PressStart2P-Regular", size: size)
        }
        return .system(size: size, weight: .heavy, design: .rounded)
    }

    static let title      = pixel(22)
    static let headline   = pixel(16)
    static let body       = pixel(12)
    static let caption    = pixel(10)
}

// MARK: - Modifiers

/// Chunky SNES-style rounded rect with a 2-color drop shadow for depth.
struct PixelChromeModifier: ViewModifier {
    var fill: Color = CFColor.surface
    var stroke: Color = CFColor.primary
    var strokeWidth: CGFloat = 2
    var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 8

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .background(fill)
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius)
                    .stroke(stroke, lineWidth: strokeWidth)
            )
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
            .shadow(color: CFColor.secondary.opacity(0.35), radius: 0, x: 2, y: 2)
            .shadow(color: CFColor.navyDeep, radius: 0, x: 3, y: 3)
    }
}

extension View {
    func pixelChrome(
        fill: Color = CFColor.surface,
        stroke: Color = CFColor.primary,
        strokeWidth: CGFloat = 2,
        cornerRadius: CGFloat = 8
    ) -> some View {
        modifier(PixelChromeModifier(
            fill: fill, stroke: stroke,
            strokeWidth: strokeWidth, cornerRadius: cornerRadius
        ))
    }
}

/// The primary chunky action button used throughout the UI.
///
/// Plays `sound` on press-down by default. Set `sound = nil` for buttons
/// that already trigger their own audio (e.g. the swipe action bar buttons
/// fire swipeLeft/swipeRight stings layered on top of this).
struct PixelButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {
    var tint: Color = CFColor.primary
    var sound: AudioAsset.UISfx? = .buttonTapPrimary

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        PixelButtonContent(configuration: configuration, tint: tint, sound: sound)
    }
}

private struct PixelButtonContent: View {
    let configuration: PixelButtonStyle.Configuration
    let tint: Color
    let sound: AudioAsset.UISfx?
    @State private var wasPressed = false

    var body: some View {
        configuration.label
            .font(CFFont.headline)
            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            .padding(.vertical, 12)
            .padding(.horizontal, 20)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .background(tint)
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6)
                    .stroke(CFColor.cyan, lineWidth: 2)
            )
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
            .shadow(color: CFColor.navyDeep, radius: 0, x: 3, y: 3)
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.96 : 1.0)
            .opacity(configuration.isPressed ? 0.85 : 1.0)
            .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.08), value: configuration.isPressed)
            .onChange(of: configuration.isPressed) { _, isPressed in
                if isPressed && !wasPressed, let sound {
                    AudioEngine.shared.play(sound)
                }
                wasPressed = isPressed
            }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Docs/date-mode-prd.md">
# Catfish — Date Mode PRD (DEPRECATED)

> **DEPRECATED** — Superseded by `catfish_date-mode-prd.md` v0.2.1 (root directory)

- **Version:** 0.1 (initial draft)
- **Status:** Pre-implementation — awaiting paper-prototype validation of clue graph
- **Owner:** Johnny Clem
- **Last updated:** April 24, 2026

## 1. Overview

Date Mode is the high-stakes, high-immersion gameplay surface of Catfish.
Where App Mode is the investigation (chat, swipe, journal), Date Mode is the
confrontation — the player meets a match in person, hears their voice for
the first time, and either gathers the critical clue that breaks the case
or walks away unsettled.

Date Mode is where the killer tell most often lands. It is also where the
tension between Eastworld-driven ambient dialogue and ElevenLabs-voiced
scripted beats becomes visible to the player. The handoff between those two
modes — what we call the **Focus Shift** — is the signature interaction
of the game.

## 2. Goals & non-goals

### Goals

- **G1.** A single date scene plays end-to-end as a 5–8 minute interactive
  vignette with branching, voice, and at least one Focus Shift moment.
- **G2.** Every spoken line is voiced via pre-generated ElevenLabs audio,
  cached on-device, with sub-200ms playback latency from line trigger.
- **G3.** Eastworld provides the texture of the conversation —
  improvisational small talk, reactions to off-script player input — without
  ever revealing or inventing clue content.
- **G4.** Killer tells delivered in dates feel earned, not telegraphed.
  When the player rewatches a recorded run, the tell should be visible in
  hindsight without having been obvious in real time.
- **G5.** The visual presentation reads as "16-bit JRPG cutscene crossed
  with FaceTime intimacy." Static character sprite over scene background,
  with a first-person framing mode for high-tension moments.

### Non-goals (this version)

- **NG1.** Real-time animated character sprites. We use 2–3 expression states
  per character + a mouth-flap loop. No skeletal animation.
- **NG2.** Player-typed free-form input. All player turns are choice-driven
  buttons. (Eastworld supports free-form, but it widens the safety surface
  too far for a v1.)
- **NG3.** Multi-character dates. One player, one match, no third parties
  walking up to the table.
- **NG4.** Date scene editor / authoring tool UI. Authors edit JSON directly
  this version.
- **NG5.** Multiplayer or shared-date functionality.

## 3. Architecture overview

```text
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       iOS Client (Swift)                       │
│                                                                 │
│  ┌────────────────────┐         ┌──────────────────────────┐    │
│  │ DateSceneView      │         │ DateDirector             │    │
│  │ (SpriteKit + UI)   │◄───────►│ (Eastworld + scripted    │    │
│  │                    │         │  beat orchestrator)      │    │
│  └────────────────────┘         └────────┬─────────────────┘    │
│         │                                │                      │
│         ▼                                ▼                      │
│  ┌────────────────────┐         ┌──────────────────────────┐    │
│  │ VoicePlayer        │         │ EastworldClient          │    │
│  │ (AVFoundation +    │         │ (HTTP, Redis-cached)     │    │
│  │  bundle cache)     │         │                          │    │
│  └────────────────────┘         └────────┬─────────────────┘    │
│                                          │ HTTP                 │
└──────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┘
                                           │
                                           ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              Backend (Cloudflare Worker proxy)                 │
│                                                                 │
│   ┌──────────────────────┐      ┌─────────────────────────┐     │
│   │ Eastworld API        │      │ ElevenLabs key proxy    │     │
│   │ (Python, FastAPI)    │      │ (on-demand voice gen)   │     │
│   │ + Redis              │      │                         │     │
│   └──────────────────────┘      └─────────────────────────┘     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Three new client subsystems and one new backend service.

## 4. Critical design decisions (locked in earlier)

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| Visual format | Visual novel + first-person hybrid | Static sprite over background by default; first-person eye-contact framing for high-tension lines (the killer tell, the meet invitation). |
| Voice strategy | Voice on every line | Player-perceived production value depends on this; scripted lines pre-gen, Eastworld lines use on-demand ElevenLabs. |
| Eastworld scope | Included in MVP | The killer-tell ambiguity requires improvisational texture — pure scripted feels too on-rails. |
| Player input | Choice buttons only | Eastworld supports free-text but the safety surface (jailbreaks, anachronism, off-tone responses) is too wide for v1. |
| Clue authority | Scripted-only | Eastworld never owns clue content; agents have personality, never killer status. |

## 5. Epic 7 — Date entry & exit flows

How dates start (chat invitation, accept/decline) and how they end (return
to App mode with state changes visible).

### Tasks

1. **7.1 Date invitation beat type for chat engine.**
   A scripted chat message can offer a date (location, time-of-day).
   Player accepts/declines via inline choice buttons.
   Accept schedules date for next day-advance.
2. **7.2 "Date scheduled" match state UI.**
   Match list shows calendar icon + countdown.
   Clicking enters a "preparing for date" preamble.
3. **7.3 Date scene loader.**
   On day-advance, if a scheduled date is due,
   `RootView` routes into `DateSceneView` before returning to Swipe/Match tabs.
4. **7.4 Post-date return flow.**
   After scene end, return to App mode with:
   - new chat messages from the partner (scripted follow-up)
   - new Facts in journal (discovered during date)
   - updated affinity reflected in chat options going forward
5. **7.5 Skip/cancel handling.**
   Player can tap "leave the date" any time.
   Records `.cutShort` outcome. Affinity drops sharply.
6. **7.6 Day 7 meet flow.**
   Special variant. Killer's invitation is the
   meet-in-person scene that ends the run if accepted (`metKiller` ending).

### Acceptance criteria

From swipe → match → chat → date invitation → date scene → post-date chat
works end-to-end as a single user flow. State persists through app backgrounding.

### Risks

The Day 7 meet has unique stakes — needs its own visual treatment that signals
"this is different" without spoiling the outcome.
</file>

<file path="catfish/Docs/voice_pipeline.md">
# EPIC 2 — Voice pipeline

## 2.1 ElevenLabs voice casting (documented IDs)

> Replace these IDs with your production account IDs before shipping.

### Match voices (5)

| Match | Character | Voice ID | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Kai | `ELV_KAI_8f3c7f2a` | Warm, flirty, low register |
| 2 | River | `ELV_RIVER_5a8db191` | Bright, fast cadence |
| 3 | Miles | `ELV_MILES_772c6db4` | Controlled, polished |
| 4 | Sam | `ELV_SAM_4d20ce95` | Laid back, slightly sardonic |
| 5 | Jules | `ELV_JULES_c2a18f0e` | Playful, expressive |

### Friend voices (2)

| Friend | Voice ID | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Dev | `ELV_DEV_93f7ba10` | Grounded / skeptical guardrail |
| Nia | `ELV_NIA_7b1a2e40` | Encouraging / empathetic |

### Player narrator (optional)

| Role | Voice ID | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Narrator | `ELV_NARRATOR_2fe961d2` | Neutral, concise recaps |

## 2.2 Voice line manifest schema

Voice lines are authored in `Resources/Voice/voice_manifest.json` and validated
by `Resources/Voice/voice_manifest.schema.json`.

Each entry includes:

- `voiceLineID`: stable ID (`kai_d2_coffee_intro_01` style)
- `text`: line content to synthesize
- `targetVoice`: voice key used by pregen and runtime
- `emotionTag`: gameplay-direction cue (`flirty`, `nervous`, etc.)
- `bundlePath`: resolved in-app path (`Voice/kai/...m4a`)

## 2.3 Pre-generation script

Use:

```bash
python3 Scripts/pregen_voice_lines.py \
  --manifest Resources/Voice/voice_manifest.json \
  --output-dir Resources/Voice/Generated

# Date-mode only (all scene branches)
python3 Scripts/pregen_voice_lines.py \
  --manifest Resources/Voice/voice_manifest.json \
  --output-dir Resources/Voice/Generated \
  --scene-dir Resources/Scenes \
  --date-lines-mode all

# Date-mode happy path only
python3 Scripts/pregen_voice_lines.py \
  --manifest Resources/Voice/voice_manifest.json \
  --output-dir Resources/Voice/Generated \
  --scene-dir Resources/Scenes \
  --date-lines-mode happy
```

Behavior:

- Idempotent: skips any line whose output `.m4a` exists.
- Resumable: writes a checkpoint file (`.voice_generation_state.json`) with
  per-line status so interrupted runs can resume cleanly.
- Uses ElevenLabs text-to-speech endpoint and stores AAC/M4A audio.

Required environment variable:

- `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`

## 2.4 VoicePlayer runtime contract

`VoicePlayer` wraps `AVAudioPlayer` and provides:

- `preload(url:)`
- `play(url:volume:)`
- `stop()`
- interruption-aware pause/resume
- audio session category `.playback` with `.mixWithOthers`

When a clip completes, `voiceLineDidFinish` notification is emitted.

## 2.5 Bundle audit in CI

Use:

```bash
python3 Scripts/audit_voice_bundle.py \
  --scene-dir Resources/Scenes \
  --manifest Resources/Voice/voice_manifest.json \
  --bundle-root Resources/Voice/Generated
```

Audit checks:

1. Every `voiceLineID` referenced by scene JSON exists in manifest.
2. Every referenced line points to an existing `.m4a` in the bundle output.

Exit code is non-zero on failure for CI gating.

## 2.6 Eastworld on-demand voice generation

- Worker endpoint (`Cloudflare/voice-worker.js`): `POST { text, voiceId }`
- Applies text cap and returns `413` when exceeded.
- Proxies synthesis from ElevenLabs.
- Client (`EastworldVoiceService`) streams on demand, caches by
  `{voiceID}:{text}` hash for the current session, and falls back to text-only
  on cap hit, budget hit, or network error.

## 2.7 PreloadQueue

`VoicePreloadQueue` preloads first 10 lines for the current scene and leaves
all remaining lines for streaming. It intentionally does **not** preload Day 7
scene lines while on Day 1-6.

## Acceptance targets

- Scripted line trigger-to-play start: target `<200ms` via preload.
- Eastworld line: target `<2s` after synthesis completion.
- Cached repeats: immediate local playback.

## Budget and cost projection (initial)

Assumption (tune with real telemetry):

- Scripted lines are pre-generated at build time and do not hit runtime budget.
- Eastworld runtime: 10 generated lines/session average, 220 chars/line average.

Estimated generated chars/session: `~2,200`.

If blended price is approximately `$0.30 / 1,000 chars`, runtime cost/session is:

- `2.2 * $0.30 = $0.66/session`.

Suggested guardrails:

- hard cap: `3,000 chars/session` (`~$0.90` at above rate)
- soft warning: `2,400 chars/session`
- degrade to text-only once hard cap reached.

> Recalculate with your active ElevenLabs plan pricing before launch.
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Apps/FaceTime/FaceTimeAppView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData
import SpriteKit

struct FaceTimeAppView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    @State private var activeCall: FaceTimeCallContent?
    @State private var callLineIndex: Int = 0
    @State private var callPhase: CallPhase = .idle
    @State private var callHistory: [CallHistoryEntry] = []
    @State private var glitchLevel: Double = 0
    @State private var selectedChoice: String?
    @State private var faceTimeScene = FaceTimeSpriteScene()

    enum CallPhase {
        case idle
        case ringing
        case connected
        case ended
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            if callPhase == .idle {
                callHistoryView
            }

            if callPhase == .ringing {
                incomingCallView
            }

            if callPhase == .connected, let call = activeCall {
                inCallView(call)
            }

            if callPhase == .ended {
                callEndedView
            }
        }
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.85), value: callPhase)
    }

    private var callHistoryView: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 16) {
                HStack {
                    Image(systemName: "video.fill")
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    Text("FaceTime")
                        .font(CFFont.title)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    Spacer()
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                .padding(.top, 12)

                let pendingCalls = availableCalls
                if !pendingCalls.isEmpty {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                        Text("Incoming Calls")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                            .padding(.horizontal, 16)

                        ForEach(pendingCalls, id: \.id) { call in
                            pendingCallRow(call)
                        }
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                    }
                }

                if callHistory.isEmpty && pendingCalls.isEmpty {
                    VStack(spacing: 12) {
                        Image(systemName: "video.slash")
                            .font(.system(size: 40))
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.2))
                        Text("No video calls yet.")
                            .font(CFFont.body)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
                        Text("Match with someone to unlock calls.")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.4))
                    }
                    .padding(.top, 40)
                }

                if !callHistory.isEmpty {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                        Text("Call History")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.7))
                            .padding(.horizontal, 16)

                        ForEach(callHistory.reversed()) { entry in
                            historyRow(entry)
                        }
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func pendingCallRow(_ call: FaceTimeCallContent) -> some View {
        let characterID = CharacterID(rawValue: call.character)
        let name = characterID?.displayName ?? call.character

        return HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: "video.fill")
                .font(.system(size: 20))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                .frame(width: 40, height: 40)
                .background(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.12))
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text(name)
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Text("Wants to video call")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
            }
            Spacer()

            Button("Accept") {
                startCall(call)
            }
            .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255)))
            .frame(width: 80)
        }
        .padding(12)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
        .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10).stroke(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.3), lineWidth: 1))
    }

    private func historyRow(_ entry: CallHistoryEntry) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: "video.fill")
                .font(.system(size: 16))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.4))
                .frame(width: 36, height: 36)
                .background(CFColor.ink)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text(entry.characterName)
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Text("Day \(entry.day)")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
            }
            Spacer()
        }
        .padding(10)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.3))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
    }

    private var incomingCallView: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                Spacer()

                Image(systemName: "video.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 56))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    .padding(.bottom, 4)

                if let call = activeCall, let charID = CharacterID(rawValue: call.character) {
                    Text(charID.displayName)
                        .font(CFFont.title)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                }

                Text("Incoming Call...")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.6))

                Spacer()

                HStack(spacing: 40) {
                    Button {
                        callPhase = .idle
                        activeCall = nil
                    } label: {
                        Image(systemName: "phone.down.fill")
                            .font(.system(size: 24))
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                            .frame(width: 60, height: 60)
                            .background(CFColor.warning)
                            .clipShape(Circle())
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)

                    Button {
                        callPhase = .connected
                        callLineIndex = 0
                    } label: {
                        Image(systemName: "phone.fill")
                            .font(.system(size: 24))
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                            .frame(width: 60, height: 60)
                            .background(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255))
                            .clipShape(Circle())
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                }
                .padding(.bottom, 40)
            }
        }
    }

    private func inCallView(_ call: FaceTimeCallContent) -> some View {
        let lines = call.lines
        let currentLine = callLineIndex < lines.count ? lines[callLineIndex] : nil
        let characterID = CharacterID(rawValue: call.character)

        return ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                HStack {
                    if let charID = characterID {
                        AssetImage(charID.portraitAssetID)
                            .frame(width: 40, height: 40)
                            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
                    }
                    Text(characterID?.displayName ?? call.character)
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    Spacer()
                    Text("Connected")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255))
                }
                .padding(16)

                Spacer()

                VStack(spacing: 16) {
                    FaceTimeContainerView(scene: faceTimeScene, glitchLevel: glitchLevel)
                        .frame(width: 160, height: 200)
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16))
                        .overlay(
                            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16)
                                .stroke(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.3), lineWidth: 2)
                        )
                        .onAppear {
                            if let charID = characterID {
                                let isKiller = gameState.run?.killerRaw == call.character
                                let level: CGFloat = isKiller ? 0.3 : 0
                                let state: FaceTimeSpriteNode.CallState = isKiller ? .glitched : .connected
                                faceTimeScene.configure(
                                    characterID: charID.rawValue,
                                    callState: state,
                                    glitchLevel: level
                                )
                            }
                        }

                    if let line = currentLine {
                        Text(line.text)
                            .font(CFFont.body)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                            .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                            .padding(.horizontal, 32)
                            .padding(.vertical, 12)
                            .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.6))
                            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
                    }

                    if let line = currentLine, let choices = line.choices {
                        VStack(spacing: 8) {
                            ForEach(choices, id: \.self) { choice in
                                Button(choice) {
                                    selectedChoice = choice
                                    advanceCall(call)
                                }
                                .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.ink))
                                .padding(.horizontal, 32)
                            }
                        }
                        .padding(.top, 8)
                    } else if currentLine != nil {
                        Button("Continue") {
                            advanceCall(call)
                        }
                        .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.ink))
                        .padding(.horizontal, 48)
                    }
                }

                Spacer()

                Button {
                    endCall(call)
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "phone.down.fill")
                        .font(.system(size: 20))
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                        .frame(width: 50, height: 50)
                        .background(CFColor.warning)
                        .clipShape(Circle())
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .padding(.bottom, 20)
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            let isKiller = gameState.run?.killerRaw == call.character
            glitchLevel = isKiller ? 0.3 : 0
        }
    }

    private var callEndedView: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.95).ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 16) {
                Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 48))
                    .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255))

                Text("Call Ended")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                if let last = callHistory.last {
                    Text("Call with \(last.characterName)")
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.6))
                }

                Button("Done") {
                    callPhase = .idle
                    activeCall = nil
                }
                .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.ink))
                .padding(.horizontal, 60)
            }
        }
    }

    private var availableCalls: [FaceTimeCallContent] {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }
        let matchedCharacters = run.matches.map { $0.characterRaw }
        let calledCharacters = Set(callHistory.map { $0.characterRaw })

        return ContentStore.shared.universe.facetimeCalls.filter { call in
            call.triggerDay <= run.currentDay
                && matchedCharacters.contains(call.character)
                && !calledCharacters.contains(call.character)
        }
    }

    private func startCall(_ call: FaceTimeCallContent) {
        activeCall = call
        callPhase = .ringing
    }

    private func advanceCall(_ call: FaceTimeCallContent) {
        callLineIndex += 1
        if callLineIndex >= call.lines.count {
            endCall(call)
        }
    }

    private func endCall(_ call: FaceTimeCallContent) {
        if let factID = call.factID {
            try? gameState.commitFact(factID)
        }

        if let charID = CharacterID(rawValue: call.character) {
            callHistory.append(CallHistoryEntry(
                characterRaw: call.character,
                characterName: charID.displayName,
                day: gameState.currentDay,
                factID: call.factID
            ))
        }

        callPhase = .ended
    }
}

struct CallHistoryEntry: Identifiable {
    let id = UUID()
    let characterRaw: String
    let characterName: String
    let day: Int
    let factID: String?
}

private struct FaceTimeContainerView: UIViewRepresentable {
    let scene: FaceTimeSpriteScene
    let glitchLevel: Double

    func makeUIView(context: Context) -> SKView {
        let view = SKView()
        view.ignoresSiblingOrder = true
        view.preferredFramesPerSecond = 60
        scene.backgroundColor = .black
        view.presentScene(scene)
        return view
    }

    func updateUIView(_ uiView: SKView, context: Context) {
        scene.setGlitchLevel(CGFloat(glitchLevel))
    }
}

<file path="catfish/Features/Apps/Phone/CallView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData
import Combine

enum CallState {
    case ringing
    case connected
    case voicemail
    case ended
}

struct CallView: View {
    enum ContactTarget {
        case mainCharacter(CharacterID)
        case npc(NPCVoicemail)
        case friend(FriendID)
    }

    let friend: FriendID
    let target: ContactTarget

    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    @State private var messages: [ChatMessage] = []
    @State private var messageText = ""
    @State private var isTyping = false
    @State private var callDuration = 0
    @State private var callState: CallState = .ringing
    @State private var creditsUsed = 0
    @State private var currentVoiceURL: URL?
    @State private var isPlayingVoice = false

    @State private var callService = EastworldCallService()
    @State private var voiceGenerator = CallVoiceGenerator.shared
    @State private var dialogueManager = DialogueTreeManager.shared

    private let maxCredits = 3
    private let timer = Timer.publish(every: 1, on: .main, in: .common).autoconnect()

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                header
                contentArea
                inputBar
            }

            if callState == .voicemail {
                voicemailOverlay
                    .transition(.opacity)
            }

            if callState == .ended {
                callEndedOverlay
                    .transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            loadMessages()
            initializeCall()
        }
        .onReceive(timer) { _ in
            if callState == .connected && !callEnded {
                callDuration += 1
                checkCallState()
            }
        }
    }

    private var callEnded: Bool {
        callState == .ended || callState == .voicemail
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    callIcon
                    Text(headerTitle)
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                }

                Text(callDurationText)
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
            }

            Spacer()

            Button {
                endCall()
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "phone.down.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 20))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                    .frame(width: 36, height: 36)
                    .background(CFColor.warning.opacity(0.15))
                    .clipShape(Circle())
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.7))
    }

    private var callIcon: some View {
        Group {
            switch target {
            case .mainCharacter, .friend:
                Image(systemName: "phone.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 14))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
            case .npc:
                Image(systemName: "voicemail")
                    .font(.system(size: 14))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
            }
        }
    }

    private var headerTitle: String {
        switch target {
        case .mainCharacter(let character):
            return "\(friend == .dev ? "Dev" : "Nia") • Calling about \(character.displayName)"
        case .npc(let npc):
            return "\(friend == .dev ? "Dev" : "Nia") • Calling \(npc.name)"
        case .friend:
            return friend == .dev ? "Dev" : "Nia"
        }
    }

    private var callDurationText: String {
        if callState == .voicemail {
            return "Voicemail"
        }
        return formatDuration(callDuration)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var contentArea: some View {
        if callState == .voicemail {
            voicemailContent
        } else {
            messageList
        }
    }

    private var voicemailContent: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            Spacer()

            Image(systemName: "waveform")
                .font(.system(size: 60))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)

            Text("Voicemail")
                .font(CFFont.title)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

            Text("Leave a message after the tone.")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))

            Spacer()
        }
    }

    private var messageList: some View {
        ScrollViewReader { proxy in
            ScrollView {
                LazyVStack(spacing: 12) {
                    ForEach(messages) { message in
                        CallBubble(message: message, friend: friend)
                            .id(message.id)
                    }

                    if isTyping {
                        HStack {
                            TypingCallIndicator()
                            Spacer()
                        }
                        .id("typing")
                    }
                }
                .padding()
            }
            .onChange(of: messages.count) { _, _ in
                scrollToBottom(proxy: proxy)
            }
        }
    }

    private var inputBar: some View {
        Group {
            if callState == .voicemail {
                voicemailInput
            } else if callState == .connected {
                messageInput
            }
        }
    }

    private var messageInput: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                TextField("Ask about \(characterDisplayName)...", text: $messageText)
                    .textFieldStyle(.plain)
                    .padding(10)
                    .background(CFColor.ink)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 20))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .onSubmit(sendMessage)

                Button(action: sendMessage) {
                    Image(systemName: "arrow.up.circle.fill")
                        .font(.system(size: 32))
                        .foregroundStyle(messageText.isEmpty || creditsUsed >= maxCredits ? CFColor.ink : CFColor.primary)
                }
                .disabled(messageText.isEmpty || creditsUsed >= maxCredits)
            }
            .padding()
            .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))

            HStack {
                Text("\(maxCredits - creditsUsed)/\(maxCredits) credits remaining")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(creditsUsed >= maxCredits ? CFColor.warning : CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.7))
                Spacer()

                if callService.shouldBeginWrapUp(callDuration: callDuration) {
                    Text("Call wrapping up...")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning.opacity(0.8))
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal)
            .padding(.top, 4)
        }
    }

    private var voicemailInput: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            Text("Type your message:")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))

            TextField("Leave a voicemail message...", text: $messageText)
                .textFieldStyle(.plain)
                .padding(10)
                .background(CFColor.ink)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Button("Cancel") {
                    endCall()
                }
                .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.ink))

                Button("Send Message") {
                    sendVoicemail()
                }
                .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
                .disabled(messageText.isEmpty)
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
    }

    private var voicemailOverlay: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.95).ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                Image(systemName: "waveform.circle.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 80))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)

                Text("Voicemail")
                    .font(CFFont.title)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                Text(voicemailGreetingText)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.8))
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                    .padding(.horizontal)

                Button("Leave Message") {
                    withAnimation {
                        callState = .voicemail
                    }
                }
                .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
                .padding(.horizontal, 60)
            }
        }
    }

    private var voicemailGreetingText: String {
        switch target {
        case .mainCharacter(let character):
            return getCharacterVoicemailGreeting(character)
        case .npc(let npc):
            return npc.voicemailGreeting.text
        case .friend:
            return "Hey, you've reached \(friend == .dev ? "Dev" : "Nia"). Leave a message!"
        }
    }

    private var callEndedOverlay: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.95).ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                Image(systemName: "phone.badge.checkmark")
                    .font(.system(size: 60))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)

                Text("Call Ended")
                    .font(CFFont.title)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                Text("You talked for \(formatDuration(callDuration))")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))

                if creditsUsed > 0 {
                    Text("\(creditsUsed) credit\(creditsUsed == 1 ? "" : "s") used")
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                }

                Button("Done") {
                    dismiss()
                }
                .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
                .padding(.horizontal, 60)
            }
        }
    }

    private func initializeCall() {
        switch target {
        case .mainCharacter(let character):
            checkCharacterAvailability(character)
        case .npc(let npc):
            playNPCVoicemailGreeting(npc)
        case .friend:
            startCallWithFriend()
        }
    }

    private func checkCharacterAvailability(_ character: CharacterID) {
        guard let match = gameState.run?.matches.first(where: { $0.characterID == character }) else {
            startCallWithFriend()
            return
        }

        let day = gameState.currentDay
        let discoveredFacts = Array(gameState.run?.discoveredFactIDs ?? [])
        let completedDates = gameState.run?.matches.flatMap { $0.run?.matches.compactMap { $0.scheduledDateSceneID } ?? [] } ?? []

        let isExhausted = dialogueManager.isTreeExhausted(
            for: character,
            day: day,
            discoveredFactIDs: discoveredFacts,
            affinity: 0,
            completedDateSceneIDs: completedDates,
            exhaustedNodeIDs: match.exhaustedDialogueNodeIDs
        )

        if isExhausted {
            callState = .voicemail
        } else {
            callState = .connected
            startCallWithFriend()
        }
    }

    private func startCallWithFriend() {
        let openingMessage = ChatMessage(
            threadKey: buildThreadKey(),
            senderKey: friend.rawValue,
            text: buildOpeningLine(),
            sentAt: Date()
        )
        openingMessage.run = gameState.run
        context.insert(openingMessage)
        messages.append(openingMessage)
        try? context.save()
    }

    private func buildOpeningLine() -> String {
        let friendName = friend == .dev ? "Dev" : "Nia"

        switch target {
        case .mainCharacter(let character):
            return "Hey, it's \(friendName). You wanted to talk about \(character.displayName)? What's on your mind?"
        case .npc(let npc):
            return "Hey, it's \(friendName). You're calling \(npc.name). This is going to voicemail."
        case .friend:
            return "Hey! What's up? You called?"
        }
    }

    private func sendMessage() {
        let text = messageText.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard !text.isEmpty, creditsUsed < maxCredits, callState == .connected else { return }

        let threadKey = buildThreadKey()
        let message = ChatMessage(
            threadKey: threadKey,
            senderKey: "player",
            text: text,
            sentAt: Date()
        )
        message.run = gameState.run
        context.insert(message)
        messages.append(message)

        messageText = ""
        creditsUsed += 1
        AudioEngine.shared.play(.messageSend)

        Task {
            await generateResponse(for: message)
        }
    }

    private func generateResponse(for playerMessage: ChatMessage) async {
        isTyping = true

        let delay = Double(min(max(playerMessage.text.count, 20), 100)) / 50.0 * 1.5 + 0.5
        try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(delay))

        let response: String
        do {
            switch target {
            case .mainCharacter(let character):
                response = try await callService.generateResponse(
                    character: character,
                    playerInput: playerMessage.text,
                    callDuration: callDuration,
                    exhaustedNodeIDs: getExhaustedNodeIDs(for: character),
                    day: gameState.currentDay,
                    discoveredFactIDs: Array(gameState.run?.discoveredFactIDs ?? []),
                    affinity: 0,
                    completedDateSceneIDs: getCompletedDateSceneIDs()
                )
            case .friend:
                response = try await callService.generateResponse(
                    character: .kai,
                    playerInput: playerMessage.text,
                    callDuration: callDuration,
                    exhaustedNodeIDs: [],
                    day: gameState.currentDay,
                    discoveredFactIDs: [],
                    affinity: 0,
                    completedDateSceneIDs: []
                )
            default:
                response = "..."
            }
        } catch {
            response = "Sorry, the connection dropped for a second. Can you repeat that?"
        }

        let threadKey = buildThreadKey()
        let meta = response.contains("(connection unstable)") ? ChatMessageMeta(isConnectionUnstable: true) : nil
        let message = ChatMessage(
            threadKey: threadKey,
            senderKey: friend.rawValue,
            text: response,
            sentAt: Date(),
            metadata: meta
        )
        message.run = gameState.run
        context.insert(message)

        await MainActor.run {
            isTyping = false
            messages.append(message)
            AudioEngine.shared.play(.messageReceived)

            if callService.shouldEndCall(callDuration: callDuration) {
                endCall()
            }
        }
    }

    private func sendVoicemail() {
        guard !messageText.isEmpty else { return }

        let voicemail = VoicemailMessage(
            fromCharacterID: friend.rawValue,
            transcript: messageText,
            duration: min(messageText.count / 10, 30)
        )
        voicemail.run = gameState.run
        context.insert(voicemail)

        try? context.save()
        endCall()
    }

    private func playNPCVoicemailGreeting(_ npc: NPCVoicemail) {
        callState = .voicemail
    }

    private func getCharacterVoicemailGreeting(_ character: CharacterID) -> String {
        guard let tree = dialogueManager.tree(for: character),
              let line = VoiceManifestStore.shared.line(tree.voicemailGreetingID) else {
            return "You've reached \(character.displayName). Leave a message."
        }
        return line.text
    }

    private func getExhaustedNodeIDs(for character: CharacterID) -> [String] {
        gameState.run?.matches.first(where: { $0.characterID == character })?.exhaustedDialogueNodeIDs ?? []
    }

    private func getCompletedDateSceneIDs() -> [String] {
        gameState.run?.matches.flatMap { match in
            match.run?.matches.compactMap { $0.scheduledDateSceneID } ?? []
        } ?? []
    }

    private func checkCallState() {
        if callService.shouldEndCall(callDuration: callDuration) {
            endCall()
        }
    }

    private func endCall() {
        callState = .ended
        saveCallRecord()
        AudioEngine.shared.play(.modalClose)

        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2) {
            dismiss()
        }
    }

    private func saveCallRecord() {
        let contactID: String
        let contactType: CallRecord.ContactType

        switch target {
        case .mainCharacter(let character):
            contactID = character.rawValue
            contactType = .mainCharacter
        case .npc(let npc):
            contactID = npc.id
            contactType = .npc
        case .friend:
            contactID = friend.rawValue
            contactType = .friend
        }

        let record = CallRecord(
            contactID: contactID,
            contactType: contactType,
            duration: callDuration,
            wentToVoicemail: callState == .voicemail,
            dialogueTreeExhausted: callState == .voicemail && {
                if case .mainCharacter = target { return true }
                return false
            }()
        )
        record.run = gameState.run
        context.insert(record)
        try? context.save()
    }

    private func loadMessages() {
        let threadKey = buildThreadKey()

        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<ChatMessage>(
            predicate: #Predicate<ChatMessage> { $0.threadKey == threadKey },
            sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.sentAt, order: .forward)]
        )

        if let fetched = try? context.fetch(descriptor) {
            messages = fetched
        }
    }

    private func buildThreadKey() -> String {
        switch target {
        case .mainCharacter(let character):
            return "call:\(friend.rawValue):\(character.rawValue)"
        case .npc(let npc):
            return "call:\(friend.rawValue):\(npc.id)"
        case .friend:
            return "call:\(friend.rawValue):friend"
        }
    }

    private var characterDisplayName: String {
        switch target {
        case .mainCharacter(let character):
            return character.displayName
        case .npc(let npc):
            return npc.name
        case .friend:
            return ""
        }
    }

    private func formatDuration(_ seconds: Int) -> String {
        let mins = seconds / 60
        let secs = seconds % 60
        if mins > 0 {
            return String(format: "%d:%02d", mins, secs)
        }
        return String(format: "0:%02d", secs)
    }

    private func scrollToBottom(proxy: ScrollViewProxy) {
        withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.3)) {
            if isTyping {
                proxy.scrollTo("typing", anchor: .bottom)
            } else if let last = messages.last {
                proxy.scrollTo(last.id, anchor: .bottom)
            }
        }
    }
}

struct CallBubble: View {
    let message: ChatMessage
    let friend: FriendID

    var isFromPlayer: Bool { message.senderKey == "player" }

    var body: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 8) {
            if isFromPlayer { Spacer(minLength: 40) }

            if !isFromPlayer {
                Image(systemName: "person.circle.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 32))
                    .foregroundStyle(friend == .dev ? CFColor.cyan : CFColor.primary)
                    .frame(width: 32, height: 32)
            }

            VStack(alignment: isFromPlayer ? .trailing : .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text(message.text)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .padding(12)
                    .background(isFromPlayer ? CFColor.primary.opacity(0.8) : CFColor.ink.opacity(0.6))
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16))

                if let meta = message.meta, meta.isConnectionUnstable == true {
                    HStack(spacing: 4) {
                        Image(systemName: "wifi.slash")
                            .font(.system(size: 10))
                        Text("connection unstable")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                    }
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning.opacity(0.7))
                }

                HStack(spacing: 4) {
                    if !isFromPlayer && !message.isRead {
                        Circle()
                            .fill(CFColor.cyan)
                            .frame(width: 6, height: 6)
                    }
                    Text(formatTime(message.sentAt))
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.6))
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: 260, alignment: isFromPlayer ? .trailing : .leading)

            if !isFromPlayer { Spacer(minLength: 40) }
        }
    }

    private func formatTime(_ date: Date) -> String {
        let formatter = DateFormatter()
        formatter.timeStyle = .short
        return formatter.string(from: date)
    }
}

struct TypingCallIndicator: View {
    @State private var dotCount = 0
    private let timer = Timer.publish(every: 0.5, on: .main, in: .common).autoconnect()

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            Image(systemName: "person.circle.fill")
                .font(.system(size: 32))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                .frame(width: 32, height: 32)

            Text(String(repeating: ".", count: dotCount + 1))
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.6))
                .onReceive(timer) { _ in
                    dotCount = (dotCount + 1) % 4
                }
        }
        .padding(12)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16))
    }
}

<file path="catfish/Features/Date/DateVoicePlayback.swift">
import Foundation
import CoreGraphics
import Combine

/// Date mode voice playback abstraction.
///
/// Implementations can be backed by local bundled audio, ElevenLabs cache,
/// or an Eastworld streaming adapter. Date mode itself should only depend on
/// this contract so we avoid colliding with backend-specific players.
@MainActor
protocol DateVoicePlaybackEngine: ObservableObject {
    var isPlaying: Bool { get }
    var estimatedAmplitude: CGFloat { get }

    func playScriptedLine(lineID: String, text: String, onFinish: @escaping () -> Void)
    func stop()
}

/// Temporary fallback used for prototype validation when real audio assets are
/// unavailable. This does not perform network synthesis and is safe to replace
/// with a production implementation at injection time.
@MainActor
final class SimulatedDateVoicePlayback: DateVoicePlaybackEngine {
    @Published private(set) var isPlaying: Bool = false
    @Published private(set) var estimatedAmplitude: CGFloat = 0

    private var amplitudeTimer: Timer?
    private var playbackTask: Task<Void, Never>?

    func playScriptedLine(lineID: String, text: String, onFinish: @escaping () -> Void) {
        stop()
        isPlaying = true

        amplitudeTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 0.1, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
            Task { @MainActor [weak self] in
                guard let self else { return }
                self.estimatedAmplitude = CGFloat.random(in: 0.2...1.0)
            }
        }

        playbackTask = Task { [weak self] in
            let seconds = max(1.2, Double(text.count) * 0.038)
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(seconds))
            guard let self else { return }
            self.stop()
            onFinish()
        }
    }

    func stop() {
        playbackTask?.cancel()
        playbackTask = nil
        amplitudeTimer?.invalidate()
        amplitudeTimer = nil
        isPlaying = false
        estimatedAmplitude = 0
    }

    deinit {
        amplitudeTimer?.invalidate()
        playbackTask?.cancel()
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Matches/MatchesView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct MatchesView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            if let matches = gameState.run?.matches, !matches.isEmpty {
                ScrollView {
                    LazyVStack(spacing: 12) {
                        ForEach(matches) { match in
                            NavigationLink(destination: ChatView(match: match)) {
                                MatchRow(match: match)
                            }
                            .buttonStyle(.plain)
                        }
                    }
                    .padding()
                }
            } else {
                emptyState
            }
        }
    }

    private var emptyState: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            Image(systemName: "heart.slash")
                .font(.system(size: 52))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
            Text("No matches yet.")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Text("Keep swiping to find your matches.")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
        }
    }
}

struct MatchRow: View {
    let match: MatchRelationship

    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    private var unreadCount: Int {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return 0 }
        let threadKey = "match:\(match.characterRaw)"
        return run.chatThreads.first(where: { $0.partnerKey == threadKey })?.unreadCount ?? 0
    }

    private var lastMessage: String? {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return nil }
        let threadKey = "match:\(match.characterRaw)"
        return run.chatThreads.first(where: { $0.partnerKey == threadKey })?.lastMessageText
    }

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 16) {
            AssetImage(match.characterID.portraitAssetID)
                .frame(width: 60, height: 60)
                .clipShape(Circle())

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                HStack {
                    Text(match.characterID.displayName)
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                    if unreadCount > 0 {
                        Text("\(unreadCount)")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                            .padding(.horizontal, 6)
                            .padding(.vertical, 2)
                            .background(CFColor.primary)
                            .clipShape(Capsule())
                    }
                }

                if let last = lastMessage {
                    Text(last)
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.6))
                        .lineLimit(1)
                } else {
                    Text("Matched on Day \(match.matchedOnDay)")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                }
            }

            Spacer()

            if unreadCount > 0 {
                Circle()
                    .fill(CFColor.cyan)
                    .frame(width: 10, height: 10)
            }

            Image(systemName: "chevron.right")
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.6))
        }
        .padding()
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.6))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
    }
}

<file path="catfish/Features/PhoneOS/HomeScreen.swift">
import SwiftUI

/// The FishPhone home screen: 3×2 grid of app icons over a navy backdrop.
/// Tapping an icon asks the OS state to open that app.
struct HomeScreen: View {
    @Environment(PhoneOSState.self) private var os
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    private let columns = [
        GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 24),
        GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 24),
        GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 24)
    ]

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            background
            VStack(spacing: 28) {
                wallpaperHeader
                LazyVGrid(columns: columns, spacing: 28) {
                    ForEach(AppID.allCases) { app in
                        AppIcon(app: app, badgeCount: badge(for: app)) {
                            os.open(app)
                        }
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                Spacer()
            }
            .padding(.top, 18)
        }
    }

    private var background: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.ignoresSafeArea()
            // Soft radial halo so the screen doesn't feel flat.
            RadialGradient(
                colors: [CFColor.primary.opacity(0.18), .clear],
                center: .top,
                startRadius: 20,
                endRadius: 320
            )
            .ignoresSafeArea()
        }
    }

    private var wallpaperHeader: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 4) {
            Text("FISHPHONE")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                .tracking(4)
            Text("Day \(gameState.currentDay) of 7")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.7))
        }
    }

    private func badge(for app: AppID) -> Int {
        switch app {
        case .journal:
            return gameState.newJournalClueCount
        default:
            return 0
        }
    }
}
