<file path="catfish/Features/PhoneOS/StatusBar.swift">
import SwiftUI

/// The thin row at the top of the FishPhone screen. Left side shows the
/// in-game day; right side shows decorative signal/battery glyphs.
///
/// The clock is intentionally tied to `GameState.currentDay` rather than the
/// real wall clock — this is a game-world device, not iOS.
struct PhoneStatusBar: View {
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Text("DAY \(gameState.currentDay)")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(gameState.isDay7 ? CFColor.warning : CFColor.cyan)

                Spacer()

                signalGlyph
                batteryGlyph
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 14)
            .padding(.vertical, 6)
            .background(CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.85))

            if gameState.isDay7 {
                Text("LAST DAY — MAKE YOUR ACCUSATION")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                    .tracking(1)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding(.vertical, 3)
                    .background(CFColor.warning.opacity(0.1))
            }
        }
    }

    private var signalGlyph: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 2) {
            ForEach(0..<4, id: \.self) { i in
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 1)
                    .fill(CFColor.cream.opacity(i < 3 ? 1 : 0.3))
                    .frame(width: 3, height: CGFloat(4 + i * 2))
            }
        }
    }

    /// Battery drains visually as the case progresses — flavor only.
    private var batteryGlyph: some View {
        let day = gameState.currentDay
        let remaining = max(0.15, 1.0 - Double(day - 1) / 7.0)
        return ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 2)
                .stroke(CFColor.cream, lineWidth: 1)
                .frame(width: 22, height: 10)
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 1)
                .fill(remaining > 0.3 ? CFColor.cream : CFColor.warning)
                .frame(width: 18 * remaining, height: 6)
                .offset(x: 2)
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Title/RunDetailView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct RunDetailView: View {
    let run: CaseRun
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
                    headerCard
                    factsTimeline
                    accusationResult
                    playAgainButton
                }
                .padding(20)
            }
            .background(CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea())
            .navigationTitle("Case Details")
            .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) {
                    Button("Close") { dismiss() }
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var headerCard: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: outcomeIcon)
                .font(.system(size: 40))
                .foregroundStyle(outcomeColor)

            Text("Killer: \(run.killer.displayName)")
                .font(CFFont.title)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

            outcomeBadge

            HStack(spacing: 20) {
                detailStat(label: "Days", value: "\(run.currentDay)")
                detailStat(label: "Clues", value: "\(run.discoveredFactIDs.count)")
                detailStat(label: "Matches", value: "\(run.matches.count)")
            }

            if let endedAt = run.endedAt {
                Text(formatDate(endedAt))
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.4))
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .padding(20)
        .background(CFColor.ink)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14))
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14)
                .stroke(outcomeColor.opacity(0.3), lineWidth: 2)
        )
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var factsTimeline: some View {
        let facts = run.discovered.sorted { $0.discoveredAt < $1.discoveredAt }
        if !facts.isEmpty {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                Label("Discovered Facts", systemImage: "magnifyingglass")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)

                ForEach(facts) { fact in
                    HStack(spacing: 10) {
                        Circle()
                            .fill(CFColor.primary)
                            .frame(width: 8, height: 8)

                        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                            Text(fact.factID)
                                .font(CFFont.body)
                                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                            Text(formatDate(fact.discoveredAt))
                                .font(CFFont.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.4))
                        }

                        Spacer()
                    }
                    .padding(.vertical, 4)
                }
            }
            .padding(16)
            .background(CFColor.ink)
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10)
                    .stroke(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.15), lineWidth: 1)
            )
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var accusationResult: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            Label("Accusation", systemImage: "exclamationmark.shield")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)

            Text(outcomeDescription)
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.8))
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .padding(16)
        .background(CFColor.ink)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10)
                .stroke(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.2), lineWidth: 1)
        )
    }

    private func detailStat(label: String, value: String) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 4) {
            Text(value)
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Text(label)
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5))
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
    }

    private var outcomeIcon: String {
        switch run.ending {
        case .caughtThem: return "checkmark.shield.fill"
        case .wrongfulAccusation: return "xmark.shield.fill"
        case .metKiller: return "eye.fill"
        case .killerEscaped: return "figure.run"
        default: return "questionmark"
        }
    }

    private var outcomeColor: Color {
        switch run.ending {
        case .caughtThem: return CFColor.cyan
        case .wrongfulAccusation: return CFColor.warning
        case .metKiller: return CFColor.primary
        case .killerEscaped: return CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5)
        default: return CFColor.cream.opacity(0.3)
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var outcomeBadge: some View {
        let params = outcomeBadgeParams
        Text(params.text)
            .font(CFFont.caption)
            .foregroundStyle(params.color)
            .padding(.vertical, 4)
            .padding(.horizontal, 12)
            .background(params.color.opacity(0.15))
            .clipShape(Capsule())
    }

    private var outcomeBadgeParams: (text: String, color: Color) {
        switch run.ending {
        case .caughtThem: return (text: "CAUGHT THEM", color: CFColor.cyan)
        case .wrongfulAccusation: return (text: "WRONGFUL ACCUSATION", color: CFColor.warning)
        case .metKiller: return (text: "MET THE KILLER", color: CFColor.primary)
        case .killerEscaped: return (text: "KILLER ESCAPED", color: CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5))
        default: return (text: "UNKNOWN", color: CFColor.cream.opacity(0.3))
        }
    }

    private var outcomeDescription: String {
        switch run.ending {
        case .caughtThem:
            return "You correctly identified \(run.killer.displayName) as the killer. Justice served."
        case .wrongfulAccusation:
            return "You accused the wrong person. \(run.killer.displayName) walked free."
        case .metKiller:
            return "You came face to face with the killer, \(run.killer.displayName)."
        case .killerEscaped:
            return "Time ran out. \(run.killer.displayName) escaped justice."
        default:
            return "This case has no recorded outcome."
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var playAgainButton: some View {
        Button {
            try? gameState.startNewRun()
            dismiss()
        } label: {
            Text("Play Again")
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        }
        .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
        .padding(.top, 8)
    }

    private func formatDate(_ date: Date) -> String {
        let formatter = DateFormatter()
        formatter.dateStyle = .short
        formatter.timeStyle = .short
        return formatter.string(from: date)
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Title/RunHistoryView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct RunHistoryView: View {
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @State private var completedRuns: [CaseRun] = []
    @State private var selectedRun: CaseRun?
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            ZStack {
                CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

                if completedRuns.isEmpty {
                    emptyState
                } else {
                    runList
                }
            }
            .navigationTitle("Past Cases")
            .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) {
                    Button("Done") { dismiss() }
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                }
            }
            .sheet(item: $selectedRun) { run in
                RunDetailView(run: run)
                    .environment(gameState)
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            completedRuns = (try? gameState.fetchCompletedRuns()) ?? []
        }
        .onChange(of: gameState.run?.id) { _, newID in
            if let newID, !completedRuns.contains(where: { $0.id == newID }) {
                dismiss()
            }
        }
    }

    private var emptyState: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            Image(systemName: "archivebox")
                .font(.system(size: 48))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.3))
            Text("No closed cases yet.")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Text("Go catch a killer.")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.6))
        }
    }

    private var runList: some View {
        List {
            ForEach(completedRuns) { run in
                Button {
                    selectedRun = run
                } label: {
                    runRow(run)
                }
                .listRowBackground(CFColor.ink)
                .listRowSeparatorTint(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.15))
            }
        }
        .scrollContentBackground(.hidden)
    }

    private func runRow(_ run: CaseRun) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 14) {
            outcomeIcon(run.ending)

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text(run.killer.displayName)
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                HStack(spacing: 12) {
                    Label("\(run.currentDay) days", systemImage: "calendar")
                    Label("\(run.discoveredFactIDs.count) clues", systemImage: "magnifyingglass")
                }
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.6))
            }

            Spacer()

            outcomeBadge(run.ending)
        }
        .padding(.vertical, 4)
    }

    private func outcomeIcon(_ ending: CaseEnding?) -> some View {
        let params = outcomeIconParams(ending)
        return Image(systemName: params.icon)
            .font(.system(size: 24))
            .foregroundStyle(params.color)
            .frame(width: 40, height: 40)
    }

    private func outcomeBadge(_ ending: CaseEnding?) -> some View {
        let params = outcomeBadgeParams(ending)
        return Text(params.text)
            .font(CFFont.caption)
            .foregroundStyle(params.color)
            .padding(.vertical, 4)
            .padding(.horizontal, 8)
            .background(params.color.opacity(0.15))
            .clipShape(Capsule())
    }

    private func outcomeIconParams(_ ending: CaseEnding?) -> (icon: String, color: Color) {
        switch ending {
        case .caughtThem: return (icon: "checkmark.shield.fill", color: CFColor.cyan)
        case .wrongfulAccusation: return (icon: "xmark.shield.fill", color: CFColor.warning)
        case .metKiller: return (icon: "eye.fill", color: CFColor.primary)
        case .killerEscaped: return (icon: "figure.run", color: CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5))
        default: return (icon: "questionmark", color: CFColor.cream.opacity(0.3))
        }
    }

    private func outcomeBadgeParams(_ ending: CaseEnding?) -> (text: String, color: Color) {
        switch ending {
        case .caughtThem: return (text: "CAUGHT", color: CFColor.cyan)
        case .wrongfulAccusation: return (text: "WRONG", color: CFColor.warning)
        case .metKiller: return (text: "MET", color: CFColor.primary)
        case .killerEscaped: return (text: "ESCAPED", color: CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5))
        default: return (text: "???", color: CFColor.cream.opacity(0.3))
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/EastworldVoiceService.swift">
import Foundation

enum EastworldVoiceError: Error {
    case textTooLong(limit: Int)
    case budgetExceeded(usedChars: Int, capChars: Int)
    case invalidResponse
    case requestFailed(statusCode: Int)
}

struct EastworldVoiceConfig {
    let endpoint: URL
    let textLimit: Int
    let perSessionCharacterBudget: Int
}

actor EastworldVoiceService {
    private let config: EastworldVoiceConfig
    private var usedCharacters = 0
    private var sessionCache: [String: URL] = [:]

    init(config: EastworldVoiceConfig? = nil) {
        self.config = config ?? EastworldVoiceConfig(
            endpoint: URL(string: "https://voice.catfish.workers.dev/generate")!,
            textLimit: 260,
            perSessionCharacterBudget: 3_000
        )
    }

    func streamOrFetch(text: String, voiceID: String) async throws -> URL {
        if text.count > config.textLimit {
            throw EastworldVoiceError.textTooLong(limit: config.textLimit)
        }

        if usedCharacters + text.count > config.perSessionCharacterBudget {
            throw EastworldVoiceError.budgetExceeded(
                usedChars: usedCharacters,
                capChars: config.perSessionCharacterBudget
            )
        }

        let cacheKey = cacheKeyFor(text: text, voiceID: voiceID)
        if let cached = sessionCache[cacheKey], FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: cached.path) {
            return cached
        }

        let localURL = try await fetchAndCache(text: text, voiceID: voiceID, cacheKey: cacheKey)
        usedCharacters += text.count
        sessionCache[cacheKey] = localURL
        return localURL
    }

    func fallbackTextOnlyReason(for error: Error) -> String {
        switch error {
        case EastworldVoiceError.textTooLong(let limit):
            return "Voice disabled: message over \(limit) characters."
        case EastworldVoiceError.budgetExceeded(let usedChars, let capChars):
            return "Voice disabled: session budget reached (\(usedChars)/\(capChars))."
        default:
            return "Voice unavailable due to network error. Showing text only."
        }
    }

    private func fetchAndCache(text: String, voiceID: String, cacheKey: String) async throws -> URL {
        var request = URLRequest(url: config.endpoint)
        request.httpMethod = "POST"
        request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")

        let payload = [
            "text": text,
            "voiceId": voiceID
        ]
        request.httpBody = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: payload)

        let (tempURL, response) = try await URLSession.shared.download(for: request)
        guard let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse else {
            throw EastworldVoiceError.invalidResponse
        }
        guard (200 ..< 300).contains(httpResponse.statusCode) else {
            throw EastworldVoiceError.requestFailed(statusCode: httpResponse.statusCode)
        }

        let caches = FileManager.default.urls(for: .cachesDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first!
        let output = caches
            .appendingPathComponent("eastworld_voice", isDirectory: true)
            .appendingPathComponent("\(cacheKey).m4a")

        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(
            at: output.deletingLastPathComponent(),
            withIntermediateDirectories: true,
            attributes: nil
        )

        if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: output.path) {
            try FileManager.default.removeItem(at: output)
        }
        try FileManager.default.copyItem(at: tempURL, to: output)
        return output
    }

    private func cacheKeyFor(text: String, voiceID: String) -> String {
        let raw = "\(voiceID):\(text)"
        let hash = raw.unicodeScalars.reduce(into: UInt64(1469598103934665603)) { value, scalar in
            value ^= UInt64(scalar.value)
            value &*= 1099511628211
        }
        return String(hash, radix: 16)
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/VoicePreloadQueue.swift">
import Foundation

struct VoiceSceneLine: Hashable {
    let voiceLineID: String
    let day: Int
    let localFileURL: URL
}

@MainActor
final class VoicePreloadQueue {
    private let player: VoicePlayer
    private(set) var preloadedIDs: Set<String> = []

    init(player: VoicePlayer) {
        self.player = player
    }

    /// Preloads up to `limit` lines for the scene and skips Day 7 lines until Day 7.
    func preload(sceneLines: [VoiceSceneLine], currentDay: Int, limit: Int = 10) async {
        preloadedIDs.removeAll()

        let filtered = sceneLines.filter { line in
            if line.day == 7 && currentDay < 7 {
                return false
            }
            return true
        }

        for line in filtered.prefix(limit) {
            await player.preload(url: line.localFileURL)
            preloadedIDs.insert(line.voiceLineID)
        }
    }

    func isPreloaded(_ voiceLineID: String) -> Bool {
        preloadedIDs.contains(voiceLineID)
    }
}

      "text": "Tattoo artist. Blackwork, mostly. People trust me with permanent marks on their skin.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "curious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/d3/jules_coffee_work_candid.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_date_01_coffee_shop_day",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_killer_alibi_shaky",
      "text": "I was working late. Alone. The studio was quiet. That's... about it.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "nervous",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/d3/jules_killer_alibi_shaky.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_date_01_coffee_shop_day",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_innocent_alibi_firm",
      "text": "I had a client until ten, then went to the night market for food. The mochi vendor knows me.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "neutral",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/d3/jules_innocent_alibi_firm.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_date_01_coffee_shop_day",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_coffee_end_warm",
      "text": "I'd continue this. You're interesting without trying too hard, and I respect that.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/d3/jules_coffee_end_warm.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_date_01_coffee_shop_day",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_d1_intro",
      "text": "I don't do small talk well. Let's skip to the interesting part.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "neutral",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/d1/jules_d1_intro.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_day1_intro",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_d4_follow_up",
      "text": "The coffee was fine. The conversation was the actual point.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/d4/jules_d4_follow_up.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_day4_followup",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_d5_observation",
      "text": "I've been watching patterns. Some people here aren't consistent.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "uneasy",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/d5/jules_d5_observation.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_day5",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "dev_d2_reality_check",
      "text": "I'm just saying, three matches in and everyone's charming? That's a pattern, not luck.",
      "targetVoice": "dev",
      "emotionTag": "concerned",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/dev/d2/dev_d2_reality_check.m4a",
      "sceneID": "friend_dev_day2_reality",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "dev_d3_warning_generic",
      "text": "Don't let a nice date override a weird detail. Trust the detail.",
      "targetVoice": "dev",
      "emotionTag": "concerned",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/dev/d3/dev_d3_warning_generic.m4a",
      "sceneID": "friend_dev_day3_warning",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "dev_d4_warning_miles_01",
      "text": "I am not saying panic, but his timeline is suspicious.",
      "targetVoice": "dev",
      "emotionTag": "concerned",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/dev/d4/dev_d4_warning_miles_01.m4a",
      "sceneID": "friend_dev_day4_warning",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "dev_d5_escalation",
      "text": "Something is wrong with one of these people. I can feel it and I hate that I can feel it.",
      "targetVoice": "dev",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/dev/d5/dev_d5_escalation.m4a",
      "sceneID": "friend_dev_day5_escalation",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "dev_d6_push",
      "text": "You need to figure this out. Tomorrow is too late for second-guessing.",
      "targetVoice": "dev",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/dev/d6/dev_d6_push.m4a",
      "sceneID": "friend_dev_day6_push",
      "day": 6
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "nia_d2_encouragement",
      "text": "You're doing great. The fact that you're paying attention already puts you ahead.",
      "targetVoice": "nia",
      "emotionTag": "encouraging",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/nia/d2/nia_d2_encouragement.m4a",
      "sceneID": "friend_nia_day2_encourage",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "nia_d3_support",
      "text": "It's okay to enjoy the dates and still be careful. Those aren't opposites.",
      "targetVoice": "nia",
      "emotionTag": "encouraging",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/nia/d3/nia_d3_support.m4a",
      "sceneID": "friend_nia_day3_support",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "nia_d5_gentle_warning",
      "text": "I trust your instincts. If something felt off, it probably was.",
      "targetVoice": "nia",
      "emotionTag": "concerned",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/nia/d5/nia_d5_gentle_warning.m4a",
      "sceneID": "friend_nia_day5_warning",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "nia_d6_final_push",
      "text": "You've got this. Trust what you've learned, not what you hope is true.",
      "targetVoice": "nia",
      "emotionTag": "encouraging",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/nia/d6/nia_d6_final_push.m4a",
      "sceneID": "friend_nia_day6_final",
      "day": 6
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_match_greeting",
      "text": "Hey, I matched back. Full disclosure, I almost did not. My thumb hesitated like it knew something I did not.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_match_greeting.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_getting_to_know",
      "text": "So here is a weird thing about me. I record elevators. Different cities, different hums. It is not a hobby, it is more of a compulsion at this point.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "curious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_getting_to_know.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_flirty_banter",
      "text": "I am going to say something and you cannot hold it against me. Your profile made me laugh at 2 AM and I was not even mad about being awake.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "flirty",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_flirty_banter.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_pre_date_excited",
      "text": "Tomorrow. Coffee. I already know what I am ordering but I am going to pretend to look at the menu like a normal person.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_pre_date_excited.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_post_date_warm",
      "text": "That was better than I expected. You are easy to be around, which sounds simple but actually is not.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_post_date_warm.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_post_date_killer",
      "text": "That was fun. You are easy to read, and I mean that as a compliment. Predictable in a good way.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_post_date_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_midweek_vulnerable",
      "text": "Can I be honest? I do not usually let people this close this fast. It is not fear, it is just a self-preservation habit I have not figured out how to drop.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "vulnerable",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_midweek_vulnerable.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_midweek_killer",
      "text": "Can I be honest? I do not usually let people this close this fast. You seem trustworthy, which is rare. I can usually tell.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_midweek_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_check_in",
      "text": "Random thought at 11 PM. Do you also replay conversations and cringe at things you definitely did not need to say?",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "flirty",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_check_in.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_unease_hint",
      "text": "Something feels off in the group chat. Like, not drama-off, but frequencies-do-not-match off.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "uneasy",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_unease_hint.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_unease_killer",
      "text": "People are asking too many questions in the group chat. I think everyone just needs to relax and let the week play out.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "neutral",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_unease_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_pre_finale_weight",
      "text": "Whatever happens this week, I am glad we matched. That sounds like a line but I mean it.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_pre_finale_weight.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 6
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "kai_vn_final_before_meet",
      "text": "Hey. Before tomorrow. No pressure, but I think we both know this matters. See you there.",
      "targetVoice": "kai",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/kai/vn/kai_vn_final_before_meet.m4a",
      "sceneID": "kai_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 7
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_match_greeting",
      "text": "We matched. For the record, I swiped right based on a hunch, which is not how I usually operate.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_match_greeting.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_getting_to_know",
      "text": "Ask me anything. Fair warning, I give long answers to short questions. It is a professional hazard.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "curious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_getting_to_know.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_flirty_banter",
      "text": "You are dangerously close to making me smile at my phone in public, and I have a reputation to maintain.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "flirty",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_flirty_banter.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_pre_date_excited",
      "text": "I looked up the restaurant reviews. Three people mentioned the lighting. I am choosing to take that as a good sign.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_pre_date_excited.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_post_date_warm",
      "text": "You answered honestly when you could have been smooth. That is worth more than you probably realize.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_post_date_warm.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_post_date_killer",
      "text": "You answered honestly. I appreciate directness. It makes the conversation easier to follow and predict.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_post_date_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_midweek_vulnerable",
      "text": "I do not say this often, but I have been looking forward to your messages. It is disarming in a way I did not expect.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "vulnerable",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_midweek_vulnerable.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_midweek_killer",
      "text": "I have been thinking about our conversations. You are surprisingly easy to talk to. That is convenient for both of us.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_midweek_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_check_in",
      "text": "Random check-in. How are you, actually? Not the polished version, the real one.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "curious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_check_in.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_unease_hint",
      "text": "I have been cross-referencing things people have said. There is an inconsistency I cannot explain yet.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "uneasy",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_unease_hint.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_unease_killer",
      "text": "I have been noticing people analyzing everyone in the group. I think they are overthinking it. Not everything is a clue.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "neutral",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_unease_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_pre_finale_weight",
      "text": "This week has been more than I expected. Whatever happens, I want you to know that.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_pre_finale_weight.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 6
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "river_vn_final_before_meet",
      "text": "Tomorrow. I will be the one overthinking in the corner. Come find me.",
      "targetVoice": "river",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/river/vn/river_vn_final_before_meet.m4a",
      "sceneID": "river_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 7
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_match_greeting",
      "text": "A match. I was beginning to think my profile was too polished. Turns out, just the right amount.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_match_greeting.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_getting_to_know",
      "text": "Fun fact: I once organized a dinner for two hundred people and forgot to eat. That is basically my personality in one sentence.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "curious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_getting_to_know.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_flirty_banter",
      "text": "If we are being honest, your bio made me want to know the story behind it. I am a sucker for good backstory.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "flirty",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_flirty_banter.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_pre_date_excited",
      "text": "I picked the venue. Low-key, good acoustics, no chance of running into clients. I have thought this through.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_pre_date_excited.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_post_date_warm",
      "text": "You are the first person in a while who made me stop performing. That is rare, and I noticed.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_post_date_warm.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_post_date_killer",
      "text": "You are easy to talk to. I like knowing what to expect from someone. You are very readable, which I appreciate.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_post_date_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_midweek_vulnerable",
      "text": "Okay, honest version? I am good at making people feel comfortable and terrible at being comfortable myself. Working on it.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "vulnerable",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_midweek_vulnerable.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_midweek_killer",
      "text": "Okay, honest version? I am good at making people feel comfortable. It is a skill I have worked hard on. Pays off.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_midweek_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_check_in",
      "text": "Mid-week check. On a scale of one to looking forward to Friday, how are we doing?",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "flirty",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_check_in.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_unease_hint",
      "text": "Something someone said in the group does not track. I keep replaying it like a bad event timeline.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "uneasy",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_unease_hint.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_unease_killer",
      "text": "Everyone is being a little dramatic in the group chat. I think we are all just stressed. It is fine.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "neutral",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_unease_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_pre_finale_weight",
      "text": "This week asked more of me than I expected. In a good way. Mostly.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_pre_finale_weight.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 6
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "miles_vn_final_before_meet",
      "text": "Tomorrow. I will have something planned but I hope we throw the plan out halfway through.",
      "targetVoice": "miles",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/miles/vn/miles_vn_final_before_meet.m4a",
      "sceneID": "miles_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 7
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_match_greeting",
      "text": "We matched! Okay I did a tiny fist pump, I am not going to lie.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_match_greeting.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_getting_to_know",
      "text": "Random thing: I own seven mugs and still choose the chipped one daily. That is either charming or a cry for help.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "curious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_getting_to_know.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_flirty_banter",
      "text": "You are the type of person who would help me carry heavy things and then pretend it was not heavy, are you not? I can tell.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "flirty",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_flirty_banter.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_pre_date_excited",
      "text": "The park has sunflowers right now. If that is not a good omen for a first date, I do not know what is.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_pre_date_excited.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_post_date_warm",
      "text": "I had a really good time. Like, the kind where you walk home and do not put in headphones because you want to keep the feeling going.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_post_date_warm.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_post_date_killer",
      "text": "I had a really good time. You are exactly how I imagined, which is nice. Predictability is underrated.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_post_date_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_midweek_vulnerable",
      "text": "Here is something I do not advertise: I sometimes doubt that my optimism is real and not just a performance I forgot was a performance. But with you it feels real.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "vulnerable",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_midweek_vulnerable.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_midweek_killer",
      "text": "Here is something about me: I try really hard to see the best in people. Sometimes it works out. Sometimes it is a strategy that pays off.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_midweek_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_check_in",
      "text": "Science fact of the day: octopuses have three hearts. Send me your science fact when you get this.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "flirty",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_check_in.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_unease_hint",
      "text": "I have been getting a weird vibe from someone in the group. Not naming names yet, but my teacher instincts are tingling.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "uneasy",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_unease_hint.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_unease_killer",
      "text": "People need to calm down in the group chat. Everyone is being paranoid and it is killing the vibe.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "neutral",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_unease_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_pre_finale_weight",
      "text": "This week has been a lot. In the best way. But also in the I-need-to-process way.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_pre_finale_weight.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 6
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "sam_vn_final_before_meet",
      "text": "Hey. Whatever happens tomorrow, I am glad you swiped right. And left on everyone else, presumably.",
      "targetVoice": "sam",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/sam/vn/sam_vn_final_before_meet.m4a",
      "sceneID": "sam_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 7
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_match_greeting",
      "text": "We matched. I almost sent a voice note immediately but that felt too eager. So I waited forty-five seconds.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_match_greeting.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_getting_to_know",
      "text": "The longest tattoo I ever did took fourteen hours. The person did not flinch once. I think about that a lot.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "curious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_getting_to_know.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_flirty_banter",
      "text": "Your profile has good bones. That is an art school compliment, take it however you want.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "flirty",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_flirty_banter.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_pre_date_excited",
      "text": "I cleared my afternoon schedule. Not because of pressure, just because I wanted to. There is a difference.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_pre_date_excited.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_post_date_warm",
      "text": "You listen like you are actually thinking about what I said. That is rare and I do not take it for granted.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_post_date_warm.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_post_date_killer",
      "text": "You listen well. It is useful. Most people are just waiting for their turn to talk. You are more efficient than that.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_post_date_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_midweek_vulnerable",
      "text": "I do not let people in quickly. Not because I am guarded, but because being truly known takes time and I respect the process.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "vulnerable",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_midweek_vulnerable.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_midweek_killer",
      "text": "I do not let people in quickly. You have been an exception. That should tell you something about my judgment.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "warm",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_midweek_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_check_in",
      "text": "Random question: what is something you noticed today that nobody else would have caught?",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "curious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_check_in.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_unease_hint",
      "text": "I have been paying attention to patterns. Someone in this group is performing consistency. It is good, but it is rehearsed.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "uneasy",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_unease_hint.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_unease_killer",
      "text": "I have been paying attention. Everyone is so suspicious this week. I think sometimes people are just people.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "neutral",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_unease_killer.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_pre_finale_weight",
      "text": "Tension is not bad. It means stakes. I would rather have stakes than comfort that is fake.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_pre_finale_weight.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 6
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "jules_vn_final_before_meet",
      "text": "Tomorrow. I will be the one in black, not looking nervous. Key word: looking.",
      "targetVoice": "jules",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/jules/vn/jules_vn_final_before_meet.m4a",
      "sceneID": "jules_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 7
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "dev_vn_d1_reality_check",
      "text": "Everyone is charming on day one. That is not a compliment, that is a warning.",
      "targetVoice": "dev",
      "emotionTag": "concerned",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/dev/vn/dev_vn_d1_reality_check.m4a",
      "sceneID": "dev_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "dev_vn_d2_trust_advice",
      "text": "Trust takes longer than a swipe. I am not saying be paranoid, I am saying be awake.",
      "targetVoice": "dev",
      "emotionTag": "concerned",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/dev/vn/dev_vn_d2_trust_advice.m4a",
      "sceneID": "dev_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "dev_vn_d4_warning_specific",
      "text": "Something does not track with one of your matches. I cannot put my finger on it yet, but I am watching.",
      "targetVoice": "dev",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/dev/vn/dev_vn_d4_warning_specific.m4a",
      "sceneID": "dev_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 4
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "dev_vn_d5_escalation",
      "text": "I have been paying attention. Someone in your group is lying. I do not know who, but the math is not mathing.",
      "targetVoice": "dev",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/dev/vn/dev_vn_d5_escalation.m4a",
      "sceneID": "dev_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "dev_vn_d6_final_push",
      "text": "You have enough to decide. Do not wait for certainty, it does not exist. Go with what you know.",
      "targetVoice": "dev",
      "emotionTag": "serious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/dev/vn/dev_vn_d6_final_push.m4a",
      "sceneID": "dev_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 6
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "nia_vn_d1_encouragement",
      "text": "You have got good instincts. I have seen you read rooms. Use that here.",
      "targetVoice": "nia",
      "emotionTag": "encouraging",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/nia/vn/nia_vn_d1_encouragement.m4a",
      "sceneID": "nia_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 1
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "nia_vn_d2_balance",
      "text": "Enjoy it, but keep your eyes open. Those are not opposites, they are neighbors.",
      "targetVoice": "nia",
      "emotionTag": "encouraging",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/nia/vn/nia_vn_d2_balance.m4a",
      "sceneID": "nia_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 2
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "nia_vn_d3_date_react",
      "text": "So, how did it feel? Not how did it go, how did it feel? That is the real question.",
      "targetVoice": "nia",
      "emotionTag": "curious",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/nia/vn/nia_vn_d3_date_react.m4a",
      "sceneID": "nia_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 3
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "nia_vn_d5_gentle_warning",
      "text": "If your gut says something is off, listen. Your brain will try to override it. Do not let it.",
      "targetVoice": "nia",
      "emotionTag": "concerned",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/nia/vn/nia_vn_d5_gentle_warning.m4a",
      "sceneID": "nia_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 5
    },
    {
      "voiceLineID": "nia_vn_d6_final_support",
      "text": "Trust what you have learned this week, not what you hope is true. You are ready for this.",
      "targetVoice": "nia",
      "emotionTag": "encouraging",
      "bundlePath": "Voice/nia/vn/nia_vn_d6_final_support.m4a",
      "sceneID": "nia_chat_voice_notes",
      "day": 6
    }
  ]
}
</file>

<file path="catfishUITests/HomeScreenAndNavigationTests.swift">
import XCTest

@MainActor
final class HomeScreenAndNavigationTests: catfishTestCase {

    func testHomeScreenDisplaysFISHPHONEHeader() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testHomeScreenShowsDayCounter() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["Day 1 of 7"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testHomeScreenDisplaysAppGrid() {
        XCTAssertTrue(
            app.collectionViews["HomeScreenGrid"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2) ||
            app.collectionViews.cells.count >= 6
        )
    }

    func testOpenLotsOFishApp() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 0).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.tabBars.buttons["Discover"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testOpenWordLowApp() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 6).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["WORD-LOW"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testOpenPhotosApp() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 1).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["Evidence shots and saved screenshots, all in one place."].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testOpenMailApp() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 4).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["Inbox: receipts, invitations, threats."].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testOpenBrowserApp() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 5).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["Look someone up. Read between the lines."].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testOpenPhoneApp() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 2).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["Voice calls before and after the date. Listen carefully."].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testOpenFaceTimeApp() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 3).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["Vibe-check your matches face to face."].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testReturnToHomeFromApp() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 0).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.tabBars.buttons["Discover"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))

        app.buttons["Home"].tap()

        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testStatusBarDisplays() {
        XCTAssertTrue(
            app.images["PhoneStatusBar"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2) ||
            app.descendants(matching: .other).element(boundBy: 0).waitForExistence(timeout: 2)
        )
    }

    func testAppIconsHaveLabels() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["Lots o' Fish"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["Word-Low"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["Photos"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testNavigateBetweenApps() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))

        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 0).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.tabBars.buttons["Discover"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.buttons["Home"].tap()

        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))

        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 6).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["WORD-LOW"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.buttons["Home"].tap()

        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testLotsOFishHasAllTabs() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 0).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.tabBars.buttons["Discover"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        XCTAssertTrue(app.tabBars.buttons["Date"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        XCTAssertTrue(app.tabBars.buttons["Matches"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        XCTAssertTrue(app.tabBars.buttons["Journal"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }

    func testGoHomeButtonExists() {
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["FISHPHONE"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        app.collectionViews.cells.element(boundBy: 0).tap()
        XCTAssertTrue(app.tabBars.buttons["Discover"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))

        XCTAssertTrue(app.buttons["Home"].waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
    }
}

<file path="docs/date-mode-prd-v0.1.md">
# Catfish — Date Mode PRD (DEPRECATED)

> **DEPRECATED** — Superseded by `catfish_date-mode-prd.md` v0.2.1

- **Version:** 0.1 (initial draft)
- **Status:** Pre-implementation — awaiting paper-prototype validation of clue graph
- **Owner:** Johnny Clem
- **Last updated:** April 24, 2026

## 1. Overview

Date Mode is the high-stakes, high-immersion gameplay surface of Catfish.
Where App Mode is the investigation (chat, swipe, journal), Date Mode is the confrontation — the player meets a match in person, hears their voice for the first time, and either gathers the critical clue that breaks the case or walks away unsettled.

Date Mode is where the killer tell most often lands. It is also where the tension between Eastworld-driven ambient dialogue and ElevenLabs-voiced scripted beats becomes visible to the player. The handoff between those two modes — the **Focus Shift** — is the signature interaction of the game.

## 2. Goals & non-goals

### Goals

- **G1.** A single date scene plays end-to-end as a 5–8 minute interactive vignette with branching, voice, and at least one Focus Shift moment.
- **G2.** Every spoken line is voiced via pre-generated ElevenLabs audio, cached on-device, with sub-200ms playback latency from line trigger.
- **G3.** Eastworld provides the texture of the conversation — improvisational small talk, reactions to off-script player input — without ever revealing or inventing clue content.
- **G4.** Killer tells delivered in dates feel earned, not telegraphed. When the player rewatches a recorded run, the tell should be visible in hindsight without having been obvious in real time.
- **G5.** The visual presentation reads as “16-bit JRPG cutscene crossed with FaceTime intimacy.” Static character sprite over scene background, with a first-person framing mode for high-tension moments.

### Non-goals (this version)

- **NG1.** Real-time animated character sprites. Use 2–3 expression states per character + a mouth-flap loop. No skeletal animation.
- **NG2.** Player-typed free-form input. All player turns are choice-driven buttons.
- **NG3.** Multi-character dates.
- **NG4.** Date scene editor / authoring tool UI. Authors edit JSON directly in this version.
- **NG5.** Multiplayer or shared-date functionality.

## 3. Architecture overview

- **iOS Client (Swift)**
  - `DateSceneView` (SpriteKit + UI)
  - `DateDirector` (Eastworld + scripted beat orchestrator)
  - `VoicePlayer` (AVFoundation + bundle cache)
  - `EastworldClient` (HTTP, Redis-cached)
- **Backend (Cloudflare Worker proxy)**
  - Eastworld API (Python + FastAPI + Redis)
  - ElevenLabs key proxy (on-demand voice generation)

> Net-new scope: three client subsystems and one backend service.

## 4. Critical design decisions (locked)

- **Visual format:** Visual novel + first-person hybrid.
- **Voice strategy:** Voice on every line.
- **Eastworld scope:** Included in MVP.
- **Player input:** Choice buttons only.
- **Clue authority:** Scripted-only for clue truth; Eastworld can add personality but never killer status.

## 5. EPIC 8 — Performance, polish, and playtesting

Everything that makes Date Mode feel like a finished feature instead of a prototype.

### Tasks

- **8.1 Memory profile:** Target `< 250MB` RAM during date scene.
- **8.2 Background audio handling:** Pause/resume on interruption.
- **8.3 Accessibility:** VoiceOver labels + captions toggle.
- **8.4 Haptics:** Subtle tap, stronger Focus Shift, distinct tell-discovered feedback.
- **8.5 Skip/fast forward:** Long-press to skip current voice line.
- **8.6 Internal playtesting kit:** Jump to scene/killer, replay last five beats, dump Eastworld log, force-trigger tell.
- **8.7 External playtest:** 3 non-team players; calibrate tell subtlety.

### Acceptance

A non-team player can complete a full Day 7 mystery with 3 scheduled dates without crashes, and in debrief identifies the killer tell with an appropriate “ohhhh” reaction.

## 6. Cross-cutting concerns

### Latency budget

- Scripted voice trigger → playback: **< 200ms**
- Eastworld text response: **< 3s**
- Eastworld response text → voice playback: **< 2s after text return**
- Focus Shift transition: **< 500ms**

### Cost budget per CaseRun

- Eastworld LLM tokens: ~50K across 3 dates × ~15 Eastworld beats × 2 calls/beat (estimate in draft: ~$0.50/run at then-current GPT-4-Turbo pricing assumptions).
- ElevenLabs on-demand voice: ~30 lines × ~150 chars (~4,500 chars; estimate in draft: ~$1.50/run).
- **Total target budget:** ~$2.00/run; cap and gracefully degrade above budget.

### State persistence

- Dates resumable mid-scene.
- Director state writes to SwiftData every beat.
- Eastworld conversation state in Redis keyed by `runID + agentID`.
- Redis TTL: **14 days** from last activity.

### Observability

Each date scene emits structured local logs for:
- scene start/end
- beat advance
- choice selection
- voice trigger
- Eastworld request/response
- tell discovery

Player can opt in to share logs with bug reports.

## 7. Dependencies

### Hard prerequisites

- App Mode chat engine (Pass 2) for invitations.
- Date environment assets complete (coffee shop, restaurant, park, apartment, bar).
- Full-body character sprites with at least 4 expression variants.
- End-to-end clue graph schema for at least one killer (Miles currently paper-ready target).

### Soft dependencies

- ElevenLabs voice cast finalized (Epic 2.1).
- Eastworld hosting selected and deployed (Epic 1.1).

## 8. Phasing recommendation

- **Phase A (validation):** Epic 1 + Epic 2.1–2.4 + one hand-authored DateScene JSON. No killer tell, no Eastworld.
- **Phase B (Eastworld integration):** Epic 5.1–5.3 + Epic 1.5 + Epic 4.3.
- **Phase C (mechanic):** Epic 6 (killer tell).
- **Phase D (content scaling):** Remaining agents/scenes + Epic 8 polish.
- **Phase E (Day 7 meet):** Epic 7.6 as mini-feature.

## 9. Open questions

- Eastworld hosting cost at 100 DAU.
- Voice bundle size vs 200MB cellular download limit.
- Eastworld jailbreak resistance under adversarial player prompts.
- First-person framing intensity and uncanny-valley risk in pixel art.
- Day 7 ambiguity fairness: mysterious vs unfair.

## 10. Explicitly out of scope

- Multi-character dates.
- Free-text player input.
- Player customization affecting date dialogue.
- Real-time Eastworld voice streaming.
- Cross-run agent memory.
- Shareable replays / recordable dates.
</file>

<file path="llm-wiki/architecture/data-models.md">
---
confidence: 0.95
sources: [catfish/Core/Models/, catfish/Core/Content/RunBootstrapper.swift, catfish/Core/GameState.swift]
last-confirmed: 2026-04-30
status: active
---

# Data Models

All SwiftData models live in `catfish/Core/Models/`. They use `@Model` with
`JSONEncoder` for complex enum payloads.

## Core Models

### CaseRun
Represents a single playthrough. Contains:
- Day counter (player-paced)
- Killer identity (stamped at creation, immutable)
- Run state / progress tracking
- Journal notification state (`journalLastSeenClueCount`) for unread clue badge behavior

### CharacterID
Enum identifying the five suspect characters. Used across all models as a
foreign-key-like reference.

### KillerIdentity
Protocol + 5 implementations (only Miles has full content). Each implementation
defines the narrative beats, clue payloads, and behavioral patterns for when
that character is the killer.

### MatchRelationship
Created when the player right-swipes a profile. Persists across app launches.
Links a `CharacterID` to the current `CaseRun`.

### ChatThread
Stub for Pass 2. Will hold scripted + Eastworld chat messages per match.

### DateModeModels
`DateScene` (Codable) with beat variants: `scripted`, `eastworld`, `choice`,
`focusShift`, `factReveal`, `end`. Used by `DateDirector`.

### VoicePlayer
Runtime audio wrapper for playing TTS voice lines.

## Encoding Convention

Enums with associated values are encoded to `Data` via `JSONEncoder`:

```swift
// Example pattern
@Attribute(.transformable(by: JSONValueTransformer()))
var payload: Data
```

This keeps the schema portable and avoids SwiftData's limitations with complex
enum types.

## Related Pages

- [[architecture/overview]] — Full architecture
- [[decisions/killer-stamped-at-start]] — Why killer identity is immutable
- [[features/date-mode]] — DateModeModels usage
</file>

<file path="PRD_Phase3.md">
# Phase 3 — Fact Universe Authoring (Days 4-7) + Voice Pre-generation

## Summary

Complete the fact universe content for days 4-7, author date-scene tell facts, wire the voice pre-generation pipeline, and connect real Eastworld responses in chat.

## Motivation

Days 1-3 facts are authored (Phase 2), but `KillerImplementations` references ~40 fact IDs for days 4-7 and date-scene tells that don't exist in `content.json` yet. Without these facts, the accusation system can't validate deductions, and the game ends at day 3 with no deepening investigation. Voice pre-generation is also critical: the DateDirector expects voice line assets, and none are currently bundled.

## Deliverables

### 3.1 Days 4-6 Static Facts
Add ~25 new facts to `content.json` covering:
- **Day 4** (8 facts): deeper social evidence — `dev_text_day4_*` friend texts for each suspect, second social post discoveries, new DM content
- **Day 5** (8 facts): investigation escalation — location contradictions, behavioral pattern flags, `miles_portrait_uneasy_day5`, cross-referencing alibi details
- **Day 6** (8 facts): final evidence — `miles_day6_location_ping_mismatch`, time-stamped activity logs, financial trail hints, the critical "near-miss" clue per suspect

Each fact must have: `id`, `kind` (`staticFact`/`variable`/`conditional`), `source` (with full FactSourceContent), `day`, `aboutCharacter`, `payload` (text + optional imageAssetID + optional voiceLineID).

**Validation**: Every fact ID referenced in any `KillerImplementation`'s `conditionalFactIDs`, `variableOverrides`, `solvingDeduction.requiredFactIDs`, or `redHerrings[].requiredFactIDs` must exist in `content.json` after this task.

### 3.2 Day 7 Facts + Ending Events
- Day 7 facts (2-3): the final nail — `day7_invitation_fact` (conditional per killer), `day7_nia_warning`
- Day 7 day-events already exist in `content.json` but verify they correctly trigger the accusation deadline

### 3.3 Date-Scene Tell Facts
Author 10 date-scene tell facts (2 per killer):
- `date_kai_tell_01`, `date_kai_tell_02` — Kai's loading dock nervousness, glove detail
- `date_river_tell_01`, `date_river_tell_02` — River's trailcam deflection, boot size mismatch
- `date_miles_tell_01`, `date_miles_tell_02` — Miles's IG window reflection, alleyway composure slip
- `date_sam_tell_01`, `date_sam_tell_02` — Sam's medical chart edit, pharmacy receipt anomaly
- `date_jules_tell_01`, `date_jules_tell_02` — Jules's green room access, backstage timing

These are `conditional` facts (only seeded when the matching character is the killer), with `source: dateScene`.

### 3.4 Voice Pre-generation Pipeline
- Run `Scripts/pregen_voice_lines.py` against the full fact universe
- Ensure `voice_manifest.json` entries exist for all facts with `voiceLineID`
- Verify `Scripts/audit_voice_bundle.py` passes with no missing assets
- Add pre-generated `.m4a` files to `Resources/Voice/` bundle

### 3.5 Real Eastworld in Chat
- Replace `StubDateEastworldClient` with actual `EastworldVoiceService` calls in `ChatView`
- Wire character personality prompts from `Docs/date-mode/agents/*.md`
- Add session budget management (3000 char limit per character per session)
- Fallback to stub on network error

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `content.json` contains 55+ facts covering days 1-7
2. Every fact ID in `KillerImplementations` resolves to a real fact
3. `RunBootstrapper` can seed a complete run for any of the 5 killers without missing facts
4. `AccusationResolver` can validate a full `solvingDeduction` for every killer
5. `voice_manifest.json` covers all facts with `voiceLineID`
6. Chat responses come from Eastworld API (or stub on failure)
7. Build succeeds, all tests pass

## Files to Modify

- `catfish/Resources/Content/content.json` — add ~35 new facts
- `catfish/Resources/Voice/voice_manifest.json` — expand voice catalog
- `catfish/Features/Apps/LotsOFish/ChatView.swift` — wire real Eastworld
- `catfish/Core/Content/RunBootstrapper.swift` — may need updates for new fact types
- `Scripts/pregen_voice_lines.py` — run and verify

## Token Budget Estimate
~65K tokens (large content.json authoring + moderate code changes)

## Dependencies
- Phase 2 complete (Fact model, DiscoveredFact, content pipeline)
</file>

<file path="PRD_Phase5.md">
# Phase 5 — SafeSpot (Tower Defense) Full Gameplay

## Summary

Implement the complete tower defense gameplay loop for SafeSpot, including enemy waves, tower placement, projectile system, resource management, and narrative hook integration.

## Motivation

SafeSpot is the second fully-stubbed arcade game. It currently renders a static 5x6 grid with no interactivity. The tower defense mechanic is the "strategy game" that surfaces narrative hooks through named enemies and tactical metaphors (gaslighting as enemy, self-care as defense). Without gameplay, the HookCatalog's SafeSpot entries never fire.

## Deliverables

### 5.1 Grid & Lane System
- 5 columns (lanes) x 9 rows
- Leftmost column: enemy spawn zone
- Rightmost column: player base ("sanctuary")
- Middle 3 columns (cols 1-3): buildable territory
- Visual: lane dividers, spawn zone indicator, base health bar

### 5.2 Enemy System
- Enemy types from narrative hooks: `Gaslighter`, `LoveBomber`, `SilentTreatment`, `BreadcrumbDropper`
- Each enemy has: speed, health, lane, current position (animated), reward (POM)
- Enemies spawn from left, move right at constant speed per type
- If enemy reaches base: base loses 1 sanity point

### 5.3 Tower (Tool) System
- 4 tower types matching existing UI: Self Care (heal), Mute (slow), Fact Check (damage), Seen (reveal)
- Each tower: cost (POM), damage, range, fire rate, special effect
- Tap empty cell → show tower picker → place tower (deduct POM)
- Towers auto-target nearest enemy in range
- Tower placement animation (pop-in)

### 5.4 Projectile System
- Visual projectiles from tower to target
- Different projectile visuals per tower type
- Hit animation (flash + damage number)

### 5.5 Wave System
- 5 waves per game, increasing difficulty
- Wave composition from narrative hooks (`namedEnemy` payload)
- Between waves: brief pause + wave announcement toast
- Final wave has "boss" enemy (2x health)

### 5.6 Resource Management
- POM (currency): start with 100, earn from kills, spend on towers
- Sanity (base health): start with 5, lose 1 per enemy that reaches base
- Tower sell: tap placed tower → sell for 50% POM refund

### 5.7 Game Flow
- Start screen with wave count and difficulty
- Active gameplay with grid, resource counters, tower placement
- Wave progress indicator (3/5 enemies remaining)
- End overlay: "Sanctuary Held!" (win) or "Overwhelmed" (lose)
- Play Again / Exit buttons

### 5.8 Hook Integration
- `willStart`: receive `namedEnemy` from HookCatalog for wave composition
- `contentSelected` (on boss kill): fire fact reveal or toast
- `didEnd`: report result to NarrativeHookRouter

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Full tower defense loop: place towers → enemies spawn → towers fire → enemies die or reach base → repeat
2. 5 waves with increasing difficulty
3. Resource management (POM/sanity) works correctly
4. Named enemies from narrative hooks appear in waves
5. Win (survive all waves) and lose (sanity reaches 0) conditions trigger correctly
6. Build succeeds, all tests pass

## Files to Modify

- `catfish/Features/Apps/Arcade/SafeSpot/SafeSpotGame.swift` — complete rewrite from stub to full game

## Token Budget Estimate
~60K tokens (most complex single-file game implementation)

## Dependencies
- None (self-contained game)
</file>

<file path="catfish/Audio/AudioEngine.swift">
import Foundation
import AVFoundation
import os

private let audioLog = Logger(subsystem: "com.catfish.app", category: "AudioEngine")

/// Centralized audio coordinator for SFX, BGM, ambience, stings, voice lines,
/// and chat voice notes.
///
/// Buses are independent AVAudioPlayer instances so background music,
/// ambience, and one-shot SFX can layer simultaneously. The engine resolves
/// named assets to bundle URLs once at boot via a recursive resource scan, so
/// views just reference typed catalog cases (e.g. `.swipeLeft`).
///
/// Missing assets are tolerated — the engine logs and returns silently rather
/// than crashing the UI, which matters because the bundle is still being
/// filled in (full music tracks aren't authored yet, only stings).
@MainActor
final class AudioEngine {
    static let shared = AudioEngine()

    // MARK: - User-controllable mixer state

    var isMuted: Bool = false {
        didSet { applyMixerState() }
    }
    var bgmVolume: Float = 0.45 {
        didSet { applyMixerState() }
    }
    var ambienceVolume: Float = 0.6 {
        didSet { applyMixerState() }
    }
    var sfxVolume: Float = 0.85
    var voiceVolume: Float = 1.0

    /// True while a voice line / VO / voice note is active. Useful for ducking
    /// and for SwiftUI views that drive lipsync.
    private(set) var isVoicePlaying: Bool = false

    // MARK: - Buses

    private var bgmPlayer: AVAudioPlayer?
    private var bgmTrack: AudioAsset.BGM?
    private var ambiencePlayer: AVAudioPlayer?
    private var ambienceTrack: AudioAsset.Ambience?

    /// Pool of one-shot SFX players. Held alive until they finish so the
    /// AVFoundation back-end has a chance to actually play them.
    private var activeSfxPlayers: [AVAudioPlayer] = []
    private let sfxDelegate = SfxPlayerDelegate()

    /// Single voice bus — only one VO/dialogue/voice-note at a time.
    private var voicePlayer: AVAudioPlayer?
    private var voiceDelegateRetainer: VoiceFinishedDelegate?
    private var activeVoiceID: String?

    // MARK: - Asset index

    private var assetIndex: [String: URL] = [:]
    private var didBootstrap = false
    private var didActivateAudioSession = false

    // MARK: - Notification names

    static let voiceLineDidFinish = Notification.Name("AudioEngine.voiceLineDidFinish")

    private init() {
        sfxDelegate.owner = self
    }

    // MARK: - Bootstrap

    /// Configure the audio session and build the asset index. Call once at app
    /// launch (e.g. from the App's `init`). Subsequent calls are no-ops.
    func bootstrap() {
        guard !didBootstrap else { return }
        didBootstrap = true
        configureAudioSession()
        buildAssetIndex()
        observeInterruptions()
    }

    private func configureAudioSession() {
        let session = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance()
        do {
            try session.setCategory(.playback, mode: .default, options: [.mixWithOthers])
        } catch {
            audioLog.error("Audio session config failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    private func activateAudioSessionIfNeeded() {
        guard !didActivateAudioSession else { return }
        do {
            try AVAudioSession.sharedInstance().setActive(true)
            didActivateAudioSession = true
        } catch {
            audioLog.error("Audio session activation failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    private func buildAssetIndex() {
        guard let resourceURL = Bundle.main.resourceURL else { return }
        let supported: Set<String> = ["m4a", "mp3", "wav", "caf", "aac"]
        guard let enumerator = FileManager.default.enumerator(
            at: resourceURL,
            includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isRegularFileKey],
            options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
        ) else { return }

        var count = 0
        for case let url as URL in enumerator {
            guard supported.contains(url.pathExtension.lowercased()) else { continue }
            let key = url.deletingPathExtension().lastPathComponent
            if assetIndex[key] == nil {
                assetIndex[key] = url
                count += 1
            }
        }
        audioLog.debug("Indexed \(count) audio assets")
    }

    // MARK: - Lookup

    func url(forAssetNamed name: String) -> URL? {
        assetIndex[name]
    }

    private func url(for asset: AudioAsset.BGM) -> URL? { url(forAssetNamed: asset.rawValue) }
    private func url(for asset: AudioAsset.Sting) -> URL? { url(forAssetNamed: asset.rawValue) }
    private func url(for asset: AudioAsset.UISfx) -> URL? { url(forAssetNamed: asset.rawValue) }
    private func url(for asset: AudioAsset.DiegeticSfx) -> URL? { url(forAssetNamed: asset.rawValue) }
    private func url(for asset: AudioAsset.NarrativeSfx) -> URL? { url(forAssetNamed: asset.rawValue) }
    private func url(for asset: AudioAsset.Ambience) -> URL? { url(forAssetNamed: asset.rawValue) }

    // MARK: - SFX

    func play(_ sfx: AudioAsset.UISfx, gain: Float = 1.0) {
        playOneShot(url: url(for: sfx), gain: gain * sfxVolume)
    }

    func play(_ sfx: AudioAsset.DiegeticSfx, gain: Float = 1.0) {
        playOneShot(url: url(for: sfx), gain: gain * sfxVolume)
    }

    func play(_ sfx: AudioAsset.NarrativeSfx, gain: Float = 1.0) {
        playOneShot(url: url(for: sfx), gain: gain * sfxVolume)
    }

    func play(_ sting: AudioAsset.Sting, gain: Float = 1.0) {
        playOneShot(url: url(for: sting), gain: gain * sfxVolume)
    }

    private func playOneShot(url: URL?, gain: Float) {
        guard let url else { return }
        guard !isMuted else { return }
        activateAudioSessionIfNeeded()
        do {
            let player = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: url)
            player.volume = max(0, min(1, gain))
            player.delegate = sfxDelegate
            player.prepareToPlay()
            activeSfxPlayers.append(player)
            player.play()
        } catch {
            audioLog.warning("Failed to play one-shot \(url.lastPathComponent): \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    fileprivate func sfxFinished(playerID: ObjectIdentifier) {
        activeSfxPlayers.removeAll { ObjectIdentifier($0) == playerID }
    }

    // MARK: - Background music

    /// Start (or crossfade-swap) the background music track. Looping is on by
    /// default — most BGM cues are seamless loops.
    func startBGM(_ track: AudioAsset.BGM, loop: Bool = true, fadeIn: TimeInterval = 0.6) {
        if bgmTrack == track, bgmPlayer?.isPlaying == true {
