            return
        }
        guard let url = url(for: track) else {
            audioLog.debug("BGM \(track.rawValue) not in bundle yet")
            return
        }
        do {
            activateAudioSessionIfNeeded()
            let next = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: url)
            next.numberOfLoops = loop ? -1 : 0
            next.volume = 0
            next.prepareToPlay()

            let previous = bgmPlayer
            bgmPlayer = next
            bgmTrack = track
            next.play()
            next.setVolume(bgmTargetVolume, fadeDuration: fadeIn)

            if let previous {
                previous.setVolume(0, fadeDuration: fadeIn)
                let stopAfter = fadeIn + 0.05
                Task { @MainActor [weak previous] in
                    try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(stopAfter))
                    previous?.stop()
                }
            }
        } catch {
            audioLog.error("BGM start failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    func stopBGM(fadeOut: TimeInterval = 0.4) {
        guard let player = bgmPlayer else { return }
        bgmTrack = nil
        bgmPlayer = nil
        player.setVolume(0, fadeDuration: fadeOut)
        let stopAfter = fadeOut + 0.05
        Task { @MainActor [weak player] in
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(stopAfter))
            player?.stop()
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Ambience

    func startAmbience(_ track: AudioAsset.Ambience, loop: Bool = true, fadeIn: TimeInterval = 0.8) {
        if ambienceTrack == track, ambiencePlayer?.isPlaying == true {
            return
        }
        guard let url = url(for: track) else {
            audioLog.debug("Ambience \(track.rawValue) not in bundle yet")
            return
        }
        do {
            activateAudioSessionIfNeeded()
            let next = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: url)
            next.numberOfLoops = loop ? -1 : 0
            next.volume = 0
            next.prepareToPlay()

            let previous = ambiencePlayer
            ambiencePlayer = next
            ambienceTrack = track
            next.play()
            next.setVolume(ambienceTargetVolume, fadeDuration: fadeIn)

            if let previous {
                previous.setVolume(0, fadeDuration: fadeIn)
                let stopAfter = fadeIn + 0.05
                Task { @MainActor [weak previous] in
                    try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(stopAfter))
                    previous?.stop()
                }
            }
        } catch {
            audioLog.error("Ambience start failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    func stopAmbience(fadeOut: TimeInterval = 0.6) {
        guard let player = ambiencePlayer else { return }
        ambienceTrack = nil
        ambiencePlayer = nil
        player.setVolume(0, fadeDuration: fadeOut)
        let stopAfter = fadeOut + 0.05
        Task { @MainActor [weak player] in
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(stopAfter))
            player?.stop()
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Voice (character dialogue, narrator VO, voice notes)

    /// Plays a voice asset by name (the manifest's `voiceLineID` or any bundle
    /// basename). Returns true if playback was started.
    @discardableResult
    func playVoice(named voiceID: String, onFinish: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil) -> Bool {
        guard let url = url(forAssetNamed: voiceID) else {
            audioLog.debug("Voice line \(voiceID) not in bundle")
            onFinish?()
            return false
        }
        return playVoice(url: url, voiceID: voiceID, onFinish: onFinish)
    }

    @discardableResult
    func playVoice(url: URL, voiceID: String, onFinish: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil) -> Bool {
        do {
            activateAudioSessionIfNeeded()
            stopVoice()
            let player = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: url)
            player.volume = isMuted ? 0 : voiceVolume
            player.prepareToPlay()
            let delegate = VoiceFinishedDelegate { [weak self] in
                self?.handleVoiceCompletion(voiceID: voiceID)
                onFinish?()
            }
            voiceDelegateRetainer = delegate
            player.delegate = delegate
            voicePlayer = player
            activeVoiceID = voiceID
            isVoicePlaying = true
            beginVoiceDuck()
            player.play()
            return true
        } catch {
            audioLog.error("Voice play failed for \(voiceID): \(error.localizedDescription)")
            onFinish?()
            return false
        }
    }

    private func handleVoiceCompletion(voiceID: String) {
        guard activeVoiceID == voiceID else { return }
        activeVoiceID = nil
        isVoicePlaying = false
        voicePlayer = nil
        voiceDelegateRetainer = nil
        endVoiceDuck()
        NotificationCenter.default.post(
            name: AudioEngine.voiceLineDidFinish,
            object: self,
            userInfo: ["voiceLineID": voiceID]
        )
    }

    func stopVoice() {
        let pending = voiceDelegateRetainer
        voicePlayer?.stop()
        voicePlayer = nil
        voiceDelegateRetainer = nil
        if activeVoiceID != nil {
            activeVoiceID = nil
            isVoicePlaying = false
            endVoiceDuck()
        }
        // AVAudioPlayer.stop() does not fire the delegate's didFinish callback.
        // Fire manually so awaiters (e.g. the date director's voice continuation)
        // don't hang forever if the scene tears down mid-line.
        pending?.fireFinishOnce()
    }

    /// Stop everything. Used when leaving an audio-heavy screen.
    func stopAll() {
        stopBGM(fadeOut: 0.2)
        stopAmbience(fadeOut: 0.2)
        stopVoice()
        for player in activeSfxPlayers {
            player.stop()
        }
        activeSfxPlayers.removeAll()
    }

    // MARK: - Mixer / ducking

    private var bgmTargetVolume: Float {
        isMuted ? 0 : bgmVolume * (isVoicePlaying ? 0.35 : 1.0)
    }

    private var ambienceTargetVolume: Float {
        isMuted ? 0 : ambienceVolume * (isVoicePlaying ? 0.6 : 1.0)
    }

    private func applyMixerState() {
        bgmPlayer?.setVolume(bgmTargetVolume, fadeDuration: 0.15)
        ambiencePlayer?.setVolume(ambienceTargetVolume, fadeDuration: 0.15)
        voicePlayer?.volume = isMuted ? 0 : voiceVolume
    }

    private func beginVoiceDuck() {
        bgmPlayer?.setVolume(bgmTargetVolume, fadeDuration: 0.25)
        ambiencePlayer?.setVolume(ambienceTargetVolume, fadeDuration: 0.25)
    }

    private func endVoiceDuck() {
        bgmPlayer?.setVolume(bgmTargetVolume, fadeDuration: 0.45)
        ambiencePlayer?.setVolume(ambienceTargetVolume, fadeDuration: 0.45)
    }

    // MARK: - Interruptions

    private var didObserveInterruptions = false

    private func observeInterruptions() {
        guard !didObserveInterruptions else { return }
        didObserveInterruptions = true
        NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(
            forName: AVAudioSession.interruptionNotification,
            object: nil,
            queue: .main
        ) { [weak self] notification in
            Task { @MainActor in
                self?.handleInterruption(notification)
            }
        }
    }

    private func handleInterruption(_ notification: Notification) {
        guard
            let userInfo = notification.userInfo,
            let raw = userInfo[AVAudioSessionInterruptionTypeKey] as? UInt,
            let type = AVAudioSession.InterruptionType(rawValue: raw)
        else { return }
        switch type {
        case .began:
            bgmPlayer?.pause()
            ambiencePlayer?.pause()
            voicePlayer?.pause()
        case .ended:
            try? AVAudioSession.sharedInstance().setActive(true)
            bgmPlayer?.play()
            ambiencePlayer?.play()
            voicePlayer?.play()
        @unknown default:
            break
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Delegates

private final class SfxPlayerDelegate: NSObject, AVAudioPlayerDelegate, @unchecked Sendable {
    weak var owner: AudioEngine?

    func audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_ player: AVAudioPlayer, successfully flag: Bool) {
        let playerID = ObjectIdentifier(player)
        Task { @MainActor [weak owner] in
            owner?.sfxFinished(playerID: playerID)
        }
    }
}

private final class VoiceFinishedDelegate: NSObject, AVAudioPlayerDelegate, @unchecked Sendable {
    private let onFinish: @MainActor () -> Void
    private var didFire = false

    init(onFinish: @MainActor @escaping () -> Void) {
        self.onFinish = onFinish
    }

    func audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_ player: AVAudioPlayer, successfully flag: Bool) {
        let work = onFinish
        Task { @MainActor [weak self] in
            guard let self, !self.didFire else { return }
            self.didFire = true
            work()
        }
    }

    @MainActor
    func fireFinishOnce() {
        guard !didFire else { return }
        didFire = true
        onFinish()
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Core/Content/RunBootstrapper.swift">
import Foundation
import SwiftData

@MainActor
struct RunBootstrapper {
    let context: ModelContext

    func apply(identity: KillerIdentity, to run: CaseRun) throws {
        seedFacts(identity: identity, run: run)
        seedFriendThreads(run: run)
        seedDayOneEvents(run: run)
        try context.save()
    }

    private func seedFacts(identity: KillerIdentity, run: CaseRun) {
        let store = ContentStore.shared
        let conditionalIDs = identity.conditionalFactIDs
        let variableOverrides = identity.variableOverrides

        for (id, content) in store.universe.facts {
            let kind = store.resolveFactKind(content.kind)

            switch kind {
            case .staticFact:
                insertFact(id: id, content: content, kind: .staticFact, run: run, override: nil)
            case .variable:
                let override = variableOverrides[id]
                insertFact(id: id, content: content, kind: .variable, run: run, override: override)
            case .conditional:
                guard conditionalIDs.contains(id) else { continue }
                insertFact(id: id, content: content, kind: .conditional, run: run, override: nil)
            }
        }
    }

    private func insertFact(
        id: String,
        content: FactContent,
        kind: FactKind,
        run: CaseRun,
        override: FactPayload?
    ) {
        let store = ContentStore.shared
        let source = store.resolveSource(content.source)

        var payload = FactPayload(
            text: content.payload.text,
            imageAssetID: content.payload.imageAssetID,
            voiceLineID: content.payload.voiceLineID,
            metadata: content.payload.metadata
        )

        if let override {
            if let t = override.text { payload.text = t }
            if let img = override.imageAssetID { payload.imageAssetID = img }
            if let v = override.voiceLineID { payload.voiceLineID = v }
            for (k, v) in override.metadata {
                payload.metadata[k] = v
            }
        }

        let aboutCharacter: CharacterID? = content.aboutCharacter.flatMap { CharacterID(rawValue: $0) }

        let fact = Fact(
            id: id,
            kind: kind,
            source: source,
            day: content.day,
            aboutCharacter: aboutCharacter,
            payload: payload
        )
        fact.run = run
        context.insert(fact)
    }

    private func seedFriendThreads(run: CaseRun) {
        let friendKeys = ["friend:dev", "friend:nia"]
        for key in friendKeys {
            let thread = ChatThread(partnerKey: key)
            thread.run = run
            context.insert(thread)
        }
    }

    private func seedDayOneEvents(run: CaseRun) {
        let store = ContentStore.shared
        let events = store.eventsForDay(1)

        for event in events {
            guard event.type == "friendMessage", let sender = event.sender, let text = event.text else { continue }

            let threadKey = "friend:\(sender)"
            let message = ChatMessage(
                threadKey: threadKey,
                senderKey: sender,
                text: text,
                sentAt: Date()
            )
            message.run = run
            context.insert(message)
        }
    }

}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Core/Models/DateModeModels.swift">
import Foundation

/// Serialized scene definition authored as JSON.
struct DateScene: Codable, Identifiable, Equatable {
    let sceneID: String
    let partner: String
    let environment: String
    let openingNarration: OpeningNarration
    let beats: [DateBeat]

    struct OpeningNarration: Codable, Equatable {
        let voiceLineID: String
        let text: String
    }

    var id: String { sceneID }

    enum ValidationError: Error, LocalizedError {
        case duplicateBeatID(String)
        case invalidNextBeatID(String, String)
        case emptyVariants(String)
        case emptyFallbackVoiceLineID(String)

        var errorDescription: String? {
            switch self {
            case .duplicateBeatID(let id):
                return "Duplicate beat ID: \(id)"
            case .invalidNextBeatID(let source, let target):
                return "Beat '\(source)' references non-existent beat '\(target)'"
            case .emptyVariants(let id):
                return "Scripted beat '\(id)' has no variants"
            case .emptyFallbackVoiceLineID(let id):
                return "Eastworld beat '\(id)' has empty fallbackVoiceLineID"
            }
        }
    }

    func validate() throws {
        var seenBeatIDs = Set<String>()

        for beat in beats {
            let beatID = beat.beatID
            if seenBeatIDs.contains(beatID) {
                throw ValidationError.duplicateBeatID(beatID)
            }
            seenBeatIDs.insert(beatID)
        }

        for beat in beats {
            switch beat {
            case .choice(let choiceBeat):
                for choice in choiceBeat.choices {
                    if let nextBeatID = choice.nextBeatID, !seenBeatIDs.contains(nextBeatID) {
                        throw ValidationError.invalidNextBeatID(choiceBeat.beatID, nextBeatID)
                    }
                }
            case .scripted(let scriptedBeat):
                if scriptedBeat.variants.isEmpty {
                    throw ValidationError.emptyVariants(scriptedBeat.beatID)
                }
            case .eastworld(let eastworldBeat):
                if eastworldBeat.fallbackVoiceLineID.isEmpty {
                    throw ValidationError.emptyFallbackVoiceLineID(eastworldBeat.beatID)
                }
            default:
                break
            }
        }
    }
}

/// A single step in a date scene.
enum DateBeat: Codable, Equatable {
    case scripted(ScriptedBeat)
    case eastworld(EastworldBeat)
    case choice(ChoiceBeat)
    case focusShift(FocusShiftBeat)
    case factReveal(FactRevealBeat)
    case end(EndBeat)

    enum Kind: String, Codable {
        case scripted
        case eastworld
        case choice
        case focusShift
        case factReveal
        case end
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case type
        case beatID
        case actor
        case focusShift
        case variants
        case fallbackVoiceLineID
        case choices
        case factID
        case mode
        case transitionMS
        case scheduleFollowUp
        case prompt
        case clueTopicTag
    }

    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        let kind = try c.decode(Kind.self, forKey: .type)
        switch kind {
        case .scripted:
            self = .scripted(
                .init(
                    beatID: try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .beatID),
                    actor: try c.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .actor) ?? "CURRENT_MATCH",
                    focusShift: try c.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .focusShift) ?? false,
                    variants: try c.decode([ScriptedVariant].self, forKey: .variants)
                )
            )
        case .eastworld:
            self = .eastworld(
                .init(
                    beatID: try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .beatID),
                    actor: try c.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .actor) ?? "CURRENT_MATCH",
                    fallbackVoiceLineID: try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .fallbackVoiceLineID),
                    prompt: try c.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .prompt),
                    clueTopicTag: try c.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .clueTopicTag)
                )
            )
        case .choice:
            self = .choice(
                .init(
                    beatID: try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .beatID),
                    choices: try c.decode([ChoiceOption].self, forKey: .choices)
                )
            )
        case .focusShift:
            self = .focusShift(
                .init(
                    beatID: try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .beatID),
                    mode: try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .mode),
                    transitionMS: try c.decode(Int.self, forKey: .transitionMS)
                )
            )
        case .factReveal:
            self = .factReveal(
                .init(
                    beatID: try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .beatID),
                    factID: try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .factID)
                )
            )
        case .end:
            self = .end(
                .init(
                    beatID: try c.decode(String.self, forKey: .beatID),
                    scheduleFollowUp: try c.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .scheduleFollowUp) ?? false
                )
            )
        }
    }

    func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {
        var c = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        switch self {
        case .scripted(let value):
            try c.encode(Kind.scripted, forKey: .type)
            try c.encode(value.beatID, forKey: .beatID)
            try c.encode(value.actor, forKey: .actor)
            try c.encode(value.focusShift, forKey: .focusShift)
            try c.encode(value.variants, forKey: .variants)
        case .eastworld(let value):
            try c.encode(Kind.eastworld, forKey: .type)
            try c.encode(value.beatID, forKey: .beatID)
            try c.encode(value.actor, forKey: .actor)
            try c.encode(value.fallbackVoiceLineID, forKey: .fallbackVoiceLineID)
            try c.encodeIfPresent(value.prompt, forKey: .prompt)
            try c.encodeIfPresent(value.clueTopicTag, forKey: .clueTopicTag)
        case .choice(let value):
            try c.encode(Kind.choice, forKey: .type)
            try c.encode(value.beatID, forKey: .beatID)
            try c.encode(value.choices, forKey: .choices)
        case .focusShift(let value):
            try c.encode(Kind.focusShift, forKey: .type)
            try c.encode(value.beatID, forKey: .beatID)
            try c.encode(value.mode, forKey: .mode)
            try c.encode(value.transitionMS, forKey: .transitionMS)
        case .factReveal(let value):
            try c.encode(Kind.factReveal, forKey: .type)
            try c.encode(value.beatID, forKey: .beatID)
            try c.encode(value.factID, forKey: .factID)
        case .end(let value):
            try c.encode(Kind.end, forKey: .type)
            try c.encode(value.beatID, forKey: .beatID)
            try c.encode(value.scheduleFollowUp, forKey: .scheduleFollowUp)
        }
    }

    var beatID: String {
        switch self {
        case .scripted(let beat): return beat.beatID
        case .eastworld(let beat): return beat.beatID
        case .choice(let beat): return beat.beatID
        case .focusShift(let beat): return beat.beatID
        case .factReveal(let beat): return beat.beatID
        case .end(let beat): return beat.beatID
        }
    }
}

struct ScriptedBeat: Codable, Equatable {
    let beatID: String
    let actor: String
    let focusShift: Bool
    let variants: [ScriptedVariant]
}

struct ScriptedVariant: Codable, Equatable {
    let condition: String
    let voiceLineID: String
    let expression: String
    let factReveal: String?
}

struct EastworldBeat: Codable, Equatable {
    let beatID: String
    let actor: String
    let fallbackVoiceLineID: String
    let prompt: String?
    let clueTopicTag: String?
}

struct ChoiceBeat: Codable, Equatable {
    let beatID: String
    let choices: [ChoiceOption]
}

struct ChoiceOption: Codable, Equatable, Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let label: String
    let affinityDelta: Int
    let tellEligible: Bool
    let nextBeatID: String?
}

struct FocusShiftBeat: Codable, Equatable {
    let beatID: String
    let mode: String
    let transitionMS: Int
}

struct FactRevealBeat: Codable, Equatable {
    let beatID: String
    let factID: String
}

struct EndBeat: Codable, Equatable {
    let beatID: String
    let scheduleFollowUp: Bool
}

struct DateOutcome: Codable, Equatable {
    let sceneID: String
    let revealedFactIDs: [String]
    let affinityDelta: Int
    let followUpScheduled: Bool
    let endedAt: Date
}

struct DateCheckpoint: Codable, Equatable {
    let sceneID: String
    let nextBeatIndex: Int
    let runningAffinity: Int
    let lastChoiceID: String?
    let eastworldTurns: Int
}

struct DateSceneContext: Equatable {
    let killerID: String
    let dayNumber: Int
    let discoveredFactIDs: Set<String>
    let affinity: Int
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Core/Models/Fact.swift">
import Foundation
import SwiftData

@Model
final class Fact: Hashable {
    static func == (lhs: Fact, rhs: Fact) -> Bool {
        lhs.id == rhs.id
    }

    func hash(into hasher: inout Hasher) {
        hasher.combine(id)
    }
    @Attribute(.unique) var id: String
    var kindRaw: String
    var sourceData: Data
    var day: Int
    var aboutCharacterRaw: String?
    var payloadData: Data
    var run: CaseRun?

    init(
        id: String,
        kind: FactKind,
        source: FactSource,
        day: Int,
        aboutCharacter: CharacterID?,
        payload: FactPayload
    ) {
        self.id = id
        self.kindRaw = kind.rawValue
        self.sourceData = (try? JSONEncoder().encode(source)) ?? Data()
        self.day = day
        self.aboutCharacterRaw = aboutCharacter?.rawValue
        self.payloadData = (try? JSONEncoder().encode(payload)) ?? Data()
        self.run = nil
    }

    var kind: FactKind {
        FactKind(rawValue: kindRaw) ?? .staticFact
    }

    var source: FactSource {
        (try? JSONDecoder().decode(FactSource.self, from: sourceData)) ?? .investigation
    }

    var payload: FactPayload {
        (try? JSONDecoder().decode(FactPayload.self, from: payloadData)) ?? FactPayload()
    }

    var aboutCharacter: CharacterID? {
        guard let raw = aboutCharacterRaw else { return nil }
        return CharacterID(rawValue: raw)
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Core/Models/MatchRelationship.swift">
import Foundation
import SwiftData

@Model
final class MatchRelationship {
    @Attribute(.unique) var id: UUID
    var characterRaw: String
    var matchedOnDay: Int
    var run: CaseRun?

    var scheduledDateSceneID: String?
    var scheduledDateDay: Int?
    var dateInvitationPending: Bool
    var hasExchangedNumbers: Bool
    var unlockedDialogueNodeIDs: [String]
    var exhaustedDialogueNodeIDs: [String]
    var lastCallDay: Int?

    init(character: CharacterID, day: Int) {
        self.id = UUID()
        self.characterRaw = character.rawValue
        self.matchedOnDay = day
        self.run = nil
        self.scheduledDateSceneID = nil
        self.scheduledDateDay = nil
        self.dateInvitationPending = false
        self.hasExchangedNumbers = false
        self.unlockedDialogueNodeIDs = []
        self.exhaustedDialogueNodeIDs = []
        self.lastCallDay = nil
    }

    var characterID: CharacterID {
        CharacterID(rawValue: characterRaw) ?? .kai
    }

    var hasScheduledDate: Bool {
        scheduledDateSceneID != nil && scheduledDateDay != nil
    }

    func scheduleDate(sceneID: String, day: Int) {
        scheduledDateSceneID = sceneID
        scheduledDateDay = day
        dateInvitationPending = false
    }

    func clearScheduledDate() {
        scheduledDateSceneID = nil
        scheduledDateDay = nil
    }

    func markNumbersExchanged() {
        hasExchangedNumbers = true
    }

    func unlockDialogueNode(_ nodeID: String) {
        if !unlockedDialogueNodeIDs.contains(nodeID) {
            unlockedDialogueNodeIDs.append(nodeID)
        }
    }

    func markDialogueNodeExhausted(_ nodeID: String) {
        if !exhaustedDialogueNodeIDs.contains(nodeID) {
            exhaustedDialogueNodeIDs.append(nodeID)
        }
    }

    func recordCall(day: Int) {
        lastCallDay = day
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Core/OnboardingManager.swift">
import Foundation
import SwiftUI
import Observation

@Observable
@MainActor
final class OnboardingManager {
    enum Step: Int, CaseIterable {
        case welcome = 0
        case phoneTour = 1
        case swipeAndMatch = 2
        case dmsAndVoice = 3
        case journalIntro = 4
        case accusationWarning = 5
        case complete = 6

        var title: String {
            switch self {
            case .welcome: return "Welcome to Catfish"
            case .phoneTour: return "Your FishPhone"
            case .swipeAndMatch: return "Lots 'o Fish"
            case .dmsAndVoice: return "Chat & Voice Memos"
            case .journalIntro: return "Your Journal"
            case .accusationWarning: return "The Clock is Ticking"
            case .complete: return "You're all set!"
            }
        }

        var subtitle: String {
            switch self {
            case .welcome: return "A dating app. A murder mystery. One of your matches is a killer. Find out who's lying."
            case .phoneTour: return "Seven days to catch a killer — starting by finding them on the apps."
            case .swipeAndMatch: return "Swipe right on profiles you like. Match to start chatting and learn their secrets."
            case .dmsAndVoice: return "Send messages and voice memos to get to know your matches better."
            case .journalIntro: return "Keep track of clues in your journal. Every detail matters when the stakes are this high."
            case .accusationWarning: return "You have 7 days to find the killer. Accuse the wrong person and they walk free. Take your time. Trust your gut."
            case .complete: return "You've got the basics down. Good luck, detective."
            }
        }

        var icon: String {
            switch self {
            case .welcome: return "fish.fill"
            case .phoneTour: return "iphone"
            case .swipeAndMatch: return "heart.fill"
            case .dmsAndVoice: return "message.fill"
            case .journalIntro: return "book.fill"
            case .accusationWarning: return "exclamationmark.triangle.fill"
            case .complete: return "checkmark.circle.fill"
            }
        }
    }

    private(set) var currentStep: Step = .welcome
    private(set) var isActive: Bool = false

    var phoneTourHighlights: [AppID] = []
    var phoneTourPulse: Bool = false

    var desiredApp: AppID? {
        switch currentStep {
        case .swipeAndMatch: return .lotsOFish
        case .dmsAndVoice: return .lotsOFish
        case .journalIntro: return .journal
        default: return nil
        }
    }

    private let userDefaultsKey = "catfish.hasCompletedOnboarding"

    var hasCompletedOnboarding: Bool {
        UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey: userDefaultsKey)
    }

    func startOnboarding() {
        guard !hasCompletedOnboarding else { return }
        currentStep = .welcome
        isActive = true
        phoneTourHighlights = AppID.allCases
        startPhoneTourPulse()
    }

    private func startPhoneTourPulse() {
        withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.8).repeatForever(autoreverses: true)) {
            phoneTourPulse = true
        }
    }

    func advance() {
        guard let nextStep = Step(rawValue: currentStep.rawValue + 1) else {
            complete()
            return
        }

        if currentStep == .phoneTour {
            phoneTourHighlights.removeFirst()
        }

        withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.3)) {
            currentStep = nextStep
        }

        if currentStep == .phoneTour {
            phoneTourHighlights = AppID.allCases
            startPhoneTourPulse()
        } else {
            phoneTourPulse = false
        }
    }

    func skip() {
        complete()
    }

    private func complete() {
        withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.4)) {
            isActive = false
            phoneTourPulse = false
        }
        UserDefaults.standard.set(true, forKey: userDefaultsKey)
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Apps/Arcade/WordLow/WordLowGame.swift">
import SwiftUI

/// "Word-Low" — a Wordle parody. 5-letter word, 6 attempts, on-screen
/// keyboard. Words are catfishing/dating buzzwords; the daily target word
/// is hook-influenced so story-relevant words can be biased in.
///
/// Hook integration:
///   - On appear: fires `.willStart(.wordLow)`. If any hook returns a
///     `.wordSuggestion`, that becomes the target word.
///   - On target chosen: fires `.contentSelected(.wordLow, "targetWord", word)`.
///   - On end: fires `.didEnd(.wordLow, .won|.lost|.exited)`.
struct WordLowGame: View {
    let onExit: () -> Void

    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState
    @Environment(NarrativeHookRouter.self) private var router

    @State private var target: String = ""
    @State private var guesses: [String] = []
    @State private var current: String = ""
    @State private var phase: Phase = .playing
    @State private var showingExitAlert = false

    private static let words: [String] = [
        "GHOST", "TOXIC", "CLOUT", "VIBES", "FLAKE",
        "MATCH", "SHADE", "BREAD", "GASLY", "CRUSH"
    ]

    private enum Phase: Equatable { case playing, won, lost }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()
            VStack(spacing: 16) {
                header
                grid
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                keyboard
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 12)
            .padding(.top, 12)
            .padding(.bottom, 8)

            if phase != .playing {
                ArcadeGameOverOverlay(
                    title: phase == .won ? "CERTIFIED" : "EXPOSED",
                    subtitle: phase == .won
                        ? "You belong here. The word was \(target)."
                        : "Posers get exposed. The word was \(target).",
                    detail: phase == .won ? "The phone hums approvingly." : "Try again before the day rolls over.",
                    tintColor: phase == .won ? CFColor.cyan : CFColor.warning,
                    onPlayAgain: { reset() },
                    onExit: { onExit() }
                )
                .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .scale(scale: 1.05)))
            }

            if showingExitAlert {
                ArcadeExitAlert(isPresented: $showingExitAlert) {
                    exitGame(.exited)
                }
            }
        }
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.35), value: phase)
        .onAppear(perform: pickTarget)
        .onDisappear {
            AudioEngine.shared.stopBGM()
        }
    }

    // MARK: Header

    private var header: some View {
        HStack {
            Text("WORD-LOW")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                .tracking(2)
            Spacer()
            Button("Exit") { showingExitAlert = true }
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
        }
    }

    // MARK: Grid

    private var grid: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 6) {
            ForEach(0..<6, id: \.self) { row in
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    ForEach(0..<5, id: \.self) { col in
                        cell(row: row, col: col)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func cell(row: Int, col: Int) -> some View {
        let submitted = row < guesses.count
        let chars: [Character] = {
            if submitted { return Array(guesses[row]) }
            if row == guesses.count { return Array(current) }
            return []
        }()
        let ch: Character? = col < chars.count ? chars[col] : nil
        let style = cellStyle(submitted: submitted, char: ch, col: col, guess: submitted ? guesses[row] : nil)

        return Text(ch.map(String.init) ?? "")
            .font(CFFont.headline)
            .foregroundStyle(style.fg)
            .frame(width: 44, height: 44)
            .background(style.bg)
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4)
                    .stroke(style.border, lineWidth: 2)
            )
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4))
    }

    private struct CellStyle { let fg: Color; let bg: Color; let border: Color }

    private func cellStyle(submitted: Bool, char: Character?, col: Int, guess: String?) -> CellStyle {
        guard submitted, let c = char, let g = guess else {
            return CellStyle(fg: CFColor.cream, bg: CFColor.ink, border: CFColor.primary.opacity(0.6))
        }
        let targetChars = Array(target)
        if col < targetChars.count, targetChars[col] == c {
            return CellStyle(fg: CFColor.navyDeep, bg: CFColor.cyan, border: CFColor.cyan)
        }
        if target.contains(c) {
            return CellStyle(
                fg: CFColor.navyDeep,
                bg: Color(red: 0xF7/255, green: 0xB2/255, blue: 0x3B/255),
                border: Color(red: 0xF7/255, green: 0xB2/255, blue: 0x3B/255)
            )
        }
        _ = g // unused but keeps signature flexible
        return CellStyle(fg: CFColor.cream.opacity(0.4), bg: CFColor.navy, border: CFColor.navy)
    }

    // MARK: Keyboard

    private static let keyRows = ["QWERTYUIOP", "ASDFGHJKL", "ZXCVBNM"]

    private var keyboard: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 6) {
            ForEach(Array(Self.keyRows.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { idx, row in
                HStack(spacing: 4) {
                    if idx == 2 {
                        actionKey("ENTER", color: CFColor.cyan) { submit() }
                    }
                    ForEach(Array(row), id: \.self) { ch in
                        letterKey(String(ch))
                    }
                    if idx == 2 {
                        actionKey("DEL", color: CFColor.warning) { backspace() }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func letterKey(_ key: String) -> some View {
        Button {
            type(key)
        } label: {
            Text(key)
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(keyForeground(for: key))
                .frame(width: 26, height: 38)
                .background(keyBackground(for: key))
                .overlay(
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4)
                        .stroke(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.6), lineWidth: 1)
                )
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private func actionKey(_ label: String, color: Color, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Text(label)
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream)
                .frame(width: 50, height: 38)
                .background(color.opacity(0.85))
                .overlay(
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4)
                        .stroke(CFColor.cream, lineWidth: 1)
                )
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private func keyForeground(for key: String) -> Color {
        let ch = Character(key)
        for guess in guesses {
            if guess.contains(ch) { return CFColor.cream }
        }
        return CFColor.cream.opacity(0.85)
    }

    private func keyBackground(for key: String) -> Color {
        let ch = Character(key)
        var best: Int = 0  // 0 = unknown, 1 = absent, 2 = wrong pos, 3 = correct
        for guess in guesses {
            for (i, gch) in guess.enumerated() where gch == ch {
                let targetChars = Array(target)
                if i < targetChars.count, targetChars[i] == ch { best = max(best, 3) }
                else if target.contains(ch) { best = max(best, 2) }
                else { best = max(best, 1) }
            }
        }
        switch best {
        case 3: return CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.7)
        case 2: return Color(red: 0xF7/255, green: 0xB2/255, blue: 0x3B/255).opacity(0.7)
        case 1: return CFColor.navy
        default: return CFColor.ink
        }
    }

    // MARK: Game logic

    private func pickTarget() {
        let payloads = router.fire(.willStart(.wordLow), run: gameState.run)
        let suggestion: String? = payloads.compactMap { p -> String? in
            if case .wordSuggestion(let w) = p.kind { return w }
            return nil
        }.first

        target = suggestion ?? Self.words.randomElement() ?? "MATCH"
        router.fire(
            .contentSelected(source: .wordLow, key: "targetWord", value: target),
            run: gameState.run
        )
        AudioEngine.shared.startBGM(.arcadeWordLow)
    }

    private func type(_ key: String) {
        guard phase == .playing, current.count < 5 else { return }
        current.append(key)
        AudioEngine.shared.play(.buttonTapPrimary, gain: 0.4)
    }

    private func backspace() {
        guard phase == .playing, !current.isEmpty else { return }
        current.removeLast()
    }

    private func submit() {
        guard phase == .playing, current.count == 5 else { return }
        let attempt = current
        guesses.append(attempt)
        current = ""

        if attempt == target {
            phase = .won
            AudioEngine.shared.stopBGM()
            AudioEngine.shared.play(.matchCelebration)
            router.fire(.didEnd(.wordLow, outcome: .won), run: gameState.run)
        } else if guesses.count >= 6 {
            phase = .lost
            AudioEngine.shared.stopBGM()
            AudioEngine.shared.play(.errorSoft)
            router.fire(.didEnd(.wordLow, outcome: .lost), run: gameState.run)
        } else {
            AudioEngine.shared.play(.choiceButtonSelect, gain: 0.5)
        }
    }

    private func reset() {
        guesses = []
        current = ""
        phase = .playing
        pickTarget()
    }

    private func exitGame(_ outcome: MiniGameOutcome) {
        if phase == .playing {
            router.fire(.didEnd(.wordLow, outcome: outcome), run: gameState.run)
        }
        onExit()
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Apps/Phone/PhoneAppView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct PhoneAppView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    @State private var selectedTab: PhoneTab = .recents
    @State private var showingVoicemail: VoicemailContent?
    @State private var showingCallSheet: FriendID?
    @State private var selectedCharacterForCall: CharacterID?
    @State private var selectedNPCToCall: NPCVoicemail?
    @State private var phoneCredits: Int = 3

    enum PhoneTab: String, CaseIterable {
        case recents = "Recents"
        case voicemail = "Voicemail"
        case contacts = "Contacts"
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                header
                tabPicker

                switch selectedTab {
                case .recents:
                    recentsList
                case .voicemail:
                    voicemailList
                case .contacts:
                    contactsList
                }
            }

            if let vm = showingVoicemail {
                voicemailPlayer(vm)
                    .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .scale(scale: 0.95)))
            }

            if let friend = showingCallSheet {
                callCharacterPicker(friend)
                    .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .scale(scale: 0.95)))
            }
        }
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.85), value: selectedTab)
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.85), value: showingVoicemail?.id)
        .animation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.85), value: showingCallSheet)
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack {
            Image(systemName: "phone.fill")
                .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255))
            Text("Phone")
                .font(CFFont.title)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Spacer()
            if phoneCredits > 0 {
                Text("\(phoneCredits) credit\(phoneCredits == 1 ? "" : "s")")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                    .padding(.vertical, 4)
                    .pixelChrome(fill: CFColor.ink, stroke: CFColor.cyan)
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.vertical, 10)
    }

    private var tabPicker: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            ForEach(PhoneTab.allCases, id: \.self) { tab in
                Button {
                    selectedTab = tab
                } label: {
                    Text(tab.rawValue)
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(selectedTab == tab ? CFColor.textOnDark : CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                        .padding(.vertical, 8)
                        .background(selectedTab == tab ? CFColor.ink : Color.clear)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
            }
        }
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.3))
    }

    private var recentsList: some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVStack(spacing: 10) {
                let calls = recentCalls
                if calls.isEmpty {
                    emptyState(icon: "phone.slash", message: "No calls yet.")
                } else {
                    ForEach(calls, id: \.id) { call in
                        callRow(call)
                    }
                }
            }
            .padding(16)
        }
    }

    private var voicemailList: some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVStack(spacing: 10) {
                let vms = availableVoicemails
                if vms.isEmpty {
                    emptyState(icon: "voicemail", message: "No voicemails yet.")
                } else {
                    ForEach(vms, id: \.id) { vm in
                        voicemailRow(vm)
                    }
                }
            }
            .padding(16)
        }
    }

    private var contactsList: some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVStack(spacing: 10) {
                ForEach(FriendID.allCases, id: \.self) { friend in
                    contactRow(friend)
                }
            }
            .padding(16)
        }
    }

    private func callRow(_ call: RecentCall) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: call.isMissed ? "phone.badge.fill" : "phone.fill")
                .font(.system(size: 20))
                .foregroundStyle(call.isMissed ? CFColor.warning : CFColor.cream.opacity(0.6))
                .frame(width: 36, height: 36)
                .background(call.isMissed ? CFColor.warning.opacity(0.15) : CFColor.ink)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text(call.senderName)
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Text("Day \(call.day) • \(call.duration)s")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.6))
            }
            Spacer()

            if call.hasVoicemail {
                Image(systemName: "waveform.badge.magnifyingglass")
                    .font(.system(size: 14))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
            }
        }
        .padding(12)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
        .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10).stroke(CFColor.ink, lineWidth: 1))
    }

    private func voicemailRow(_ vm: VoicemailContent) -> some View {
        Button {
            showingVoicemail = vm
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Image(systemName: "waveform")
                    .font(.system(size: 20))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    .frame(width: 36, height: 36)
                    .background(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.12))
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    Text(vm.sender == "dev" ? "Dev" : "Nia")
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    Text(String(vm.text.prefix(50)) + (vm.text.count > 50 ? "..." : ""))
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.6))
                        .lineLimit(2)
                    Text("Day \(vm.day) • \(vm.duration)s")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.5))
                }
                Spacer()

                Image(systemName: "play.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 12))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
            }
            .padding(12)
            .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
            .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10).stroke(CFColor.ink, lineWidth: 1))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private func contactRow(_ friend: FriendID) -> some View {
        Button {
            showingCallSheet = friend
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Image(systemName: "person.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 24))
                    .foregroundStyle(friend == .dev ? CFColor.cyan : CFColor.primary)
                    .frame(width: 44, height: 44)
                    .background(friend == .dev ? CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.12) : CFColor.primary.opacity(0.12))
                    .clipShape(Circle())

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    Text(friend == .dev ? "Dev" : "Nia")
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    Text(friend == .dev ? "Your skeptical friend" : "Your supportive friend")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.6))
                }
                Spacer()

                Image(systemName: "phone.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 14))
                    .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255))
            }
            .padding(12)
            .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
            .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10).stroke(CFColor.ink, lineWidth: 1))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private func voicemailPlayer(_ vm: VoicemailContent) -> some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.95).ignoresSafeArea()
                .onTapGesture { showingVoicemail = nil }

            VStack(spacing: 16) {
                Text(vm.sender == "dev" ? "Dev" : "Nia")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                Image(systemName: "waveform")
                    .font(.system(size: 48))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    .frame(width: 80, height: 80)
                    .background(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.1))
                    .clipShape(Circle())

                Text(vm.text)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 24)

                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    Text("Day \(vm.day)")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.6))
                    Text("•")
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.3))
                    Text("\(vm.duration)s")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.6))
                }

                if let factID = vm.factID, !gameState.isFactDiscovered(factID) {
                    Button("Save Evidence") {
                        try? gameState.commitFact(factID)
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
                    .padding(.horizontal, 48)
                } else if vm.factID != nil {
                    Text("Evidence saved")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255))
                }

                Button("Close") { showingVoicemail = nil }
                    .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.ink))
                    .padding(.horizontal, 60)
            }
        }
    }

    private func callCharacterPicker(_ friend: FriendID) -> some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.95).ignoresSafeArea()
                .onTapGesture { showingCallSheet = nil }

            VStack(spacing: 16) {
                Image(systemName: "phone.connection.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 48))
                    .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255))

                Text("Who do you want to call?")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                Text("Via \(friend == .dev ? "Dev" : "Nia")")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))

                LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.flexible()), GridItem(.flexible())], spacing: 8) {
                    ForEach(CharacterID.allCases) { character in
                        Button(character.displayName) {
                            selectedCharacterForCall = character
                            showingCallSheet = nil
                        }
                        .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.ink))
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 24)

                if let matches = gameState.run?.matches, !matches.isEmpty {
                    Divider()
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.3))
                        .padding(.vertical, 8)

                    Text("NPCs You've Met")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))

                    LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.flexible()), GridItem(.flexible())], spacing: 8) {
                        let npcs = DialogueTreeManager.shared.allNPCs()
                        ForEach(npcs.prefix(4)) { npc in
                            Button(npc.name) {
                                selectedNPCToCall = npc
                                showingCallSheet = nil
                            }
                            .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.ink))
                        }
                    }
                    .padding(.horizontal, 24)
                }

                Button("Cancel") { showingCallSheet = nil }
                    .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.ink))
                    .padding(.horizontal, 60)
            }
        }
        .sheet(item: $selectedCharacterForCall) { character in
            CallView(friend: friend, target: .mainCharacter(character))
        }
        .sheet(item: $selectedNPCToCall) { npc in
            CallView(friend: friend, target: .npc(npc))
        }
    }

    private func emptyState(icon: String, message: String) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: icon)
                .font(.system(size: 40))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.25))
            Text(message)
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
        }
        .padding(.top, 40)
    }

    private var recentCalls: [RecentCall] {
        let day = gameState.currentDay
        let killerRaw = gameState.run?.killerRaw ?? ""
        var calls: [RecentCall] = []
        for d in 1...day {
            let vms = ContentStore.shared.voicemails(forDay: d, killerRaw: killerRaw)
            for vm in vms {
                calls.append(RecentCall(
                    id: vm.id,
                    senderName: vm.sender == "dev" ? "Dev" : "Nia",
                    day: vm.day,
                    duration: vm.duration,
                    isMissed: true,
                    hasVoicemail: true
                ))
            }
        }
        return calls.reversed()
    }

    private var availableVoicemails: [VoicemailContent] {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }
        var result: [VoicemailContent] = []
        for d in 1...run.currentDay {
            result.append(contentsOf: ContentStore.shared.voicemails(forDay: d, killerRaw: run.killerRaw))
        }
        return result.reversed()
    }
}

struct RecentCall {
    let id: String
    let senderName: String
    let day: Int
    let duration: Int
    let isMissed: Bool
    let hasVoicemail: Bool
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.swift">
import SwiftUI

struct PixelButton: View {
    let title: String
    let action: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Text(title)
        }
        .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
    }
}

struct OnboardingOverlay: View {
    @Environment(OnboardingManager.self) private var onboarding

    var body: some View {
        if onboarding.isActive {
            switch onboarding.currentStep {
            case .swipeAndMatch, .dmsAndVoice, .journalIntro:
                bottomBanner
            default:
                fullScreenOverlay
            }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var fullScreenOverlay: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.92)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                topBar

                Spacer()

                stepCard
                    .padding(.horizontal, 24)

                Spacer()

                bottomBar
            }
            .padding(.vertical, 20)
        }
        .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .scale(scale: 0.95)))
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var bottomBanner: some View {
        VStack {
            Spacer()

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    Image(systemName: onboarding.currentStep.icon)
                        .font(.system(size: 16))
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                    Text(onboarding.currentStep.title)
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    Spacer()
                }

                Text(bannerInstruction)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.8))
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)

                if onboarding.currentStep == .journalIntro {
                    PixelButton(title: "Got it →") {
                        onboarding.advance()
                    }
                    .padding(.top, 4)
                }
            }
            .padding(16)
            .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.95))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12)
                    .stroke(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.5), lineWidth: 2)
            )
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.bottom, 70)
        }
        .transition(.move(edge: .bottom).combined(with: .opacity))
    }

    private var bannerInstruction: String {
        switch onboarding.currentStep {
        case .swipeAndMatch:
            return "Swipe right on a profile to match with them. Try it now!"
        case .dmsAndVoice:
            return "Send a message or voice memo to your match."
        case .journalIntro:
            return "Your journal tracks every clue you discover."
        default:
            return ""
        }
    }

    private var topBar: some View {
        HStack {
            Spacer()
            Button("Skip") {
                onboarding.skip()
            }
            .font(CFFont.caption)
            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
            .padding(.horizontal, 8)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 8)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var stepCard: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            Image(systemName: onboarding.currentStep.icon)
                .font(.system(size: 52))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)

            Text(onboarding.currentStep.title)
                .font(CFFont.title)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)

            Text(onboarding.currentStep.subtitle)
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.8))
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)

            stepActionContent
        }
        .padding(28)
        .frame(maxWidth: 340)
        .background(CFColor.ink)
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16)
                .stroke(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.4), lineWidth: 2)
        )
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16))
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var stepActionContent: some View {
        switch onboarding.currentStep {
        case .welcome, .phoneTour:
            Group {
                PixelButton(title: "Next →") {
                    onboarding.advance()
                }
            }
            .padding(.top, 8)

        case .swipeAndMatch:
            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                Text("Swipe right on the next card to match!")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)

                HStack(spacing: 20) {
                    Label("Pass", systemImage: "xmark")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning.opacity(0.7))

                    Label("Match", systemImage: "heart.fill")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.7))
                }
            }
            .padding(.top, 8)

        case .dmsAndVoice:
            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                Text("Send a message or hold the mic for a voice memo!")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)

                HStack(spacing: 20) {
                    Label("Text", systemImage: "message.fill")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.7))

                    Label("Voice", systemImage: "mic.fill")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.7))
                }
            }
            .padding(.top, 8)

        case .journalIntro:
            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                Text("Tap the Journal icon on your home screen to review clues.")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)

                PixelButton(title: "Got it →") {
                    onboarding.advance()
                }
            }
            .padding(.top, 8)

        case .accusationWarning:
            Group {
                PixelButton(title: "I understand →") {
                    onboarding.advance()
                }
            }
            .padding(.top, 8)

        case .complete:
            Group {
                PixelButton(title: "Start investigating!") {
                    onboarding.skip()
                }
            }
            .padding(.top, 8)
        }
    }

    private var bottomBar: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            ForEach(0..<7, id: \.self) { index in
                Circle()
                    .fill(index == onboarding.currentStep.rawValue ? CFColor.primary : CFColor.ink)
                    .frame(width: 8, height: 8)
            }
        }
        .padding(.bottom, 8)
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/EastworldChatService.swift">
import Foundation

actor EastworldChatBudget {
    private var usedCharacters: [String: Int] = [:]
    private var fallbackCursor: [String: Int] = [:]
    private let cap: Int

    init(cap: Int = 3_000) {
        self.cap = cap
    }

    func canUse(_ count: Int, character: String) -> Bool {
        (usedCharacters[character] ?? 0) + count <= cap
    }

    func record(_ count: Int, character: String) {
        usedCharacters[character, default: 0] += count
    }

    func atLimit(character: String) -> Bool {
        (usedCharacters[character] ?? 0) >= cap
    }

    func nextFallbackIndex(character: String, count: Int) -> Int {
        guard count > 0 else { return 0 }
        let current = fallbackCursor[character, default: 0]
        fallbackCursor[character] = current + 1
        return current % count
    }
}

struct ProductionDateEastworldClient: DateDirectorEastworldClient {
    private let endpoint: URL
    private let budget: EastworldChatBudget
    private let cache: NSCache<NSString, NSString>

    init(
        endpoint: URL = URL(string: "https://ai.catfish.workers.dev/chat")!,
        budget: EastworldChatBudget = EastworldChatBudget()
    ) {
        self.endpoint = endpoint
        self.budget = budget
        self.cache = NSCache()
    }

    func nextLine(sceneID: String, partnerID: String, playerInput: String) async throws -> String {
        let prompt = buildPrompt(partnerID: partnerID, playerInput: playerInput)
        let cacheKey = fnvHash("\(partnerID):\(playerInput)") as NSString

        if let cached = cache.object(forKey: cacheKey) as? String {
            return cached
        }

        let canUse = await budget.canUse(prompt.count, character: partnerID)
        if !canUse {
            return await fallbackText(for: partnerID, budget: budget)
        }

        let response: String
        do {
            response = try await callEastworld(prompt: prompt, partnerID: partnerID)
            await budget.record(prompt.count, character: partnerID)
            cache.setObject(response as NSString, forKey: cacheKey)
        } catch {
            return await fallbackText(for: partnerID, budget: budget)
        }

        return response
    }

    private func buildPrompt(partnerID: String, playerInput: String) -> String {
        let characterContext = characterPrompt(for: partnerID)
        return """
        \(characterContext)

        The person you're dating just said: "\(playerInput)"

        Respond naturally in character. Keep your response under 200 characters. Be yourself — curious, warm, with your own speech patterns and personality.

        IMPORTANT GUARDRAILS:
        - Stay on topic about your life, the date, or your interests
        - Do not discuss real-world politics, religion, or harmful content
        - If asked about something you shouldn't know, deflect naturally
        - Never break character or mention being an AI
        """
    }

    private func characterPrompt(for characterID: String) -> String {
        switch characterID {
        case "kai":
            return """
            You are Kai Navarro, a 29-year-old sound designer and freelance artist. You're warm but guarded, observant, and often answer with sensory details. You use short clauses, occasional dry self-drag, and ask clarifying questions. You say things like "Not a bad silence, just a full one" in awkward pauses, and "Can we do this slower so I answer honestly?" when pushed.
            """
        case "river":
            return """
            You are River Hale, a 31-year-old public defender investigator. You're precise, measured, and slightly forensic in your thinking. You drop into warmer phrasing as trust builds. You say things like "Help me square that with what you said earlier" when you notice contradictions, and "Trust is a verb. We can build it" when someone questions your openness.
            """
        case "miles":
            return """
            You are Miles Durant, a 34-year-old event producer. You're smooth, articulate, and often frame answers as stories with setup/punchline. Under stress you become overly formal. You say things like "Okay, honest version?" as an awkward beat, and "You're dangerous to my ego" when complimented.
            """
        case "sam":
            return """
            You are Samira "Sam" Okafor, a 27-year-old middle school science teacher. You're warm, expressive, with analogies from teaching and nature. You use humor to mediate conflict. You say "Okay, tiny reset. One honest sentence each?" in awkward silences, and "Nice is free. Boundaries are extra" when pushed.
            """
        case "jules":
            return """
            You are Jules Park, a 30-year-old tattoo artist. You're calm, concise with vivid metaphors, and use pauses intentionally. You say "Give it a second; good answers take oxygen" in awkward pauses, and "Hard no. Different question" when a boundary is crossed.
            """
        default:
            return "You are on a casual first date. Be warm and engaging but guarded."
        }
    }

    private func callEastworld(prompt: String, partnerID: String) async throws -> String {
        var request = URLRequest(url: endpoint)
        request.httpMethod = "POST"
        request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
        request.setValue("text/plain", forHTTPHeaderField: "Accept")
        request.timeoutInterval = 15

        let payload: [String: Any] = [
            "prompt": prompt,
            "character": partnerID,
            "max_tokens": 200
        ]
        request.httpBody = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: payload)

        let (data, response) = try await URLSession.shared.data(for: request)

        guard let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse else {
            throw EastworldChatError.invalidResponse
        }

        guard (200..<300).contains(httpResponse.statusCode) else {
            throw EastworldChatError.requestFailed(statusCode: httpResponse.statusCode)
        }

        guard let json = try JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any],
              let text = json["text"] as? String else {
            throw EastworldChatError.invalidResponse
        }

        return text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
    }

    private func fallbackText(for partnerID: String, budget: EastworldChatBudget) async -> String {
        await budget.record(1, character: partnerID)
        let lines = fallbackLines(for: partnerID)
        let index = await budget.nextFallbackIndex(character: partnerID, count: lines.count)
        let line = lines[index]
        let isAtLimit = await budget.atLimit(character: partnerID)
        let shouldMarkUnstable = index % 2 == 1 || isAtLimit
        if shouldMarkUnstable {
            return "\(line) (connection unstable)"
        }
        return line
    }

    private func fallbackLines(for partnerID: String) -> [String] {
        switch partnerID {
        case "kai":
            return [
                "Hmm. That's an interesting way to put it.",
                "I want to answer that well. Give me a sec.",
                "You're not wrong. I just need a better angle."
            ]
        case "river":
            return [
                "I'm not sure I follow. Can you say that differently?",
                "Walk me through that one more time.",
                "I might be missing context. Start from the middle."
            ]
        case "miles":
            return [
                "That's a fair point. Let me think about it.",
                "Okay, that landed. Let me answer properly.",
                "You've got me pausing for a better response."
            ]
        case "sam":
            return [
                "I hear you. Tell me more?",
                "Okay, tiny reset. What part matters most to you?",
                "I'm with you so far. Keep going."
            ]
        case "jules":
            return [
                "I see what you mean. Go on.",
                "Give me a second; I want the honest answer.",
                "That's sharp. Keep that thread going."
            ]
        default:
            return ["..."]
        }
    }

    private func fnvHash(_ input: String) -> String {
        let hash = input.unicodeScalars.reduce(UInt64(1469598103934665603)) { value, scalar in
            (value ^ UInt64(scalar.value)) &* 1099511628211
        }
        return String(hash, radix: 16)
    }
}

enum EastworldChatError: Error {
    case textTooLong(limit: Int)
    case budgetExceeded(usedChars: Int, capChars: Int)
    case invalidResponse
    case requestFailed(statusCode: Int)
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Scripts/pregen_voice_lines.py">
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pre-generate voice lines and sound assets from manifest/CSV via ElevenLabs.

Supports two generation modes:
  - TTS (text-to-speech) for character voice lines from the JSON manifest
  - Sound generation for SFX, stings, ambience from the audio-assets CSV

Compose-sourced assets in the CSV are skipped automatically.
Existing output files are skipped (idempotent resume).
Progress is checkpointed to a JSON state file.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from typing import Any

ELEVENLABS_TTS_URL = "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}"
ELEVENLABS_SOUND_URL = "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/sound-generation"
DEFAULT_MODEL_ID = "eleven_turbo_v2_5"

SOUND_MAX_PROMPT_CHARS = 450
SOUND_MIN_DURATION = 0.5
SOUND_MAX_DURATION = 30.0

CATEGORY_DIRS: dict[str, str] = {
    "music_hero": "Music/Hero",
    "music_ending": "Music/Endings",
    "music_sting": "Music/Stings",
    "sfx_ui": "SFX/UI",
    "ambience": "Ambience",
    "sfx_diegetic": "SFX/Diegetic",
    "sfx_narrative": "SFX/Narrative",
}

STYLE_PREFIXES = [
    "lo-fi beats crossed with SNES-era chiptune, in the spirit of Sayonara Wild Hearts and 2064: Read Only Memories. Warm vinyl crackle texture underneath clean synth leads. Mid-to-low BPM unless specified. Magenta/cyan-coded vibes — hopeful, slightly nocturnal, occasionally uneasy. Avoid orchestral, avoid pure 8-bit, avoid trap or drill. Mix should sit cleanly under voice — leave 800Hz-3kHz space for dialogue. ",
    "clean synthetic UI sound, 16-bit videogame aesthetic but with modern production polish. Crisp transients, short tail, no realistic physical foley. Tonal where appropriate. Sits in app UI without feeling like a toy. ",
    "naturalistic real-world sound, recorded or sample-library quality. Sits in the world of the scene as if heard from the player's POV. ",
]


def load_json(path: pathlib.Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def write_json(path: pathlib.Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(payload, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)


def load_csv_assets(path: pathlib.Path) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def bundle_path_for_row(row: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    directory = CATEGORY_DIRS.get(row["category"], "SFX/Misc")
    name = row["asset_name"]
    fmt = row.get("format", "m4a")
    return f"{directory}/{name}.{fmt}"


def sanitize_prompt(raw: str) -> str:
    text = raw
    for prefix in STYLE_PREFIXES:
        if text.startswith(prefix):
            text = text[len(prefix):]
            break
    if len(text) > SOUND_MAX_PROMPT_CHARS:
        text = text[:SOUND_MAX_PROMPT_CHARS - 1].rstrip() + "…"
    return text


def clamp_duration(seconds: float) -> float:
    return max(SOUND_MIN_DURATION, min(SOUND_MAX_DURATION, seconds))


def convert_to_m4a(mp3_data: bytes, output_path: pathlib.Path) -> None:
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp3", delete=False) as tmp:
        tmp.write(mp3_data)
        tmp_path = tmp.name
    try:
        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        subprocess.run(
            [
                "ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", tmp_path,
                "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k",
                "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "2",
                str(output_path),
            ],
            check=True,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
    finally:
        pathlib.Path(tmp_path).unlink(missing_ok=True)


def synthesize_voice(
    *,
    api_key: str,
    voice_id: str,
    text: str,
    model_id: str,
    stability: float,
    similarity_boost: float,
) -> bytes:
    url = ELEVENLABS_TTS_URL.format(voice_id=voice_id)
    payload = {
        "text": text,
        "model_id": model_id,
        "voice_settings": {
            "stability": stability,
            "similarity_boost": similarity_boost,
        },
        "output_format": "mp3_44100_128",
    }
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url=url,
        method="POST",
        data=body,
        headers={
            "xi-api-key": api_key,
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Accept": "audio/mpeg",
        },
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
        return resp.read()


def synthesize_sound(
    *,
    api_key: str,
    prompt: str,
    duration_seconds: float,
) -> bytes:
    payload = {
        "text": prompt,
        "duration_seconds": duration_seconds,
        "output_format": "mp3_44100_128",
    }
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url=ELEVENLABS_SOUND_URL,
        method="POST",
        data=body,
        headers={
            "xi-api-key": api_key,
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Accept": "audio/mpeg",
        },
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
        return resp.read()


def _record(
    state: dict[str, Any],
    asset_id: str,
    status: str,
    extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    entry: dict[str, Any] = {"status": status, "updatedAt": int(time.time())}
    if extra:
        entry.update(extra)
    state["assets"][asset_id] = entry


def _checkpoint(state: dict[str, Any], path: pathlib.Path) -> None:
    state["updatedAt"] = int(time.time())
    write_json(path, state)


def _handle_error(
    err: Exception,
    asset_id: str,
    state: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    if isinstance(err, urllib.error.HTTPError):
        detail = err.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        _record(state, asset_id, "http_error", {"code": err.code, "error": detail})
        print(f"[ERR] {asset_id}: HTTP {err.code} {detail}", file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        _record(state, asset_id, "error", {"error": str(err)})
        print(f"[ERR] {asset_id}: {err}", file=sys.stderr)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Pre-generate voice lines and sound assets via ElevenLabs",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--manifest", required=True, type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True, type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument("--csv", type=pathlib.Path, default=None,
                        help="Audio assets CSV with SFX/sting/ambience definitions")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--state-file",
        type=pathlib.Path,
        default=pathlib.Path(".voice_generation_state.json"),
    )
    parser.add_argument("--model-id", default=DEFAULT_MODEL_ID)
    parser.add_argument("--stability", type=float, default=0.45)
    parser.add_argument("--similarity-boost", type=float, default=0.85)
    parser.add_argument("--sleep-ms", type=int, default=200)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--scene-dir",
        type=pathlib.Path,
        default=None,
        help="Optional directory of date scene JSON files used to scope voice generation",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--date-lines-mode",
        choices=["all", "happy"],
        default="all",
        help="When --scene-dir is set: generate all branch lines or happy-path-only lines",
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def collect_date_line_ids(scene: dict[str, Any], mode: str) -> set[str]:
    line_ids: set[str] = set()
    opening = scene.get("openingNarration", {})
    opening_id = opening.get("voiceLineID")
    if opening_id:
        line_ids.add(opening_id)

    beats = scene.get("beats", [])
    if mode == "all":
        for beat in beats:
            beat_type = beat.get("type")
            if beat_type == "scripted":
                for variant in beat.get("variants", []):
                    vid = variant.get("voiceLineID")
                    if vid:
                        line_ids.add(vid)
            if beat_type == "eastworld":
                fallback_id = beat.get("fallbackVoiceLineID")
                if fallback_id:
                    line_ids.add(fallback_id)
        return line_ids

    by_id = {beat.get("beatID"): idx for idx, beat in enumerate(beats)}
    visited: set[int] = set()
    idx = 0
    while 0 <= idx < len(beats) and idx not in visited:
        visited.add(idx)
        beat = beats[idx]
        beat_type = beat.get("type")
        if beat_type == "scripted":
            variants = beat.get("variants", [])
            default_variant = None
