<file path="catfish/Features/Apps/LotsOFish/LotsOFishApp.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct LotsOFishApp: View {
    @State private var activeDateScene: DateScene?
    @State private var activeDateContext: DateSceneContext?
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context

    private var totalUnread: Int {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return 0 }
        return run.chatThreads.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.unreadCount }
    }

    var body: some View {
        TabView {
            SwipeView()
                .tabItem { Label("Discover", systemImage: "flame.fill") }

            DateTabContainer(activeDateScene: $activeDateScene, activeDateContext: $activeDateContext)
                .tabItem { Label("Date", systemImage: "person.2.wave.2.fill") }

            MatchesView()
                .tabItem { Label("Matches", systemImage: "message.fill") }
                .badge(totalUnread)

            ClueJournalView()
                .tabItem { Label("Journal", systemImage: "book.fill") }
        }
        .tint(CFColor.primary)
        .fullScreenCover(item: $activeDateScene) { scene in
            DateSceneView(scene: scene, context: activeDateContext)
        }
    }
}

struct DateTabContainer: View {
    @Binding var activeDateScene: DateScene?
    @Binding var activeDateContext: DateSceneContext?
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            if let matches = gameState.run?.matches, !matches.isEmpty {
                ScrollView {
                    LazyVStack(spacing: 16) {
                        ForEach(matches) { match in
                            DateMatchRow(
                                match: match,
                                onStartDate: { scene, ctx in
                                    activeDateScene = scene
                                    activeDateContext = ctx
                                }
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    .padding()
                }
            } else {
                emptyState
            }
        }
    }

    private var emptyState: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            Image(systemName: "heart.slash")
                .font(.system(size: 52))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
            Text("No matches yet.")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Text("Match with someone first, then come back to schedule a date.")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
        }
    }
}

struct DateMatchRow: View {
    let match: MatchRelationship
    let onStartDate: (DateScene, DateSceneContext) -> Void

    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState
    @Query private var dateOutcomes: [DateOutcomeRecord]

    init(match: MatchRelationship, onStartDate: @escaping (DateScene, DateSceneContext) -> Void) {
        self.match = match
        self.onStartDate = onStartDate
        let characterRaw = match.characterRaw
        _dateOutcomes = Query(filter: #Predicate<DateOutcomeRecord> { $0.characterRaw == characterRaw })
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
            HStack(spacing: 16) {
                AssetImage(match.characterID.portraitAssetID)
                    .frame(width: 52, height: 52)
                    .clipShape(Circle())

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    Text(match.characterID.displayName)
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    Text("Matched Day \(match.matchedOnDay)")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                }

                Spacer()
            }

            dateActions

            completedDatesSummary
        }
        .padding()
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.6))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var dateActions: some View {
        let completedSceneIDs = Set(dateOutcomes.map(\.sceneID))
        let day = gameState.currentDay
        let characterRaw = match.characterRaw
        let availableScenes = DateSceneLoader.allScenesForCharacter(characterRaw)
            .filter { scene in
                scene.minDay <= day &&
                !completedSceneIDs.contains(where: { $0 == scene.sceneID || $0.contains("_0\(scene.sceneNumber)_") || $0.contains("_\(scene.sceneNumber)_") })
            }

        if match.hasScheduledDate, let sceneID = match.scheduledDateSceneID, let scene = DateSceneLoader.sceneForID(sceneID) {
            Button(action: { startDate(scene) }) {
                HStack {
                    Image(systemName: "heart.fill")
                    Text("Go on Date")
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            }
            .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
        } else if match.dateInvitationPending {
            if let first = availableScenes.first, let scene = DateSceneLoader.loadScene(named: first.sceneID) {
                Button(action: { acceptInvitation(scene: scene) }) {
                    HStack {
                        Image(systemName: "envelope.open.fill")
                        Text("Accept Date Invite")
                    }
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                }
                .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.cyan))
            }
        } else if let first = availableScenes.first, let scene = DateSceneLoader.loadScene(named: first.sceneID) {
            Button(action: { scheduleDate(scene) }) {
                HStack {
                    Image(systemName: "calendar")
                    Text("Schedule Date")
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            }
            .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.magentaDim))
        } else {
            Text("All dates completed")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var completedDatesSummary: some View {
        let characterOutcomes = dateOutcomes.filter { $0.characterRaw == match.characterRaw }
        if !characterOutcomes.isEmpty {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
                Text("Completed Dates")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                ForEach(characterOutcomes, id: \.id) { outcome in
                    HStack {
                        Image(systemName: outcome.affinityDelta >= 0 ? "heart.fill" : "heart.slash")
                            .foregroundStyle(outcome.affinityDelta >= 0 ? CFColor.primary : CFColor.warning)
                            .font(.system(size: 12))
                        Text(sceneDisplayName(outcome.sceneID))
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
                        if outcome.affinityDelta != 0 {
                            Text("\(outcome.affinityDelta > 0 ? "+" : "")\(outcome.affinityDelta)")
                                .font(CFFont.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(outcome.affinityDelta > 0 ? CFColor.primary : CFColor.warning)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func startDate(_ scene: DateScene) {
        guard let ctx = makeContext() else { return }
        match.clearScheduledDate()
        try? context.save()
        onStartDate(scene, ctx)
    }

    private func scheduleDate(_ scene: DateScene) {
        match.scheduleDate(sceneID: scene.sceneID, day: gameState.currentDay)
        try? context.save()
    }

    private func acceptInvitation(scene: DateScene) {
        match.scheduleDate(sceneID: scene.sceneID, day: gameState.currentDay)
        try? context.save()
    }

    private func makeContext() -> DateSceneContext? {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return nil }
        return DateSceneContext(
            killerID: run.killerRaw,
            dayNumber: run.currentDay,
            discoveredFactIDs: run.discoveredFactIDs,
            affinity: 0
        )
    }

    private func sceneDisplayName(_ sceneID: String) -> String {
        let parts = sceneID.components(separatedBy: "_")
        if parts.count >= 4 {
            let setting = parts.dropFirst(3).joined(separator: " ")
            return setting.replacingOccurrences(of: "_", with: " ").capitalized
        }
        return sceneID
    }
}

struct AppPlaceholderTab: View {
    let title: String
    let systemImage: String

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()
            VStack(spacing: 16) {
                Image(systemName: systemImage)
                    .font(.system(size: 52))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                Text(title)
                    .font(CFFont.title)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Text("Coming in the next pass.")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
            }
        }
    }
}

<file path="catfish/Features/Date/DateScene.swift">
import SpriteKit

enum DateSpriteMode: Equatable {
    case standard
    case firstPerson
}

enum DateSpriteExpression: Equatable {
    case neutral
    case neutralSaintmask
    case smile
    case flirty
    case curious
    case uneasy
    case sinister
}

final class DateSpriteScene: SKScene {
    private let backgroundNode = SKSpriteNode(color: .black, size: CGSize(width: 1, height: 1))
    private let parallaxNode = SKSpriteNode(color: .darkGray, size: CGSize(width: 1, height: 1))
    private let characterNode = SKSpriteNode(color: .white, size: CGSize(width: 320, height: 480))
    private let mouthNode = SKSpriteNode(color: .black, size: CGSize(width: 52, height: 12))
    private let uneasyOverlay = SKSpriteNode(color: .black.withAlphaComponent(0.2), size: CGSize(width: 320, height: 180))
    private let glitchOverlay = SKSpriteNode(color: .magenta.withAlphaComponent(0.10), size: CGSize(width: 1, height: 1))
    private let initialLabel = SKLabelNode(text: "?")

    private(set) var mode: DateSpriteMode = .standard

    func configure(sceneID: String, partner: String, environment: String) {
        let initial = partner.prefix(1).uppercased()
        initialLabel.text = initial

        if let texture = loadBackgroundTexture(for: sceneID) {
            backgroundNode.texture = texture
            backgroundNode.color = .clear
        } else {
            backgroundNode.texture = nil
            applyEnvironmentColors(environment)
        }

        if let texture = loadPortraitTexture(for: partner) {
            characterNode.texture = texture
            characterNode.color = .clear
        } else {
            characterNode.texture = nil
        }
    }

    private func loadPortraitTexture(for partner: String) -> SKTexture? {
        guard let partnerID = CharacterID(rawValue: partner.lowercased()) else {
            return nil
        }
        let assetID = partnerID.portraitAssetID
        if let image = UIImage(named: assetID) {
            return SKTexture(image: image)
        }
        return nil
    }

    private func loadBackgroundTexture(for sceneID: String) -> SKTexture? {
        if let image = UIImage(named: sceneID) {
            return SKTexture(image: image)
        }
        return nil
    }

    private func applyEnvironmentColors(_ environment: String) {
        let env = environment.lowercased()
        let bg: UIColor
        let parallax: UIColor
        if env.contains("coffee") {
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.12, green: 0.08, blue: 0.04, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.20, green: 0.14, blue: 0.08, alpha: 1)
        } else if env.contains("park") {
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.04, green: 0.10, blue: 0.06, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.08, green: 0.18, blue: 0.10, alpha: 1)
        } else if env.contains("bar") {
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.10, green: 0.04, blue: 0.12, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.18, green: 0.06, blue: 0.20, alpha: 1)
        } else if env.contains("restaurant") {
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.10, green: 0.06, blue: 0.04, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.16, green: 0.10, blue: 0.06, alpha: 1)
        } else if env.contains("apartment") {
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.06, green: 0.06, blue: 0.10, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.10, green: 0.10, blue: 0.16, alpha: 1)
        } else {
            bg = UIColor(red: 0.06, green: 0.08, blue: 0.20, alpha: 1)
            parallax = UIColor(red: 0.10, green: 0.12, blue: 0.30, alpha: 1)
        }
        backgroundNode.color = bg
        parallaxNode.color = parallax
    }

    override func didMove(to view: SKView) {
        scaleMode = .resizeFill
        configureNodes()
        layoutNodes(for: size)
    }

    override func didChangeSize(_ oldSize: CGSize) {
        super.didChangeSize(oldSize)
        layoutNodes(for: size)
    }

    private func configureNodes() {
        backgroundColor = .black
        addChild(backgroundNode)
        addChild(parallaxNode)
        addChild(characterNode)

        mouthNode.position = CGPoint(x: 0, y: -84)
        mouthNode.alpha = 0.6
        characterNode.addChild(mouthNode)

        initialLabel.fontSize = 96
        initialLabel.fontColor = .white.withAlphaComponent(0.7)
        initialLabel.fontName = "HelveticaNeue-Bold"
        initialLabel.verticalAlignmentMode = .center
        initialLabel.zPosition = 10
        characterNode.addChild(initialLabel)

        uneasyOverlay.position = CGPoint(x: 0, y: 70)
        uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        characterNode.addChild(uneasyOverlay)

        glitchOverlay.alpha = 0
        glitchOverlay.zPosition = 100
        addChild(glitchOverlay)
    }

    private func layoutNodes(for newSize: CGSize) {
        backgroundNode.size = newSize
        backgroundNode.position = CGPoint(x: newSize.width / 2, y: newSize.height / 2)
        if backgroundNode.texture == nil {
            backgroundNode.color = .init(red: 0.06, green: 0.08, blue: 0.20, alpha: 1)
        }

        parallaxNode.size = CGSize(width: newSize.width * 1.15, height: newSize.height * 1.1)
        parallaxNode.position = CGPoint(x: newSize.width / 2 + 10, y: newSize.height / 2 + 4)
        parallaxNode.color = .init(red: 0.10, green: 0.12, blue: 0.30, alpha: 1)
        parallaxNode.alpha = 0.45

        glitchOverlay.size = newSize
        glitchOverlay.position = CGPoint(x: newSize.width / 2, y: newSize.height / 2)

        applyMode(mode, animated: false)
    }

    func applyMode(_ newMode: DateSpriteMode, animated: Bool) {
        mode = newMode
        let targetScale: CGFloat = newMode == .firstPerson ? 1.45 : 1.0
        let targetY: CGFloat = newMode == .firstPerson ? size.height * 0.56 : size.height * 0.48

        if animated {
            characterNode.run(.group([
                .move(to: CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: targetY), duration: 0.4),
                .scale(to: targetScale, duration: 0.4)
            ]))
            runGlitchPulse()
        } else {
            characterNode.position = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: targetY)
            characterNode.setScale(targetScale)
        }
    }

    func setExpression(_ expression: DateSpriteExpression) {
        uneasyOverlay.removeAllActions()
        if characterNode.texture != nil {
            initialLabel.alpha = 0
        }
        switch expression {
        case .neutral:
            if characterNode.texture == nil { characterNode.color = .white }
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        case .neutralSaintmask:
            if characterNode.texture == nil { characterNode.color = .init(red: 0.88, green: 0.94, blue: 0.96, alpha: 1) }
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        case .smile:
            if characterNode.texture == nil { characterNode.color = .systemTeal }
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        case .flirty:
            if characterNode.texture == nil { characterNode.color = .systemPink }
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        case .curious:
            if characterNode.texture == nil { characterNode.color = .systemBlue }
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0
        case .uneasy:
            if characterNode.texture == nil { characterNode.color = .systemOrange }
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0.20
            uneasyOverlay.run(.repeatForever(.sequence([
                .fadeAlpha(to: 0.12, duration: 0.08),
                .fadeAlpha(to: 0.20, duration: 0.08)
            ])))
        case .sinister:
            if characterNode.texture == nil { characterNode.color = .systemRed }
            uneasyOverlay.alpha = 0.3
        }
    }

    func setMouthFlap(isActive: Bool, amplitude: CGFloat) {
        if isActive {
            mouthNode.xScale = 1 + max(0.05, amplitude * 0.15)
            mouthNode.yScale = 1 + max(0.1, amplitude * 0.7)
            mouthNode.alpha = 0.9
        } else {
            mouthNode.xScale = 1
            mouthNode.yScale = 1
            mouthNode.alpha = 0.2
        }
    }

    private func runGlitchPulse() {
        glitchOverlay.removeAllActions()
        glitchOverlay.run(.sequence([
            .fadeAlpha(to: 0.34, duration: 0.08),
            .fadeOut(withDuration: 0.22)
        ]))
    }
}

<file path="catfish/Features/Swipe/SwipeDeckViewModel.swift">
import Foundation
import SwiftData
import Observation

/// A profile presented in the swipe deck. Distinct from MatchRelationship —
/// this exists before the player swipes right. Lightweight, not persisted
/// (rebuilt each run from authored content + current run state).
struct CandidateProfile: Identifiable, Hashable {
    let id: CharacterID
    let displayName: String
    let age: Int
    let archetype: String
    let bioLine: String
    let portraitAssetID: String
    let portraitFlirtyAssetID: String
    let portraitSinisterAssetID: String
    let portraitUneasyAssetID: String
    let portraitSmileAssetID: String
    let portraitCuriousAssetID: String
    let fullBodyAssetID: String
    let fullBodyFormalAssetID: String
    let badges: [String]           // e.g. ["🎨 artist", "📍 2 mi away"]
}

/// Drives the SwipeView. Owns the candidate queue and executes the
/// swipe-left/swipe-right side effects against SwiftData.
@Observable
@MainActor
final class SwipeDeckViewModel {
    private(set) var queue: [CandidateProfile] = []
    private(set) var topCard: CandidateProfile? = nil
    private(set) var lastSwipeResult: SwipeResult? = nil

    private let context: ModelContext
    private let gameState: GameState

    init(context: ModelContext, gameState: GameState) {
        self.context = context
        self.gameState = gameState
    }

    enum SwipeResult: Equatable {
        case passed(CharacterID)
        case matched(CharacterID)
    }

    // MARK: - Queue management

    /// Rebuild the candidate queue from the authored profiles, skipping any
    /// character the player has already matched or passed this run.
    func refresh() {
        guard let run = gameState.run else {
            queue = []
            topCard = nil
            return
        }
        let alreadyMatched = Set(run.matches.map { $0.characterID })
        // TODO (Content pass): load pass-tracking so passed cards don't reappear.
        // For now, passing is non-persistent and recycles on refresh.
        queue = CharacterID.allCases
            .filter { !alreadyMatched.contains($0) }
            .map { Self.profile(for: $0) }
        topCard = queue.first
    }

    // MARK: - Swipe actions

    func swipeLeft() {
        guard let card = topCard else { return }
        lastSwipeResult = .passed(card.id)
        advance()
    }

    func swipeRight() {
        guard let card = topCard, let run = gameState.run else { return }

        let match = MatchRelationship(character: card.id, day: run.currentDay)
        match.run = run
        context.insert(match)

        let threadKey = "match:\(card.id.rawValue)"
        let thread = ChatThread(partnerKey: threadKey)
        thread.run = run
        context.insert(thread)

        let store = ContentStore.shared
        let openings = store.dmMessages(trigger: "match", character: card.id.rawValue)
        if let opening = openings.randomElement() {
            let message = ChatMessage(
                threadKey: threadKey,
                senderKey: card.id.rawValue,
                text: opening.text,
                sentAt: Date()
            )
            message.run = run
            context.insert(message)
            thread.lastMessageText = opening.text
            thread.lastMessageAt = Date()
            thread.unreadCount = 1
        }

        try? context.save()

        lastSwipeResult = .matched(card.id)
        advance()
    }

    private func advance() {
        if !queue.isEmpty { queue.removeFirst() }
        topCard = queue.first
    }

    static func profile(for id: CharacterID) -> CandidateProfile {
        if let content = ContentStore.shared.profile(for: id) {
            return CandidateProfile(
                id: id,
                displayName: content.displayName,
                age: content.age,
                archetype: content.archetype,
                bioLine: content.bioLine,
                portraitAssetID: content.portraitAssetID,
                portraitFlirtyAssetID: content.portraitFlirtyAssetID,
                portraitSinisterAssetID: content.portraitSinisterAssetID,
                portraitUneasyAssetID: content.portraitUneasyAssetID,
                portraitSmileAssetID: content.portraitSmileAssetID,
                portraitCuriousAssetID: content.portraitCuriousAssetID,
                fullBodyAssetID: content.fullBodyAssetID,
                fullBodyFormalAssetID: content.fullBodyFormalAssetID,
                badges: content.badges
            )
        }
        return fallbackProfile(for: id)
    }

    private static func fallbackProfile(for id: CharacterID) -> CandidateProfile {
        switch id {
        case .kai:
            return CandidateProfile(
                id: .kai, displayName: "Kai", age: 28,
                archetype: "Artist", bioLine: "Painter, night owl, bad at texting.",
                portraitAssetID: "A022_kai_portrait_neutral",
                portraitFlirtyAssetID: "A023_kai_portrait_flirty",
                portraitSinisterAssetID: "A024_kai_portrait_sinister",
                portraitUneasyAssetID: "A025_kai_portrait_uneasy",
                portraitSmileAssetID: "A026_kai_portrait_smile",
                portraitCuriousAssetID: "A027_kai_portrait_curious",
                fullBodyAssetID: "A028_kai_fullbody_casual",
                fullBodyFormalAssetID: "A028_kai_fullbody_formal",
                badges: ["🎨 painter", "📍 1.2 mi"]
            )
        case .river:
            return CandidateProfile(
                id: .river, displayName: "River", age: 31,
                archetype: "Trail runner", bioLine: "Mountains over meetings. Always.",
                portraitAssetID: "A030_river_portrait_neutral",
                portraitFlirtyAssetID: "A031_river_portrait_flirty",
                portraitSinisterAssetID: "A032_river_portrait_sinister",
                portraitUneasyAssetID: "A033_river_portrait_uneasy",
                portraitSmileAssetID: "A034_river_portrait_smile",
                portraitCuriousAssetID: "A035_river_portrait_curious",
                fullBodyAssetID: "A036_river_fullbody_casual",
                fullBodyFormalAssetID: "A068_river-full-body_formal",
                badges: ["🥾 hiker", "📍 3.4 mi"]
            )
        case .miles:
            return CandidateProfile(
                id: .miles, displayName: "Miles", age: 32,
                archetype: "Finance", bioLine: "Downtown loft, amazing skyline view.",
                portraitAssetID: "A038_miles_portrait_neutral",
                portraitFlirtyAssetID: "A036_miles_portrait_flirty",
                portraitSinisterAssetID: "A039_miles_portrait_sinister",
                portraitUneasyAssetID: "A038_miles_portrait_uneasy",
                portraitSmileAssetID: "A035_miles_portrait_smile",
                portraitCuriousAssetID: "A037_miles_portrait_curious",
                fullBodyAssetID: "A044_miles_fullbody_casual",
                fullBodyFormalAssetID: "A045_miles_fullbody_formal",
                badges: ["💼 analyst", "📍 0.8 mi"]
            )
        case .sam:
            return CandidateProfile(
                id: .sam, displayName: "Sam", age: 29,
                archetype: "Nurse", bioLine: "Long shifts, good coffee, better books.",
                portraitAssetID: "A046_sam_portrait_neutral",
                portraitFlirtyAssetID: "A052_sam_portrait_",
                portraitSinisterAssetID: "A053_sam_portrait_",
                portraitUneasyAssetID: "A054_sam_portrait_",
                portraitSmileAssetID: "A056_sam_portrait_",
                portraitCuriousAssetID: "A057_sam_portrait_",
                fullBodyAssetID: "A052_sam_fullbody_casual",
                fullBodyFormalAssetID: "A053_sam_fullbody_formal",
                badges: ["🩺 nurse", "📍 2.1 mi"]
            )
        case .jules:
            return CandidateProfile(
                id: .jules, displayName: "Jules", age: 27,
                archetype: "Musician", bioLine: "Gigs after dark. Synths not guitars.",
                portraitAssetID: "A054_jules_portrait_neutral",
                portraitFlirtyAssetID: "A056_jules_portrait_flirty",
                portraitSinisterAssetID: "A059_jules_portrait_sinister",
                portraitUneasyAssetID: "A058_jules_portrait_uneasy",
                portraitSmileAssetID: "A055_jules_portrait_smile",
                portraitCuriousAssetID: "A057_jules_portrait_curious",
                fullBodyAssetID: "A060_jules_fullbody_casual",

                badges: ["🎹 synth", "📍 4.0 mi"]
            )

    }

# PhoneOS Meta-UI

Catfish presents itself as a fictional phone OS — the game world is a phone
inside your phone.

## Components

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `Features/PhoneOS/PhoneShell.swift` | Phone frame container |
| `Features/PhoneOS/PhoneOSState.swift` | Phone-level state management |
| `Features/PhoneOS/HomeScreen.swift` | App grid / home screen |
| `Features/PhoneOS/StatusBar.swift` | Top status bar |
| `Features/PhoneOS/AppIcon.swift` | App icon component |
| `Features/PhoneOS/AppStubView.swift` | Placeholder for unimplemented apps |
| `DesignSystem/PhoneTheme.swift` | PhoneOS-specific theming |

## Apps

The PhoneShell wraps the entire game experience. Apps within the phone include:

- **LotsOFish** — The dating app (contains the Swipe feature)
- **Photos** — Evidence gallery showing discovered fact images (`PhotosGalleryView`)
- **Word-Low**, **Ego Trip**, **Sugar Coat**, **Safe Spot** — Mini-games launched directly from the home screen
- Other app stubs for future features (phone, FaceTime, mail, browser)

### Journal Badge

`HomeScreen.badge(for:)` now returns a live badge count for the Journal icon.
The badge is `GameState.newJournalClueCount`, calculated as discovered clues
minus `CaseRun.journalLastSeenClueCount`. Opening the Journal marks clues as
seen via `GameState.markJournalViewed()`.

### Photos App

Implemented in `Features/Apps/Photos/PhotosGalleryView.swift`. Shows a grid of
discovered facts that have `imageAssetID` set. Tap to expand with detail overlay
showing image, fact text, and source label. Empty state when no evidence photos.

## Related Pages

- [[features/swipe]] — LotsOFish dating app
- [[features/arcade]] — Mini-games
- [[architecture/overview]] — Full architecture
