<file path="catfish/Features/Apps/Arcade/SafeSpot/SafeSpotGame.swift">
import SwiftUI

struct SafeSpotGame: View {
    let onExit: () -> Void

    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState
    @Environment(NarrativeHookRouter.self) private var router

    @State private var phase: GamePhase = .startScreen
    @State private var wave: Int = 0
    @State private var sanity: Int = 5
    @State private var pom: Int = 100
    @State private var towers: [Tower] = []
    @State private var enemies: [Enemy] = []
    @State private var projectiles: [Projectile] = []
    @State private var damageNumbers: [DamageNumber] = []
    @State private var selectedTowerKind: TowerKind? = nil
    @State private var waveEnemiesLeft: Int = 0
    @State private var spawnTimer: Timer? = nil
    @State private var gameTimer: Timer? = nil
    @State private var lastTick: Date = .now
    @State private var gridWidth: CGFloat = 0
    @State private var gridHeight: CGFloat = 0
    @State private var waveToast: String? = nil
    @State private var namedEnemyLabel: String? = nil
    @State private var spawnIndex: Int = 0
    @State private var showingExitAlert = false

    private let cols = 5
    private let rows = 9
    private let totalWaves = 5
    private let maxSanity = 5

    enum GamePhase {
        case startScreen, playing, waveBreak, won, lost
    }

    enum EnemyKind: String, CaseIterable {
        case gaslighter = "Gaslighter"
        case loveBomber = "Love Bomber"
        case silentTreatment = "Silent Treatment"
        case breadcrumbDropper = "Breadcrumb Dropper"

        var glyph: String {
            switch self {
            case .gaslighter: return "ant.fill"
            case .loveBomber: return "heart.fill"
            case .silentTreatment: return "eye.slash.fill"
            case .breadcrumbDropper: return "leaf.fill"
            }
        }

        var color: Color {
            switch self {
            case .gaslighter: return CFColor.warning
            case .loveBomber: return CFColor.primary
            case .silentTreatment: return CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5)
            case .breadcrumbDropper: return Color.orange
            }
        }

        var speed: Double {
            switch self {
            case .gaslighter: return 40.0
            case .loveBomber: return 30.0
            case .silentTreatment: return 18.0
            case .breadcrumbDropper: return 50.0
            }
        }

        var health: Double {
            switch self {
            case .gaslighter: return 40.0
            case .loveBomber: return 70.0
            case .silentTreatment: return 120.0
            case .breadcrumbDropper: return 30.0
            }
        }

        var reward: Int {
            switch self {
            case .gaslighter: return 10
            case .loveBomber: return 15
            case .silentTreatment: return 25
            case .breadcrumbDropper: return 20
            }
        }
    }

    enum TowerKind: String, CaseIterable {
        case selfCare = "Self Care"
        case mute = "Mute"
        case factCheck = "Fact Check"
        case seen = "Seen"

        var glyph: String {
            switch self {
            case .selfCare: return "cup.and.saucer.fill"
            case .mute: return "speaker.slash.fill"
            case .factCheck: return "shield.fill"
            case .seen: return "eye.fill"
            }
        }

        var cost: Int {
            switch self {
            case .selfCare: return 50
            case .mute: return 75
            case .factCheck: return 100
            case .seen: return 125
            }
        }

        var damage: Int {
            switch self {
            case .selfCare: return 0
            case .mute: return 5
            case .factCheck: return 25
            case .seen: return 12
            }
        }

        var range: Double {
            switch self {
            case .selfCare: return 130.0
            case .mute: return 100.0
            case .factCheck: return 110.0
            case .seen: return 140.0
            }
        }

        var fireRate: Double {
            switch self {
            case .selfCare: return 2.5
            case .mute: return 1.8
            case .factCheck: return 1.0
            case .seen: return 1.4
            }
        }

        var color: Color {
            switch self {
            case .selfCare: return CFColor.cyan
            case .mute: return CFColor.ink
            case .factCheck: return CFColor.primary
            case .seen: return CFColor.magenta
            }
        }

        var projectileShape: ProjectileShape {
            switch self {
            case .selfCare: return .circle
            case .mute: return .square
            case .factCheck: return .diamond
            case .seen: return .triangle
            }
        }

        var effect: String {
            switch self {
            case .selfCare: return "heal"
            case .mute: return "slow"
            case .factCheck: return "damage"
            case .seen: return "reveal"
            }
        }

        enum ProjectileShape {
            case circle, square, diamond, triangle
        }
    }

    struct Tower: Identifiable {
        let id = UUID()
        var kind: TowerKind
        var row: Int
        var col: Int
        var lastFired: Date = .distantPast
        var scale: CGFloat = 0.01
    }

    struct Enemy: Identifiable {
        let id = UUID()
        var kind: EnemyKind
        var lane: Int
        var x: Double
        var health: Double
        var maxHealth: Double
        var slowedUntil: Date = .distantPast
        var hitFlash: Bool = false
        var isBoss: Bool = false
        var name: String? = nil
    }

    struct Projectile: Identifiable {
        let id = UUID()
        var fromX: Double
        var fromY: Double
        var toX: Double
        var toY: Double
        var progress: Double = 0.0
        var towerKind: TowerKind
        var damage: Int
        var targetID: UUID
    }

    struct DamageNumber: Identifiable {
        let id = UUID()
        var x: CGFloat
        var y: CGFloat
        var text: String
        var color: Color
        var createdAt: Date
    }

    struct Position: Hashable {
        let row: Int
        let col: Int
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()
            switch phase {
            case .startScreen:
                startScreen
            case .playing, .waveBreak:
                gameBoard
            case .won, .lost:
                endOverlay
            }
        }
        .onAppear { setupGame() }
        .onDisappear {
            stopTimers()
            AudioEngine.shared.stopBGM()
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Start Screen

    private var startScreen: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            Text("SAFE SPOT")
                .font(CFFont.title)
                .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E / 255, green: 0xC4 / 255, blue: 0x6B / 255))

            Text("Defend your sanctuary.")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.8))

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                Text("Towers:")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream)
                towerLegend("Self Care", glyph: "cup.and.saucer.fill", color: CFColor.cyan, desc: "Heals base")
                towerLegend("Mute", glyph: "speaker.slash.fill", color: CFColor.ink, desc: "Slows enemies")
                towerLegend("Fact Check", glyph: "shield.fill", color: CFColor.primary, desc: "High damage")
                towerLegend("Seen", glyph: "eye.fill", color: CFColor.magenta, desc: "Damage + slow")
            }
            .padding(.vertical, 8)

            VStack(spacing: 8) {
                Text("Enemy Types:")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream)
                enemyLegend("Gaslighter", glyph: "ant.fill", color: CFColor.warning, desc: "Fast, weak")
                enemyLegend("Love Bomber", glyph: "heart.fill", color: CFColor.primary, desc: "Balanced")
                enemyLegend("Silent Treatment", glyph: "eye.slash.fill", color: CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5), desc: "Slow, tough")
                enemyLegend("Breadcrumb Dropper", glyph: "leaf.fill", color: Color.orange, desc: "Fast, rewarding")
            }

            Text("\(totalWaves) waves  •  \(maxSanity) sanity  •  Don't let them through.")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)

            Button("PLAY") {
                startGame()
            }
            .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: Color(red: 0x2E / 255, green: 0xC4 / 255, blue: 0x6B / 255)))
            .padding(.horizontal, 40)
        }
        .padding()
    }

    private func towerLegend(_ name: String, glyph: String, color: Color, desc: String) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            Image(systemName: glyph)
                .font(.system(size: 14, weight: .heavy))
                .foregroundStyle(color)
                .frame(width: 28, height: 28)
                .background(color.opacity(0.2))
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 4))
            Text(name)
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream)
            Text("— \(desc)")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.6))
        }
    }

    private func enemyLegend(_ name: String, glyph: String, color: Color, desc: String) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            Image(systemName: glyph)
                .font(.system(size: 12))
                .foregroundStyle(color)
            Text(name)
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(color)
            Text("(\(desc))")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.5))
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Game Board

    private var gameBoard: some View {
        ZStack {
            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                header
                laneGrid
                toolTray
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 12)
            .padding(.top, 12)
            .padding(.bottom, 14)

            if let toast = waveToast {
                VStack {
                    Spacer()
                    Text(toast)
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                        .padding(.vertical, 8)
                        .background(CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.92))
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
                        .overlay(
                            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6)
                                .stroke(CFColor.warning.opacity(0.5), lineWidth: 1)
                        )
                        .transition(.opacity)
                    Spacer()
                }
            }
        }
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.3), value: waveToast)
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                Text("SAFE SPOT")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0x2E / 255, green: 0xC4 / 255, blue: 0x6B / 255))
                if phase == .waveBreak {
                    Text("Preparing wave \(wave + 1)...")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                } else {
                    let alive = enemies.count
                    Text("Wave \(wave + 1)/\(totalWaves)  •  \(alive + waveEnemiesLeft) remaining")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.7))
                }
            }
            Spacer()
            stat(label: "SANITY", value: "\(sanity)", tint: sanity <= 2 ? CFColor.warning : CFColor.cyan)
            stat(label: "POM", value: "\(pom)", tint: CFColor.primary)
            Button("Exit") {
                showingExitAlert = true
            }
            .font(CFFont.caption)
            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
        }
    }

    private func stat(label: String, value: String, tint: Color) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            Text(label).font(CFFont.caption).foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.7))
            Text(value).font(CFFont.body).foregroundStyle(tint)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Lane Grid

    private var laneGrid: some View {
        GeometryReader { geo in
            let cellW = geo.size.width / CGFloat(cols)
            let cellH = geo.size.height / CGFloat(rows)

            ZStack {
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6)
                    .fill(CFColor.navy.opacity(0.3))

                spawnZoneOverlay(cellW: cellW, geo: geo)
                baseZoneOverlay(cellW: cellW, geo: geo)

                ForEach(0..<rows, id: \.self) { r in
                    Path { p in
                        let y = cellH * CGFloat(r)
                        p.move(to: CGPoint(x: 0, y: y))
                        p.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: geo.size.width, y: y))
                    }
                    .stroke(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.1), lineWidth: 1)
                }

                ForEach(0..<rows, id: \.self) { r in
                    ForEach(0..<cols, id: \.self) { c in
                        Rectangle()
                            .stroke(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.15), lineWidth: 1)
                            .frame(width: cellW, height: cellH)
                            .position(
                                x: cellW * (CGFloat(c) + 0.5),
                                y: cellH * (CGFloat(r) + 0.5)
                            )
                            .onTapGesture { handleCellTap(row: r, col: c) }
                    }
                }

                baseHealthBar(cellH: cellH, gridH: geo.size.height, gridW: geo.size.width)

                ForEach(towers) { tower in
                    towerView(tower, cellW: cellW, cellH: cellH)
                }

                ForEach(enemies) { enemy in
                    enemyView(enemy, cellH: cellH)
                }

                ForEach(projectiles) { proj in
                    projectileView(proj)
                }

                ForEach(damageNumbers) { dmg in
                    damageNumberView(dmg)
                }

                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6)
                    .stroke(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.5), lineWidth: 2)
            }
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
            .onAppear {
                gridWidth = geo.size.width
                gridHeight = geo.size.height
            }
            .onChange(of: geo.size) { _, newSize in
                gridWidth = newSize.width
                gridHeight = newSize.height
            }
        }
        .frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
    }

    private func spawnZoneOverlay(cellW: CGFloat, geo: GeometryProxy) -> some View {
        Rectangle()
            .fill(
                LinearGradient(
                    colors: [CFColor.warning.opacity(0.15), CFColor.warning.opacity(0.03)],
                    startPoint: .leading,
                    endPoint: .trailing
                )
            )
            .frame(width: cellW, height: geo.size.height)
            .position(x: cellW * 0.5, y: geo.size.height / 2)
            .overlay(
                Text("▶")
                    .font(.system(size: 10))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning.opacity(0.4))
                    .position(x: cellW * 0.5, y: geo.size.height / 2)
            )
    }

    private func baseZoneOverlay(cellW: CGFloat, geo: GeometryProxy) -> some View {
        Rectangle()
            .fill(
                LinearGradient(
                    colors: [CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.03), CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.15)],
                    startPoint: .leading,
                    endPoint: .trailing
                )
            )
            .frame(width: cellW, height: geo.size.height)
            .position(x: geo.size.width - cellW * 0.5, y: geo.size.height / 2)
    }

    private func baseHealthBar(cellH: CGFloat, gridH: CGFloat, gridW: CGFloat) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 2) {
            ForEach(0..<maxSanity, id: \.self) { i in
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 1)
                    .fill(i < sanity ? CFColor.cyan : CFColor.navy.opacity(0.3))
                    .frame(width: 4, height: cellH * 0.5)
            }
        }
        .position(x: gridW - 8, y: gridH / 2)
    }

    // MARK: - Entity Views

    @ViewBuilder
    private func towerView(_ tower: Tower, cellW: CGFloat, cellH: CGFloat) -> some View {
        let x = cellW * (CGFloat(tower.col) + 0.5)
        let y = cellH * (CGFloat(tower.row) + 0.5)

        ZStack {
            Image(systemName: tower.kind.glyph)
                .font(.system(size: 20, weight: .heavy))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream)
                .frame(width: 36, height: 36)
                .background(tower.kind.color)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
                .overlay(
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6)
                        .stroke(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.6), lineWidth: 1)
                )
        }
        .scaleEffect(tower.scale)
        .position(x: x, y: y)
        .onTapGesture { sellTower(tower) }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func enemyView(_ enemy: Enemy, cellH: CGFloat) -> some View {
        let x = CGFloat(enemy.x)
        let y = cellH * (CGFloat(enemy.lane) + 0.5)

        ZStack {
            if enemy.isBoss {
                Image(systemName: enemy.kind.glyph)
                    .font(.system(size: 28))
                    .foregroundStyle(enemy.kind.color.opacity(0.3))
            }
            Image(systemName: enemy.kind.glyph)
                .font(.system(size: enemy.isBoss ? 24 : 16, weight: .heavy))
                .foregroundStyle(enemy.hitFlash ? Color.white : enemy.kind.color)
        }
        .position(x: x, y: y)

        let barW: CGFloat = enemy.isBoss ? 40 : 28
        let healthPct = CGFloat(enemy.health / enemy.maxHealth)
        ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
            Rectangle()
                .fill(Color.black.opacity(0.5))
                .frame(width: barW, height: 3)
            Rectangle()
                .fill(healthPct > 0.5 ? Color.green : healthPct > 0.25 ? Color.yellow : Color.red)
                .frame(width: barW * healthPct, height: 3)
        }
        .position(x: x, y: y - (enemy.isBoss ? 22 : 16))

        if let name = enemy.name {
            Text(name)
                .font(.system(size: 7, weight: .semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.8))
                .frame(maxWidth: 60)
                .position(x: x, y: y + (enemy.isBoss ? 22 : 16))
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func projectileView(_ proj: Projectile) -> some View {
        let x = proj.fromX + (proj.toX - proj.fromX) * proj.progress
        let y = proj.fromY + (proj.toY - proj.fromY) * proj.progress

        switch proj.towerKind.projectileShape {
        case .circle:
            Circle()
                .fill(proj.towerKind.color)
                .frame(width: 10, height: 10)
                .position(x: x, y: y)
        case .square:
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 2)
                .fill(proj.towerKind.color)
                .frame(width: 8, height: 8)
                .position(x: x, y: y)
        case .diamond:
            Rectangle()
                .fill(proj.towerKind.color)
                .frame(width: 8, height: 8)
                .rotationEffect(.degrees(45))
                .position(x: x, y: y)
        case .triangle:
            Triangle()
                .fill(proj.towerKind.color)
                .frame(width: 9, height: 9)
                .position(x: x, y: y)
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func damageNumberView(_ dmg: DamageNumber) -> some View {
        let age = Date().timeIntervalSince(dmg.createdAt)
        let opacity = max(0, 1.0 - age / 0.8)
        let yOff = CGFloat(age) * -30
        Text(dmg.text)
            .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold))
            .foregroundStyle(dmg.color.opacity(opacity))
            .position(x: dmg.x, y: dmg.y + yOff)
    }

    // MARK: - Tool Tray

    private var toolTray: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 8) {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                ForEach(TowerKind.allCases, id: \.self) { kind in
                    toolButton(kind: kind)
                }
            }

            if selectedTowerKind != nil {
                Text("Tap grid to place  •  Tap tower to sell (50%)")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.7))
            }
        }
    }

    private func toolButton(kind: TowerKind) -> some View {
        let canAfford = pom >= kind.cost
        let isSelected = selectedTowerKind == kind

        return VStack(spacing: 4) {
            Image(systemName: kind.glyph)
                .font(.system(size: 18, weight: .heavy))
                .foregroundStyle(canAfford ? CFColor.cream : CFColor.cream.opacity(0.4))
                .frame(width: 44, height: 44)
                .background(isSelected ? kind.color.opacity(0.5) : kind.color)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
                .overlay(
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6)
                        .stroke(
                            isSelected ? CFColor.cream : CFColor.cream.opacity(0.6),
                            lineWidth: isSelected ? 2 : 1
                        )
                )
                .opacity(canAfford ? 1.0 : 0.5)
                .onTapGesture {
                    guard canAfford else { return }
                    selectedTowerKind = selectedTowerKind == kind ? nil : kind
                }

            Text(kind.rawValue)
                .font(.system(size: 9))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cream.opacity(0.85))
            Text("\(kind.cost) POM")
                .font(.system(size: 9))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
    }

    // MARK: - End Overlay

    private var endOverlay: some View {
        ZStack {
            ArcadeGameOverOverlay(
                title: phase == .won ? "SANCTUARY HELD!" : "OVERWHELMED",
                subtitle: phase == .won ? "All \(totalWaves) waves survived" : "Fell at wave \(wave + 1)",
                detail: phase == .won ? "You held the line." : "The gaslighters broke through.",
                tintColor: phase == .won
                    ? Color(red: 0x2E / 255, green: 0xC4 / 255, blue: 0x6B / 255)
                    : CFColor.warning,
                onPlayAgain: {
                    setupGame()
                    startGame()
                },
                onExit: {
                    router.fire(
                        .didEnd(.safeSpot, outcome: phase == .won ? .won : .lost),
                        run: gameState.run
                    )
                    onExit()
                }
            )

            if showingExitAlert {
                ArcadeExitAlert(isPresented: $showingExitAlert) {
                    stopTimers()
                    router.fire(.didEnd(.safeSpot, outcome: .exited), run: gameState.run)
                    onExit()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Game Logic

    private func setupGame() {
        phase = .startScreen
        wave = 0
        sanity = maxSanity
        pom = 100
        towers = []
        enemies = []
        projectiles = []
        damageNumbers = []
        selectedTowerKind = nil
        waveEnemiesLeft = 0
        spawnIndex = 0
        waveToast = nil
        namedEnemyLabel = nil
        stopTimers()
    }

    private func startGame() {
        phase = .playing
        wave = 0
        lastTick = .now
        startWave()
        startGameTimer()
        AudioEngine.shared.startBGM(.arcadeGeneral)
    }

    private func startGameTimer() {
        gameTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 1.0 / 60.0, repeats: true) { _ in
            self.tick()
        }
    }

    private func stopTimers() {
        gameTimer?.invalidate()
        gameTimer = nil
        spawnTimer?.invalidate()
        spawnTimer = nil
    }

    private var waveConfig: [EnemyKind] {
        switch wave {
        case 0: return [.gaslighter, .gaslighter, .gaslighter]
        case 1: return [.gaslighter, .gaslighter, .loveBomber, .loveBomber]
        case 2: return [.gaslighter, .loveBomber, .loveBomber, .silentTreatment, .gaslighter]
        case 3:
            return [.loveBomber, .silentTreatment, .breadcrumbDropper, .loveBomber,
                    .silentTreatment, .breadcrumbDropper]
        default:
            return [.gaslighter, .loveBomber, .silentTreatment, .breadcrumbDropper,
                    .gaslighter, .loveBomber, .silentTreatment]
        }
    }

    private func startWave() {
        let config = waveConfig
        waveEnemiesLeft = config.count
        spawnIndex = 0

        spawnTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 1.2, repeats: true) { timer in
            guard self.spawnIndex < config.count, self.phase == .playing else {
                timer.invalidate()
                return
            }
            let isBoss = (self.wave == self.totalWaves - 1) && (self.spawnIndex == config.count - 1)
            self.spawnEnemy(kind: config[self.spawnIndex], isBoss: isBoss)
            self.spawnIndex += 1
        }

        let payloads = router.fire(.willStart(.safeSpot), run: gameState.run)
        for payload in payloads {
            if case .namedEnemy(let name) = payload.kind {
                namedEnemyLabel = name
            }
        }
    }

    private func spawnEnemy(kind: EnemyKind, isBoss: Bool = false) {
        let lane = Int.random(in: 0..<rows)
        let health = isBoss ? kind.health * 3 : kind.health

        var enemy = Enemy(
            kind: kind,
            lane: lane,
            x: -20,
            health: health,
            maxHealth: health,
            isBoss: isBoss
        )

        if let name = namedEnemyLabel, !isBoss {
            enemy.name = name
            namedEnemyLabel = nil
        }

        enemies.append(enemy)
        waveEnemiesLeft -= 1

        router.fire(
            .contentSelected(source: .safeSpot, key: "enemyAppears", value: kind.rawValue),
            run: gameState.run
        )
    }

    private func tick() {
        guard phase == .playing, gridWidth > 0 else { return }

        let now = Date()
        let dt = min(now.timeIntervalSince(lastTick), 0.05)
        lastTick = now

        moveEnemies(dt: dt)
        fireTowers()
        moveProjectiles(dt: dt)
        checkProjectileHits()
        cleanupDamageNumbers()
        checkWaveComplete()
        checkGameOver()
    }

    private func moveEnemies(dt: Double) {
        var reachedBase: [UUID] = []

        for i in enemies.indices {
            let speed = enemies[i].slowedUntil > Date()
                ? enemies[i].kind.speed * 0.35
                : enemies[i].kind.speed
            enemies[i].x += speed * dt

            if enemies[i].x >= Double(gridWidth) {
                reachedBase.append(enemies[i].id)
            }
        }

        for id in reachedBase {
            enemies.removeAll { $0.id == id }
            sanity -= 1
            AudioEngine.shared.play(.affinityDown, gain: 0.7)
        }
    }

    private func fireTowers() {
        guard gridWidth > 0, gridHeight > 0 else { return }
        let cellW = gridWidth / CGFloat(cols)
        let cellH = gridHeight / CGFloat(rows)
        let now = Date()

        for i in towers.indices {
            var tower = towers[i]
            guard now.timeIntervalSince(tower.lastFired) >= tower.kind.fireRate else { continue }

            let towerX = Double(cellW * (CGFloat(tower.col) + 0.5))
            let towerY = Double(cellH * (CGFloat(tower.row) + 0.5))

            var nearestEnemy: Enemy? = nil
            var nearestDist: Double = .infinity

            for enemy in enemies {
                let enemyY = Double(cellH * (CGFloat(enemy.lane) + 0.5))
                let dist = sqrt(pow(enemy.x - towerX, 2) + pow(enemyY - towerY, 2))

                if dist <= tower.kind.range && dist < nearestDist {
                    nearestDist = dist
                    nearestEnemy = enemy
                }
            }

            if let target = nearestEnemy {
                tower.lastFired = now
                towers[i] = tower

                let targetY = Double(cellH * (CGFloat(target.lane) + 0.5))
                let proj = Projectile(
                    fromX: towerX,
                    fromY: towerY,
                    toX: target.x,
                    toY: targetY,
                    towerKind: tower.kind,
                    damage: tower.kind.damage,
                    targetID: target.id
                )
                projectiles.append(proj)

                if tower.kind.effect == "heal" {
                    sanity = min(sanity + 1, maxSanity)
                    let targetID = target.id
                    DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.05) {
                        if let idx = self.enemies.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == targetID }) {
                            let ey = Double(cellH * (CGFloat(self.enemies[idx].lane) + 0.5))
                            self.damageNumbers.append(DamageNumber(
                                x: CGFloat(self.enemies[idx].x),
                                y: CGFloat(ey) - 20,
                                text: "+1 ♥",
                                color: .green,
                                createdAt: .now
                            ))
                        }
                    }
                }

                if tower.kind.effect == "slow" || tower.kind.effect == "reveal" {
                    if let idx = enemies.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == target.id }) {
                        enemies[idx].slowedUntil = now.addingTimeInterval(2.0)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func moveProjectiles(dt: Double) {
        for i in projectiles.indices {
            projectiles[i].progress += dt * 3.0
        }
    }

    private func checkProjectileHits() {
        var killedIDs: [UUID] = []
        let cellH = gridHeight / CGFloat(rows)

        for proj in projectiles where proj.progress >= 1.0 {
            if let idx = enemies.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == proj.targetID }) {
                let enemy = enemies[idx]

                if proj.damage > 0 {
                    enemies[idx].health -= Double(proj.damage)
                    enemies[idx].hitFlash = true

                    let ey = Double(cellH * (CGFloat(enemy.lane) + 0.5))
                    damageNumbers.append(DamageNumber(
                        x: CGFloat(enemy.x),
                        y: CGFloat(ey) - 24,
                        text: "-\(proj.damage)",
                        color: proj.towerKind.color,
                        createdAt: .now
                    ))

                    let targetID = enemy.id
                    DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.1) {
                        if let i = self.enemies.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == targetID }) {
                            self.enemies[i].hitFlash = false
                        }
                    }
                }

                if enemies[idx].health <= 0 {
                    let reward = enemy.kind.reward + (enemy.isBoss ? enemy.kind.reward * 2 : 0)
                    pom += reward
                    killedIDs.append(enemy.id)
                    AudioEngine.shared.play(.affinityUp, gain: 0.5)

                    let killKey = enemy.isBoss ? "bossKilled" : "enemyKilled"
                    let killVal = enemy.isBoss ? "boss" : enemy.kind.rawValue
                    let payloads = router.fire(
                        .contentSelected(source: .safeSpot, key: killKey, value: killVal),
                        run: gameState.run
                    )
                    for payload in payloads {
                        if case .factReveal = payload.kind {
                            router.latestToast = .init(
                                id: UUID().uuidString,
                                kind: payload.kind
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        enemies.removeAll { killedIDs.contains($0.id) }
        projectiles.removeAll { $0.progress >= 1.0 }
    }

    private func cleanupDamageNumbers() {
        damageNumbers.removeAll { Date().timeIntervalSince($0.createdAt) > 0.8 }
    }

    private func checkWaveComplete() {
        guard enemies.isEmpty, waveEnemiesLeft <= 0, phase == .playing else { return }

        wave += 1
        if wave >= totalWaves {
            phase = .won
            stopTimers()
            AudioEngine.shared.stopBGM()
            AudioEngine.shared.play(.matchCelebration)
            router.fire(.didEnd(.safeSpot, outcome: .won), run: gameState.run)
        } else {
            phase = .waveBreak
            waveToast = "Wave \(wave + 1) incoming..."
            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2.0) {
                if self.phase == .waveBreak {
                    self.waveToast = nil
                    self.phase = .playing
                    self.startWave()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func checkGameOver() {
        guard sanity <= 0, phase == .playing else { return }
        phase = .lost
        stopTimers()
        AudioEngine.shared.stopBGM()
        AudioEngine.shared.play(.errorSoft)
        router.fire(.didEnd(.safeSpot, outcome: .lost), run: gameState.run)
    }

    // MARK: - Player Actions

    private func handleCellTap(row: Int, col: Int) {
        if towers.contains(where: { $0.row == row && $0.col == col }) {
            if let existing = towers.first(where: { $0.row == row && $0.col == col }) {
                sellTower(existing)
            }
            return
        }

        guard col > 0, col < cols - 1 else { return }

        guard let kind = selectedTowerKind else { return }
        guard pom >= kind.cost else { return }

        pom -= kind.cost
        var tower = Tower(kind: kind, row: row, col: col)
        towers.append(tower)
        selectedTowerKind = nil
        AudioEngine.shared.play(.buttonTapPrimary, gain: 0.6)

        let newID = tower.id
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.05) {
            if let idx = self.towers.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == newID }) {
                withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.6)) {
                    self.towers[idx].scale = 1.0
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func sellTower(_ tower: Tower) {
        let refund = tower.kind.cost / 2
        pom += refund
        towers.removeAll { $0.id == tower.id }
    }
}

private struct Triangle: Shape {
    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        var path = Path()
        path.move(to: CGPoint(x: rect.midX, y: rect.minY))
        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.maxX, y: rect.maxY))
        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.minX, y: rect.maxY))
        path.closeSubpath()
        return path
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Date/DateDirector.swift">
import Foundation

// MARK: - Voice Manifest Support

private struct DateDirectorManifest: Codable {
    let lines: [DateDirectorManifestEntry]
}

private struct DateDirectorManifestEntry: Codable {
    let voiceLineID: String
    let text: String
}

protocol DateDirectorEastworldClient {
    func nextLine(sceneID: String, partnerID: String, playerInput: String) async throws -> String
}

protocol DateDirectorVoicePlayer {
    func play(lineID: String, fallbackText: String) async
}

protocol DateDirectorSceneRenderer {
    func showNarration(_ text: String)
    func showPartnerLine(_ text: String, expression: DateSpriteExpression)
    func showChoicePrompt(options: [ChoiceOption]) async -> ChoiceOption
    func runFocusShift(_ beat: FocusShiftBeat)
    func showTypingIndicator(_ isVisible: Bool)
}

protocol DateDirectorPersistence {
    func loadCheckpoint(sceneID: String) throws -> DateCheckpoint?
    func saveCheckpoint(_ checkpoint: DateCheckpoint) throws
    func markFactDiscovered(_ factID: String) throws
    func writeDateOutcome(_ outcome: DateOutcome) throws
    func updateAffinity(delta: Int) throws
}

enum DateDirectorError: Error {
    case missingBeatTarget(String)
    case eastworldTurnLimitReached
}

/// Orchestrates a date scene by stepping through authored beats and dispatching
/// rendering, voice playback, Eastworld turns, and persistence side effects.
@MainActor
final class DateDirector {
    private let scene: DateScene
    private let eastworld: DateDirectorEastworldClient
    private let voicePlayer: DateDirectorVoicePlayer
    private let renderer: DateDirectorSceneRenderer
    private let persistence: DateDirectorPersistence
    private let context: DateSceneContext

    private let maxEastworldTurns: Int
    private let eastworldTimeoutNanoseconds: UInt64

    private var beatIndex: Int = 0
    private var lastChoice: ChoiceOption?
    private var eastworldTurns: Int = 0
    private var runningAffinityDelta: Int = 0
    private var revealedFactIDs = Set<String>()

    private lazy var voiceManifest: [String: String]? = {
        guard let url = Bundle.main.url(forResource: "voice_manifest", withExtension: "json", subdirectory: "Resources/Voice"),
              let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url),
              let manifest = try? JSONDecoder().decode(DateDirectorManifest.self, from: data) else {
            return nil
        }
        return Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: manifest.lines.map { ($0.voiceLineID, $0.text) })
    }()

    init(
        scene: DateScene,
        eastworld: DateDirectorEastworldClient,
        voicePlayer: DateDirectorVoicePlayer,
        renderer: DateDirectorSceneRenderer,
        persistence: DateDirectorPersistence,
        context: DateSceneContext,
        maxEastworldTurns: Int = 8,
        eastworldTimeoutSeconds: UInt64 = 4
    ) {
        self.scene = scene
        self.eastworld = eastworld
        self.voicePlayer = voicePlayer
        self.renderer = renderer
        self.persistence = persistence
        self.context = context
        self.maxEastworldTurns = maxEastworldTurns
        self.eastworldTimeoutNanoseconds = eastworldTimeoutSeconds * 1_000_000_000
    }

    func play() async throws {
        try restoreCheckpointIfPresent()
        if beatIndex == 0 {
            renderer.showNarration(scene.openingNarration.text)
            await voicePlayer.play(
                lineID: scene.openingNarration.voiceLineID,
                fallbackText: scene.openingNarration.text
            )
        }

        while beatIndex < scene.beats.count {
            let beat = scene.beats[beatIndex]
            switch beat {
            case .scripted(let scripted):
                let variant = resolveVariant(for: scripted)
                let lineText = lineText(for: variant.voiceLineID)
                renderer.showPartnerLine(lineText, expression: spriteExpression(for: variant.expression))
                await voicePlayer.play(lineID: variant.voiceLineID, fallbackText: lineText)
                if scripted.focusShift {
                    renderer.runFocusShift(.init(beatID: "\(scripted.beatID)_focus", mode: "firstPerson", transitionMS: 400))
                }
                if let factReveal = variant.factReveal {
                    try persistence.markFactDiscovered(factReveal)
                    revealedFactIDs.insert(factReveal)
                }
                try advanceToNextBeat()

            case .eastworld(let ambient):
                try await handleEastworldBeat(ambient)

            case .choice(let choice):
                try await handleChoiceBeat(choice)

            case .focusShift(let focus):
                renderer.runFocusShift(focus)
                try advanceToNextBeat()

            case .factReveal(let reveal):
                try persistence.markFactDiscovered(reveal.factID)
                revealedFactIDs.insert(reveal.factID)
                try advanceToNextBeat()

            case .end(let end):
                try finalize(end: end)
                return
            }
        }

        try finalize(end: EndBeat(beatID: "auto_end", scheduleFollowUp: false))
    }

    private func handleChoiceBeat(_ beat: ChoiceBeat) async throws {
        let picked = await renderer.showChoicePrompt(options: beat.choices)
        lastChoice = picked
        runningAffinityDelta += picked.affinityDelta
        try persistence.updateAffinity(delta: picked.affinityDelta)

        if picked.tellEligible, skipSingleAmbientBeatForFocusShift() {
            try saveCheckpoint()
            return
        }

        if let branch = picked.nextBeatID {
            beatIndex = try indexForBeatID(branch)
            try saveCheckpoint()
            return
        }

        try advanceToNextBeat()
    }

    private func handleEastworldBeat(_ beat: EastworldBeat) async throws {
        guard eastworldTurns < maxEastworldTurns else {
            throw DateDirectorError.eastworldTurnLimitReached
        }

        eastworldTurns += 1
        renderer.showTypingIndicator(true)
        defer { renderer.showTypingIndicator(false) }

        let fallbackLine = lineText(for: beat.fallbackVoiceLineID)
        let playerInput = lastChoice?.label ?? beat.prompt ?? "small talk"

        let line: String
        do {
            line = try await withTimeout(nanoseconds: eastworldTimeoutNanoseconds) {
                try await self.eastworld.nextLine(
                    sceneID: self.scene.id,
                    partnerID: self.scene.partner,
                    playerInput: playerInput
                )
            }
        } catch {
            line = fallbackLine
        }

        renderer.showPartnerLine(line, expression: .curious)
        await voicePlayer.play(lineID: "eastworld:", fallbackText: line)
        try advanceToNextBeat()
    }

    private func restoreCheckpointIfPresent() throws {
        guard let checkpoint = try persistence.loadCheckpoint(sceneID: scene.id) else { return }
        guard checkpoint.nextBeatIndex < scene.beats.count else {
            // Stale checkpoint, reset to beginning
            beatIndex = 0
            return
        }
        beatIndex = checkpoint.nextBeatIndex
        runningAffinityDelta = checkpoint.runningAffinity
        eastworldTurns = checkpoint.eastworldTurns
    }

    private func advanceToNextBeat() throws {
        beatIndex += 1
        try saveCheckpoint()
    }

    private func saveCheckpoint() throws {
        try persistence.saveCheckpoint(
            DateCheckpoint(
                sceneID: scene.id,
                nextBeatIndex: beatIndex,
                runningAffinity: runningAffinityDelta,
                lastChoiceID: lastChoice?.id,
                eastworldTurns: eastworldTurns
            )
        )
    }

    private func finalize(end: EndBeat) throws {
        let outcome = DateOutcome(
            sceneID: scene.id,
            revealedFactIDs: Array(revealedFactIDs).sorted(),
            affinityDelta: runningAffinityDelta,
            followUpScheduled: end.scheduleFollowUp || runningAffinityDelta > 0,
            endedAt: Date()
        )
        try persistence.writeDateOutcome(outcome)
        try saveCheckpoint()
    }

    private func indexForBeatID(_ id: String) throws -> Int {
        for (idx, beat) in scene.beats.enumerated() {
            if beat.beatID == id {
                return idx
            }
        }
        throw DateDirectorError.missingBeatTarget(id)
    }

    private func skipSingleAmbientBeatForFocusShift() -> Bool {
        let nextIndex = beatIndex + 1
        guard nextIndex < scene.beats.count else { return false }
        guard case .eastworld = scene.beats[nextIndex] else {
            return false
        }
        beatIndex = nextIndex + 1
        return true
    }

    private func resolveVariant(for beat: ScriptedBeat) -> ScriptedVariant {
        for variant in beat.variants where conditionMatches(variant.condition) {
            return variant
        }
        return beat.variants.last ?? .init(condition: "default", voiceLineID: "missing_line", expression: "neutral", factReveal: nil)
    }

    private func conditionMatches(_ condition: String) -> Bool {
        let normalized = condition.replacingOccurrences(of: " ", with: "")
        if normalized == "default" {
            return true
        }
        if normalized == "isKiller==true" {
            return scene.partner == context.killerID
        }
        if normalized == "isKiller==false" {
            return scene.partner != context.killerID
        }
        if normalized.hasPrefix("affinity>="), let value = Int(normalized.replacingOccurrences(of: "affinity>=", with: "")) {
            return context.affinity + runningAffinityDelta >= value
        }
        if normalized.hasPrefix("dayNumber=="), let value = Int(normalized.replacingOccurrences(of: "dayNumber==", with: "")) {
            return context.dayNumber == value
        }
        if normalized.hasPrefix("factDiscovered(\""), normalized.hasSuffix("\")") {
            let factID = String(normalized.dropFirst("factDiscovered(\"".count).dropLast(2))
            return context.discoveredFactIDs.contains(factID) || revealedFactIDs.contains(factID)
        }
        return false
    }

    private func lineText(for voiceLineID: String) -> String {
        if let manifest = voiceManifest, let text = manifest[voiceLineID] {
            return text
        }
        return voiceLineID.replacingOccurrences(of: "_", with: " ").capitalized
    }

    private func spriteExpression(for rawValue: String) -> DateSpriteExpression {
        switch rawValue.lowercased() {
        case "smile": return .smile
        case "flirty": return .flirty
        case "curious": return .curious
        case "uneasy": return .uneasy
        case "sinister": return .sinister
        case "neutral_saintmask": return .neutralSaintmask
        default: return .neutral
        }
    }

    private static let ambientFallbackLines = [
        "Sorry, I spaced out for a second.",
        "Wait, where were we?",
        "I keep getting distracted in here."
    ]
}

private func withTimeout<T>(
    nanoseconds: UInt64,
    operation: @escaping () async throws -> T
) async throws -> T {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: T.self) { group in
        group.addTask { try await operation() }
        group.addTask {
            try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: nanoseconds)
            throw CancellationError()
        }

        guard let first = try await group.next() else {
            throw CancellationError()
        }
        group.cancelAll()
        return first
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Swipe/SwipeView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

/// The swipe tab. Shows the top card with the next card peeking underneath,
/// handles the match celebration overlay, and an empty state when the deck
/// is exhausted.
struct SwipeView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState
    @Environment(OnboardingManager.self) private var onboarding

    @State private var viewModel: SwipeDeckViewModel?
    @State private var matchOverlay: CharacterID? = nil
    @State private var chatMatch: MatchRelationship? = nil

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            if let vm = viewModel {
                content(vm: vm)
            } else {
                ProgressView().tint(CFColor.primary)
            }

            if let matched = matchOverlay {
                MatchCelebrationOverlay(
                    character: matched,
                    onSendMessage: {
                        matchOverlay = nil
                        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<MatchRelationship>(
                            predicate: #Predicate<MatchRelationship> { $0.characterRaw == matched.rawValue }
                        )
                        chatMatch = try? context.fetch(descriptor).first
                    },
                    onKeepSwiping: {
                        matchOverlay = nil
                    }
                )
                .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .scale(scale: 1.05)))
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            if viewModel == nil {
                viewModel = SwipeDeckViewModel(context: context, gameState: gameState)
            }
            viewModel?.refresh()
        }
        .fullScreenCover(item: $chatMatch) { match in
            ChatView(match: match)
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func content(vm: SwipeDeckViewModel) -> some View {
        if let top = vm.topCard {
            deck(vm: vm, top: top)
        } else {
            emptyState
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Deck

    @ViewBuilder
    private func deck(vm: SwipeDeckViewModel, top: CandidateProfile) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            header
            ZStack {
                // Peek of the next card.
                if vm.queue.count > 1 {
                    peekCard(profile: vm.queue[1])
                }
                SwipeCard(profile: top) { direction in
                    switch direction {
                    case .left:
                        AudioEngine.shared.play(.swipeLeft)
                        vm.swipeLeft()
                    case .right:
                        AudioEngine.shared.play(.swipeRight)
                        vm.swipeRight()
                        let wasOnboardingSwipe = onboarding.currentStep == .swipeAndMatch
                        withAnimation { matchOverlay = top.id }
                        if wasOnboardingSwipe {
                            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2.0) {
                                onboarding.advance()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Key on id so the drag state resets between cards.
                .id(top.id)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 20)
            actionBar(vm: vm)
        }
        .padding(.vertical, 12)
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack {
            AssetImage("A002_game_logo_wordmark")
                .frame(height: 34)
                .frame(maxWidth: 160)
            Spacer()
            Text("Day \(gameState.currentDay)")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                .padding(.horizontal, 12).padding(.vertical, 6)
                .background(CFColor.ink)
                .clipShape(Capsule())
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 20)
    }

    private func peekCard(profile: CandidateProfile) -> some View {
        GeometryReader { _ in
            SwipeCard(profile: profile) { _ in }
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
                .scaleEffect(0.95)
                .opacity(0.6)
                .offset(y: 10)
        }
    }

    private func actionBar(vm: SwipeDeckViewModel) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 24) {
            Button(action: {
                AudioEngine.shared.play(.swipeLeft)
                vm.swipeLeft()
            }) {
                Image(systemName: "xmark")
                    .font(.system(size: 26, weight: .heavy))
            }
            .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.warning, sound: nil))
            .frame(width: 80)

            Button(action: {
                let pendingCard = vm.topCard
                AudioEngine.shared.play(.swipeRight)
                vm.swipeRight()
                if let card = pendingCard {
                    withAnimation { matchOverlay = card.id }
                }
                if onboarding.currentStep == .swipeAndMatch {
                    DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2.0) {
                        onboarding.advance()
                    }
                }
            }) {
                Image(systemName: "heart.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 26, weight: .heavy))
            }
            .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary, sound: nil))
            .frame(width: 80)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 60)
        .padding(.top, 4)
    }

    // MARK: - Empty state

    private var emptyState: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            Image(systemName: "person.2.slash")
                .font(.system(size: 52))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
            Text("No one new around here.")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Text("Check your matches for messages.")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        }
        .padding(40)
    }
}

// MARK: - Match celebration

/// The "It's a Match!" overlay that fires on a right-swipe commit.
/// Uses the generated match_burst art as the hero visual and lets the
/// player dismiss to chat or keep swiping.
struct MatchCelebrationOverlay: View {
    let character: CharacterID
    var onSendMessage: () -> Void
    var onKeepSwiping: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.9).ignoresSafeArea()
            VStack(spacing: 24) {
                AssetImage("A007_match_burst")
                    .frame(height: 240)

                Text("You matched with \(character.displayName)!")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                VStack(spacing: 10) {
                    Button(action: onSendMessage) {
                        Text("Send a message")
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))

                    Button(action: onKeepSwiping) {
                        Text("Keep swiping")
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.ink, sound: .buttonTapSecondary))
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 40)
            }
            .padding(.vertical, 40)
        }
        .onAppear {
            AudioEngine.shared.play(.matchCelebration)
            AudioEngine.shared.play(.matchFirstMessageTone, gain: 0.5)
        }
    }
}

<file path="catfish/Features/Journal/AccusationView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct AccusationView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    @Query private var allDiscovered: [DiscoveredFact]
    @Query private var allFacts: [Fact]

    @State private var step = 1
    @State private var selectedCharacter: CharacterID?
    @State private var selectedChainIDs: Set<String> = []
    @State private var showingResult = false
    @State private var result: AccusationResult?
    @State private var showLowEvidenceWarning = false

    private var discoveredForRun: Set<String> {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }
        return Set(allDiscovered.filter { $0.run?.id == run.id }.map(\.factID))
    }

    private var completedChains: [EvidenceChainContent] {
        let discovered = discoveredForRun
        return ContentStore.shared.allEvidenceChains.filter { chain in
            chain.factIDs.allSatisfy { discovered.contains($0) }
        }
    }

    private func evidenceStrength(for character: CharacterID) -> Double {
        let chains = completedChains.filter { $0.impliedKiller == character.rawValue }
        let totalWeight = chains.reduce(0.0) { $0 + $1.weight }
        let factsAbout = allFacts.filter {
            guard let run = gameState.run else { return false }
            return $0.run?.id == run.id && $0.aboutCharacter == character && discoveredForRun.contains($0.id)
        }
        let factBonus = Double(min(factsAbout.count, 5)) * 0.05
        return min(totalWeight + factBonus, 1.0)
    }

    private func evidenceLabel(for character: CharacterID) -> String {
        let strength = evidenceStrength(for: character)
        if strength >= 0.8 { return "STRONG" }
        if strength >= 0.4 { return "MODERATE" }
        if strength > 0 { return "WEAK" }
        return "NONE"
    }

    private func strengthColor(_ strength: Double) -> Color {
        if strength >= 0.8 { return CFColor.warning }
        if strength >= 0.4 { return Color(red: 0xFF/255, green: 0xD7/255, blue: 0x00/255) }
        if strength > 0 { return CFColor.cyan }
        return CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.3)
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                stepIndicator

                switch step {
                case 1:
                    reviewStep
                case 2:
                    nameKillerStep
                case 3:
                    presentCaseStep
                default:
                    EmptyView()
                }
            }
            .padding()

            if showingResult, let result {
                resultOverlay(result: result)
            }

            if showLowEvidenceWarning {
                lowEvidenceWarning
            }
        }
    }

    private var stepIndicator: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            ForEach(1...3, id: \.self) { s in
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    Circle()
                        .fill(s <= step ? CFColor.primary : CFColor.ink)
                        .frame(width: 8, height: 8)
                    if s < 3 {
                        Rectangle()
                            .fill(s < step ? CFColor.primary : CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
                            .frame(height: 2)
                    }
                }
            }

            Spacer()

            if step > 1 {
                Button("Back") {
                    withAnimation { step -= 1 }
                }
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
            }
        }
    }

    private var stepLabel: some View {
        Group {
            switch step {
            case 1:
                Text("STEP 1: REVIEW EVIDENCE")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                    .tracking(2)
            case 2:
                Text("STEP 2: NAME THE KILLER")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                    .tracking(2)
            case 3:
                Text("STEP 3: PRESENT YOUR CASE")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                    .tracking(2)
            default:
                EmptyView()
            }
        }
    }

    private var reviewStep: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
                stepLabel

                Text("Review your completed evidence chains before naming your suspect.")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))

                if completedChains.isEmpty {
                    Text("No evidence chains completed yet. Link facts in the Evidence Chains section to build your case.")
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
                        .padding()
                } else {
                    ForEach(completedChains, id: \.id) { chain in
                        chainReviewRow(chain)
                    }
                }

                evidenceStrengthBars

                Button("CONTINUE") {
                    withAnimation { step = 2 }
                }
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .padding()
                .background(CFColor.primary)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
                .padding(.top, 8)
            }
        }
    }

    private func chainReviewRow(_ chain: EvidenceChainContent) -> some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 8) {
            Image(systemName: "link.circle.fill")
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                .font(.system(size: 14))

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                Text(chain.summary)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                if let character = CharacterID(rawValue: chain.impliedKiller) {
                    HStack(spacing: 4) {
                        Text("Points toward:")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
                        Text(character.displayName)
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(10)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.3))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
    }

    private var evidenceStrengthBars: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            Text("EVIDENCE STRENGTH")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                .tracking(2)

            ForEach(CharacterID.allCases) { character in
                let strength = evidenceStrength(for: character)
                let label = evidenceLabel(for: character)

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    HStack {
                        Text(character.displayName)
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                        Spacer()

                        Text(label)
                            .font(.system(size: 8, weight: .bold))
                            .foregroundStyle(strengthColor(strength))
                    }

                    GeometryReader { geo in
                        ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 3)
                                .fill(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.6))
                                .frame(height: 6)

                            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 3)
                                .fill(strengthColor(strength))
                                .frame(width: geo.size.width * strength, height: 6)
                        }
                    }
                    .frame(height: 6)
                }
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.4))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
    }

    private var nameKillerStep: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                stepLabel

                Text("Select who you believe is the killer.")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))

                LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.flexible()), GridItem(.flexible())], spacing: 12) {
                    ForEach(CharacterID.allCases) { character in
                        accusationButton(for: character)
                    }
                }

                if let character = selectedCharacter {
                    evidencePreview(for: character)

                    Button("CONTINUE") {
                        let strength = evidenceStrength(for: character)
                        if strength < 0.3 {
                            showLowEvidenceWarning = true
                        } else {
                            withAnimation { step = 3 }
                        }
                    }
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding()
                    .background(CFColor.warning)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func accusationButton(for character: CharacterID) -> some View {
        let isSelected = selectedCharacter == character
        let strength = evidenceStrength(for: character)

        return Button {
            selectedCharacter = character
        } label: {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                AssetImage(character.portraitAssetID)
                    .frame(width: 64, height: 64)
                    .clipShape(Circle())
                    .overlay(
                        Circle()
                            .stroke(isSelected ? CFColor.warning : strengthColor(strength), lineWidth: isSelected ? 3 : 1.5)
                    )

                Text(character.displayName)
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                Text(evidenceLabel(for: character))
                    .font(.system(size: 8, weight: .bold))
                    .foregroundStyle(strengthColor(strength))
            }
            .padding()
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .background(isSelected ? CFColor.ink.opacity(0.8) : CFColor.ink.opacity(0.4))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private func evidencePreview(for character: CharacterID) -> some View {
        let chains = completedChains.filter { $0.impliedKiller == character.rawValue }

        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text("Your case against \(character.displayName):")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

            if chains.isEmpty {
                Text("No evidence chains pointing toward this suspect.")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
            } else {
                ForEach(chains, id: \.id) { chain in
                    Text("• \(chain.summary)")
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.8))
                }
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.4))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
    }

    private var presentCaseStep: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                stepLabel

                Text("Select your top 3 evidence chains as proof.")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))

                if let character = selectedCharacter {
                    Text("Accusing: \(character.displayName)")
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                }

                if completedChains.isEmpty {
                    Text("No evidence chains available.")
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
                        .padding()
                } else {
                    ForEach(completedChains, id: \.id) { chain in
                        chainSelectionRow(chain)
                    }
                }

                let selectedCount = selectedChainIDs.count
                Button {
                    makeAccusation()
                } label: {
                    Text(selectedCount > 0 ? "ACCUSE WITH \(selectedCount) CHAIN\(selectedCount == 1 ? "" : "S")" : "ACCUSE WITHOUT EVIDENCE")
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                        .padding()
                        .background(CFColor.warning)
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func chainSelectionRow(_ chain: EvidenceChainContent) -> some View {
        let isSelected = selectedChainIDs.contains(chain.id)

        return Button {
            if isSelected {
                selectedChainIDs.remove(chain.id)
            } else if selectedChainIDs.count < 3 {
                selectedChainIDs.insert(chain.id)
            }
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Image(systemName: isSelected ? "checkmark.square.fill" : "square")
                    .font(.system(size: 16))
                    .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? CFColor.primary : CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.3))

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text(chain.summary)
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                        .lineLimit(2)

                    if let character = CharacterID(rawValue: chain.impliedKiller) {
                        Text("→ \(character.displayName)")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning.opacity(0.8))
                    }
                }

                Spacer()
            }
            .padding(8)
            .background(isSelected ? CFColor.primary.opacity(0.15) : CFColor.ink.opacity(0.3))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private var lowEvidenceWarning: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.9).ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 16) {
                Image(systemName: "exclamationmark.triangle.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 40))
                    .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0xFF/255, green: 0xD7/255, blue: 0x00/255))

                Text("ARE YOU SURE?")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                    .tracking(2)

                Text("You don't have much evidence against this suspect. The real killer might still be out there.")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)

                HStack(spacing: 16) {
                    Button("Go Back") {
                        showLowEvidenceWarning = false
                    }
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    .padding()
                    .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.6))
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))

                    Button("Proceed") {
                        showLowEvidenceWarning = false
                        if let selected = selectedCharacter {
                            performAccusation(selected)
                        } else {
                            withAnimation { step = 3 }
                        }
                    }
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .padding()
                    .background(CFColor.warning)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
                }
            }
            .padding(32)
        }
    }

    private func resultOverlay(result: AccusationResult) -> some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.95).ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 24) {
                if result.correct {
                    Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                        .font(.system(size: 72))
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)

                    Text("CASE CLOSED")
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                        .tracking(2)

                    if !selectedChainIDs.isEmpty {
                        let solvingChainIDs = solvingChainMatchCount(result: result)
                        if solvingChainIDs > 0 {
                            Text("EVIDENCE: VERIFIED (\(solvingChainIDs) chain\(solvingChainIDs == 1 ? "" : "s"))")
                                .font(CFFont.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                                .tracking(2)
                        } else {
                            Text("EVIDENCE: PARTIAL")
                                .font(CFFont.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(Color(red: 0xFF/255, green: 0xD7/255, blue: 0x00/255))
                                .tracking(2)
                        }
                    } else {
                        if result.matchedDeduction != nil {
                            Text("EVIDENCE: VERIFIED")
                                .font(CFFont.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                                .tracking(2)
                        } else {
                            Text("EVIDENCE: INSUFFICIENT")
                                .font(CFFont.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                                .tracking(2)
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark.circle.fill")
                        .font(.system(size: 72))
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)

                    Text("WRONG ACCUSATION")
                        .font(CFFont.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                        .tracking(2)
                }

                Text(result.narrativeBeat)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            }
            .padding(40)
        }
    }

    private func solvingChainMatchCount(result: AccusationResult) -> Int {
        guard let deduction = result.matchedDeduction else { return 0 }
        let requiredIDs = deduction.requiredFactIDs
        return selectedChainIDs.filter { chainID in
            guard let chain = ContentStore.shared.evidenceChain(id: chainID) else { return false }
            return !Set(chain.factIDs).isDisjoint(with: requiredIDs)
        }.count
    }

    private func makeAccusation() {
        guard let selected = selectedCharacter else { return }
        let strength = evidenceStrength(for: selected)
        if strength == 0 && discoveredForRun.isEmpty {
            withAnimation { showLowEvidenceWarning = true }
            return
        }
        performAccusation(selected)
    }

    private func performAccusation(_ selected: CharacterID) {
        AudioEngine.shared.play(.accusationLockIn)
        AudioEngine.shared.stopBGM(fadeOut: 0.3)
        let result = try? gameState.makeAccusation(accused: selected)
        self.result = result
        showingResult = true
        if let result {
            if result.correct {
                AudioEngine.shared.startBGM(.endingCaughtThem, loop: false)
            } else {
                AudioEngine.shared.startBGM(.endingWrongfulAccusation, loop: false)
            }
        }
        DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 4.0) {
            dismiss()
        }
    }
}
