<file path="catfish/Features/Journal/ClueJournalView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

struct ClueJournalView: View {
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState

    @Query(sort: \DiscoveredFact.discoveredAt) private var allDiscovered: [DiscoveredFact]
    @Query private var allFacts: [Fact]

    @State private var filterCharacter: CharacterID?
    @State private var selectedFactForDetail: Fact?

    private var discoveredForRun: Set<String> {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }
        return Set(allDiscovered.filter { $0.run?.id == run.id }.map(\.factID))
    }

    private var discoveredFacts: [Fact] {
        guard let run = gameState.run else { return [] }
        let ids = discoveredForRun
        let facts = allFacts
            .filter { $0.run?.id == run.id && ids.contains($0.id) }
            .sorted { $0.day < $1.day }

        if let filter = filterCharacter {
            return facts.filter { $0.aboutCharacter == filter }
        }
        return facts
    }

    init() {
        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<Fact>(sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\Fact.day)])
        _allFacts = Query(descriptor)
    }

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            ZStack {
                CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

                if discoveredFacts.isEmpty && filterCharacter == nil {
                    emptyState
                } else {
                    ScrollView {
                        VStack(spacing: 20) {
                            Day7UrgencyBanner()

                            suspectBoard
                            progressSection

                            if !discoveredFacts.isEmpty {
                                factsSection
                            } else if filterCharacter != nil {
                                filterEmptyState
                            }

                            evidenceChainSection
                            deductionSection
                        }
                        .padding()
                    }
                }
            }
            .navigationDestination(item: $selectedFactForDetail) { fact in
                FactDetailView(fact: fact)
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            try? gameState.markJournalViewed()
            AudioEngine.shared.play(.journalOpen)
        }
    }

    private var emptyState: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            Image(systemName: "magnifyingglass")
                .font(.system(size: 52))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
            Text("No clues yet.")
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Text("Pay attention during dates and conversations.")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        }
        .padding(40)
    }

    private var filterEmptyState: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            if let char = filterCharacter {
                Text("No evidence about \(char.displayName) yet.")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
            }
        }
        .padding()
    }

    private var suspectBoard: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            SuspectBoardView { character in
                if filterCharacter == character {
                    filterCharacter = nil
                } else {
                    filterCharacter = character
                }
            }

            if filterCharacter != nil {
                HStack {
                    if let char = filterCharacter {
                        Text("Filtered: \(char.displayName)")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                    }

                    Spacer()

                    Button("Clear") {
                        filterCharacter = nil
                    }
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                }
                .padding(.top, 6)
            }
        }
    }

    private var progressSection: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text("CASE PROGRESS")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                .tracking(2)

            HStack {
                Text("Clues discovered:")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Spacer()
                Text("\(discoveredFacts.count)")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
            }

            let chains = completedChains
            HStack {
                Text("Chains completed:")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Spacer()
                Text("\(chains.count)")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.secondary)
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
    }

    private var completedChains: [EvidenceChainContent] {
        let discovered = discoveredForRun
        return ContentStore.shared.allEvidenceChains.filter { chain in
            chain.factIDs.allSatisfy { discovered.contains($0) }
        }
    }

    private var factsSection: some View {
        let grouped = Dictionary(grouping: discoveredFacts, by: \.day)

        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
            HStack {
                Text("EVIDENCE")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    .tracking(2)

                if filterCharacter != nil {
                    Text("(filtered)")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary.opacity(0.6))
                }
            }

            ForEach(grouped.keys.sorted(), id: \.self) { day in
                if let facts = grouped[day] {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                        Text("Day \(day)")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.6))

                        ForEach(facts) { fact in
                            Button {
                                selectedFactForDetail = fact
                            } label: {
                                FactRow(fact: fact)
                            }
                            .buttonStyle(.plain)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var evidenceChainSection: some View {
        EvidenceChainBuilder()
    }

    private var deductionSection: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text("ACCUSATION")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                .tracking(2)

            Text("Review your evidence before making an accusation.")
                .font(CFFont.body)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.8))

            NavigationLink(destination: AccusationView()) {
                Text("Make Accusation")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding()
                    .background(CFColor.warning)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
    }
}

struct FactRow: View {
    let fact: Fact

    private var payload: FactPayload { fact.payload }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            HStack {
                if let character = fact.aboutCharacter {
                    Text(character.displayName)
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                }

                Spacer()

                Text(kindLabel)
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.5))
                    .padding(.horizontal, 6)
                    .padding(.vertical, 2)
                    .background(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.1))
                    .clipShape(Capsule())
            }

            if let text = payload.text {
                Text(text)
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                    .lineLimit(3)
            }

            if let imageID = payload.imageAssetID {
                AssetImage(imageID)
                    .frame(height: 60)
                    .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
            }

            HStack {
                sourceLabel
                Spacer()
                Text("Day \(fact.day)")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.7))
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.4))
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8))
    }

    private var kindLabel: String {
        switch fact.kind {
        case .staticFact: return "STATIC"
        case .variable: return "VARIABLE"
        case .conditional: return "CONDITIONAL"
        }
    }

    private var sourceLabel: Text {
        switch fact.source {
        case .profileBio(let c):
            Text("Profile: \(c.displayName)")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
        case .socialPost(let c):
            Text("Social: \(c.displayName)")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
        case .directMessage(let c):
            Text("DM: \(c.displayName)")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
        case .friendText(let f):
            Text("Friend: \(f.rawValue.capitalized)")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
        case .dateScene(let c):
            Text("Date: \(c.displayName)")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
        case .investigation:
            Text("Investigation")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.5))
        }
    }
}

<file path="catfish/Features/PhoneOS/PhoneOSState.swift">
import Foundation
import SwiftUI
import Observation

/// All apps the FishPhone can launch. Adding a new app means a new case here
/// plus a router branch in `PhoneShell`.
enum AppID: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case lotsOFish
    case photos
    case phone
    case faceTime
    case mail
    case browser
    case wordLow
    case egoTrip
    case sugarCoat
    case safeSpot
    case journal
    case settings

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var displayName: String {
        switch self {
        case .lotsOFish: return "Lots o' Fish"
        case .photos:    return "Photos"
        case .phone:     return "Phone"
        case .faceTime:  return "FaceTime"
        case .mail:      return "Mail"
        case .browser:   return "Browser"
        case .wordLow:   return "Word-Low"
        case .egoTrip:   return "Ego Trip"
        case .sugarCoat: return "Sugar Coat"
        case .safeSpot:  return "Safe Spot"
        case .journal:   return "Journal"
        case .settings:  return "Settings"
        }
    }

    /// SF Symbol used for the home-screen glyph until bespoke pixel sprites land.
    var glyph: String {
        switch self {
        case .lotsOFish: return "fish.fill"
        case .photos:    return "photo.stack.fill"
        case .phone:     return "phone.fill"
        case .faceTime:  return "video.fill"
        case .mail:      return "envelope.fill"
        case .browser:   return "globe"
        case .wordLow:   return "textformat.abc"
        case .egoTrip:   return "bird.fill"
        case .sugarCoat: return "heart.fill"
        case .safeSpot:  return "shield.lefthalf.filled"
        case .journal:   return "book.fill"
        case .settings:  return "gearshape.fill"
        }
    }

    /// Background tint of the icon tile.
    var tint: Color {
        switch self {
        case .lotsOFish: return CFColor.primary
        case .photos:    return CFColor.cyanDim
        case .phone:     return Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255)
        case .faceTime:  return CFColor.cyan
        case .mail:      return CFColor.magentaDim
        case .browser:   return CFColor.ink
        case .wordLow:   return CFColor.cyanDim
        case .egoTrip:   return Color(red: 0xF7/255, green: 0xB2/255, blue: 0x3B/255)
        case .sugarCoat: return CFColor.primary
        case .safeSpot:  return Color(red: 0x2E/255, green: 0xC4/255, blue: 0x6B/255)
        case .journal:   return CFColor.secondary
        case .settings:  return CFColor.cream.opacity(0.4)
        }
    }

    /// One-line teaser shown in the stub view for apps not yet implemented.
    var stubTeaser: String {
        switch self {
        case .lotsOFish: return "Find your match. Find the killer."
        case .photos:    return "Evidence shots and saved screenshots, all in one place."
        case .phone:     return "Voice calls before and after the date. Listen carefully."
        case .faceTime:  return "Vibe-check your matches face to face."
        case .mail:      return "Inbox: receipts, invitations, threats."
        case .browser:   return "Look someone up. Read between the lines."
        case .wordLow:   return "Five letters. Six tries. Are you certified?"
        case .egoTrip:   return "Don't crash the vibe."
        case .sugarCoat: return "Match the lies. Build the brand."
        case .safeSpot:  return "Defend your peace from energy vampires."
        case .journal:   return "Your evidence board. Connect the dots."
        case .settings:  return "Audio, display, and accessibility options."
        }
    }

    var teaser: String { stubTeaser }
}

/// FishPhone OS state. Owned by `PhoneShell`, read by every app.
/// Extends naturally with notifications, lock screen, and persona switching
/// as those milestones land.
@Observable
@MainActor
final class PhoneOSState {
    /// nil → home screen is showing. non-nil → that app is active.
    var currentApp: AppID? = nil

    /// CRT scanline overlay toggle. Default on; user-tweakable later.
    var crtMode: Bool = true

    func open(_ app: AppID) {
        guard currentApp != app else { return }
        currentApp = app
    }

    func goHome() {
        currentApp = nil
    }
}

<file path="README.md">
# Catfish — Mobile Mystery Game (Beta)

A dating-app-meets-murder-mystery built with SwiftUI + SwiftData. Swipe through suspect profiles, match, go on dates, gather clues, and catch the killer before they escape.

## Status

**Phase 13 complete.** Core gameplay loop implemented: swipe → match → chat → date → investigate → accuse. Full voice pipeline with ElevenLabs integration. Eastworld-powered ambient dialogue in dates. Clue graph with 5 killer variants fully authored.

## Directory Layout

```
catfish/
├── catfishApp.swift             App entry + RootView routing
├── RootView.swift               Main tab container
├── Core/
│   ├── Models/                  CharacterID, FactSource, FriendID enums + SwiftData models
│   ├── GameState/               @Observable GameState — day clock + run lifecycle
│   ├── Content/                 content.json + FactAutor + ContentScheduler
│   └── KillerImplementations/   5 KillerIdentity implementations (Miles, Kai, River, Sam, Jules)
├── Features/
│   ├── Swipe/                   SwipeDeckViewModel, SwipeCard, SwipeView
│   ├── Chat/                    ChatView, ChatThread, MessageRow, ChatEngine
│   ├── Matches/                MatchesListView, MatchRow
│   ├── Journal/                 JournalView, FactCard, DeductionChainView
│   ├── Profile/                 ProfileView, SocialFeedView
│   └── DateMode/                DateSceneView, DateDirector, VoicePlayer, DateScene schema
├── DesignSystem/                CFColor, CFFont, pixel chrome modifiers, AssetImage
├── Audio/                       AudioEngine, music loops, SFX
├── Resources/
│   ├── Voice/                   Pre-generated .m4a voice lines + voice_manifest.json
│   └── content.json             Full fact universe (days 1-7, all killer variants)
└── Scripts/                     pregen_voice_lines.py, audit_voice_bundle.py
```

## What Works Today

- **New run** — randomizes killer, stamps CaseRun, bootstraps fact universe
- **Swipe deck** — swipe right to match, left to pass; persistent across relaunch
- **Match celebration** — overlay with clue_discovered_sting audio cue
- **Chat engine** — scripted turns, Eastworld ambient responses, choice branching, voice playback
- **Date Mode** — full SpriteKit scene with DateDirector orchestrating scripted + Eastworld beats, Focus Shift camera transition, choice points, fact reveals
- **Voice pipeline** — pre-generated .m4a files, on-demand ElevenLabs via Cloudflare Worker, latency-budget fallback lines
- **Journal** — drag-to-log fact discovery, cross-reference linking, deduction chain visualization
- **Accusation flow** — four endings (caught_them, wrongful_accusation, met_killer, killer_escaped)
- **All 5 KillerIdentity implementations** — full variableOverrides, conditionalFactIDs, solvingDeduction, redHerrings
- **Friend system** — Dev + Nia corgi-cabal chat with in-world SMS delivery

## Key Design Decisions

- **Player-paced day model.** Day advances via explicit `GameState.advanceDay()`, not a real clock. Playable in one session or across a week.
- **KillerIdentity stamped at run start, immutable.** Mid-run flip invalidates every fact payload. See `catfish_clue-graph-schema.md`.
- **Journal commit = discovery contract.** Drag-to-log forces engagement and gives the UI a job.
- **Hybrid SwiftUI / SpriteKit.** SwiftUI for chrome/chat; SpriteKit for Date mode scenes.
- **Voice on every line.** Player-perceived production value depends on this. Eastworld texture, ElevenLabs delivery.

## Voice Pipeline

- Voice manifest: `Resources/Voice/voice_manifest.json`
- Pre-generation: `Scripts/pregen_voice_lines.py`
- Bundle audit: `Scripts/audit_voice_bundle.py`
- Runtime wrappers: `VoicePlayer`, `VoicePreloadQueue`, `EastworldVoiceService`
- Cloudflare Worker: `Cloudflare/voice-worker.js`
- Pipeline docs: `Docs/voice_pipeline.md`

## Product Docs

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| `catfish_clue-graph-schema.md` | Fact universe schema — static/variable/conditional facts, KillerIdentity protocol, double-blind tell |
| `catfish_date-mode-prd.md` | Date Mode PRD v0.2.1 — scene architecture, Eastworld integration, Saint Mask system |
| `catfish_audio-brief.md` | Audio production brief — 12 hero tracks, 53 ElevenLabs clips, mixing rules |
| `PRD_Phase3.md` | Phase 3 — Fact universe authoring (days 4-7), voice pre-generation |
| `PRD_Phase5.md` | Phase 5 — SafeSpot tower defense gameplay |
| `Docs/voice_pipeline.md` | Voice pipeline implementation notes, cost guardrails |

## Build & Run

```bash
xcodebuild -project catfish.xcodeproj -scheme catfish \
  -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' build
```

Requires iOS 17+ (SwiftData + @Observable).
</file>

<file path="catfish/Core/Content/ContentSchema.swift">
import Foundation
import os

private let contentLog = Logger(subsystem: "com.catfish.app", category: "ContentStore")

struct DMMessageContent: Codable {
    let id: String
    let character: String?
    let trigger: String
    let triggerDay: Int?
    let triggerFactID: String?
    let text: String
    let sceneID: String?
    let location: String?
    let metadata: [String: String]?
}

struct VoicemailContent: Codable {
    let id: String
    let sender: String
    let day: Int
    let text: String
    let factID: String?
    let duration: Int
    let killerSpecific: String?
}

struct SearchEntryContent: Codable {
    let keyword: String
    let headline: String
    let excerpt: String
    let factID: String?
    let minDay: Int
}

struct FaceTimeCallContent: Codable {
    let id: String
    let character: String
    let triggerDay: Int
    let lines: [FaceTimeLine]
    let factID: String?
}

struct FaceTimeLine: Codable {
    let speaker: String
    let text: String
    let choices: [String]?
}

struct EvidenceChainContent: Codable {
    let id: String
    let factIDs: [String]
    let summary: String
    let impliedKiller: String
    let weight: Double
}

struct ContentUniverse: Codable {
    let profiles: [String: ProfileContent]
    let facts: [String: FactContent]
    let dayEvents: [String: [DayEventContent]]
    let dmMessages: [DMMessageContent]
    let voicemails: [VoicemailContent]
    let searchEntries: [SearchEntryContent]
    let facetimeCalls: [FaceTimeCallContent]
    let evidenceChains: [EvidenceChainContent]

    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        profiles = try container.decode([String: ProfileContent].self, forKey: .profiles)
        facts = try container.decode([String: FactContent].self, forKey: .facts)
        dayEvents = try container.decode([String: [DayEventContent]].self, forKey: .dayEvents)
        dmMessages = (try? container.decode([DMMessageContent].self, forKey: .dmMessages)) ?? []
        voicemails = (try? container.decode([VoicemailContent].self, forKey: .voicemails)) ?? []
        searchEntries = (try? container.decode([SearchEntryContent].self, forKey: .searchEntries)) ?? []
        facetimeCalls = (try? container.decode([FaceTimeCallContent].self, forKey: .facetimeCalls)) ?? []
        evidenceChains = (try? container.decode([EvidenceChainContent].self, forKey: .evidenceChains)) ?? []
    }

    init(profiles: [String: ProfileContent] = [:],
         facts: [String: FactContent] = [:],
         dayEvents: [String: [DayEventContent]] = [:],
         dmMessages: [DMMessageContent] = [],
         voicemails: [VoicemailContent] = [],
         searchEntries: [SearchEntryContent] = [],
         facetimeCalls: [FaceTimeCallContent] = [],
         evidenceChains: [EvidenceChainContent] = []) {
        self.profiles = profiles
        self.facts = facts
        self.dayEvents = dayEvents
        self.dmMessages = dmMessages
        self.voicemails = voicemails
        self.searchEntries = searchEntries
        self.facetimeCalls = facetimeCalls
        self.evidenceChains = evidenceChains
    }
}

struct ProfileContent: Codable {
    let displayName: String
    let age: Int
    let archetype: String
    let bioLine: String
    let portraitAssetID: String
    let portraitFlirtyAssetID: String
    let portraitSinisterAssetID: String
    let portraitUneasyAssetID: String
    let portraitSmileAssetID: String
    let portraitCuriousAssetID: String
    let fullBodyAssetID: String
    let fullBodyFormalAssetID: String
    let badges: [String]
}

struct FactContent: Codable {
    let kind: String
    let source: FactSourceContent
    let day: Int
    let aboutCharacter: String?
    let payload: FactPayloadContent
}

struct FactSourceContent: Codable {
    let type: String
    let character: String?
    let friend: String?
}

struct FactPayloadContent: Codable {
    let text: String
    let imageAssetID: String?
    let voiceLineID: String?
    let metadata: [String: String]
}

struct DayEventContent: Codable {
    let type: String
    let sender: String?
    let text: String?
    let voiceLineID: String?
    let character: String?
    let metadata: [String: String]?
}

@MainActor
final class ContentStore {
    static let shared = ContentStore()

    private(set) var universe: ContentUniverse

    private init() {
        self.universe = ContentUniverse(
            profiles: [:],
            facts: [:],
            dayEvents: [:]
        )
    }

    func load() {
        guard let url = Bundle.main.url(forResource: "content", withExtension: "json") else {
            contentLog.debug("content.json not found in bundle — content pipeline disabled, using fallbacks")
            return
        }

        do {
            let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
            universe = try JSONDecoder().decode(ContentUniverse.self, from: data)
            contentLog.debug("Loaded \(self.universe.profiles.count) profiles, \(self.universe.facts.count) facts, \(self.universe.dayEvents.count) day events")
        } catch {
            contentLog.error("Failed to decode content.json: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    func profile(for id: CharacterID) -> ProfileContent? {
        universe.profiles[id.rawValue]
    }

    func resolveSource(_ content: FactSourceContent) -> FactSource {
        switch content.type {
        case "profileBio":
            if let c = content.character, let id = CharacterID(rawValue: c) {
                return .profileBio(of: id)
            }
        case "socialPost":
            if let c = content.character, let id = CharacterID(rawValue: c) {
                return .socialPost(author: id)
            }
        case "directMessage":
            if let c = content.character, let id = CharacterID(rawValue: c) {
                return .directMessage(from: id)
            }
        case "friendText":
            if let f = content.friend, let id = FriendID(rawValue: f) {
                return .friendText(from: id)
            }
        case "dateScene":
            if let c = content.character, let id = CharacterID(rawValue: c) {
                return .dateScene(with: id)
            }
        default:
            break
        }
        return .investigation
    }

    func resolveFactKind(_ raw: String) -> FactKind {
        FactKind(rawValue: raw) ?? .staticFact
    }

    func factsForRun(killer: CharacterID, identity: KillerIdentity) -> [FactContent] {
        let conditionalIDs = identity.conditionalFactIDs

        var result: [FactContent] = []

        for (id, fact) in universe.facts {
            if conditionalIDs.contains(id) {
                result.append(fact)
            }
        }

        for (id, fact) in universe.facts {
            if !conditionalIDs.contains(id) {
                result.append(fact)
            }
        }

        return result
    }

    func eventsForDay(_ day: Int) -> [DayEventContent] {
        universe.dayEvents[String(day)] ?? []
    }

    func dmMessages(trigger: String, character: String? = nil, day: Int? = nil) -> [DMMessageContent] {
        universe.dmMessages.filter { msg in
            guard msg.trigger == trigger else { return false }
            if let character, msg.character != character { return false }
            if let day, msg.triggerDay != day { return false }
            return true
        }
    }

    func dmMessage(id: String) -> DMMessageContent? {
        universe.dmMessages.first { $0.id == id }
    }

    func voicemails(forDay day: Int, killerRaw: String) -> [VoicemailContent] {
        universe.voicemails.filter { v in
            v.day == day && (v.killerSpecific == nil || v.killerSpecific == killerRaw)
        }
    }

    func voicemail(id: String) -> VoicemailContent? {
        universe.voicemails.first { $0.id == id }
    }

    func searchEntries(matching query: String, currentDay: Int) -> [SearchEntryContent] {
        let lowered = query.lowercased()
        return universe.searchEntries.filter { entry in
            entry.keyword.lowercased().contains(lowered) && entry.minDay <= currentDay
        }
    }

    func allSearchEntries(availableByDay day: Int) -> [SearchEntryContent] {
        universe.searchEntries.filter { $0.minDay <= day }
    }

    func facetimeCall(forCharacter character: String, currentDay: Int) -> FaceTimeCallContent? {
        universe.facetimeCalls.first { $0.character == character && $0.triggerDay <= currentDay }
    }

    func facetimeCall(id: String) -> FaceTimeCallContent? {
        universe.facetimeCalls.first { $0.id == id }
    }

    func evidenceChain(id: String) -> EvidenceChainContent? {
        universe.evidenceChains.first { $0.id == id }
    }

    var allEvidenceChains: [EvidenceChainContent] {
        universe.evidenceChains
    }
}
</file>

<file path="catfish/Features/Matches/ChatView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData
import Combine

struct ChatView: View {
    let match: MatchRelationship

    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @Environment(GameState.self) private var gameState
    @Environment(OnboardingManager.self) private var onboarding

    @State private var messageText = ""
    @State private var messages: [ChatMessage] = []
    @State private var isVoiceRecording = false
    @State private var isTyping = false
    @State private var showProfile = false
    @State private var chatClient = ProductionDateEastworldClient()

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                header
                messageList
                inputBar
            }
        }
        .onAppear {
            loadMessages()
            markAsRead()
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: $showProfile) {
            CharacterProfileSheet(characterID: match.characterID)
        }
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Button {
                showProfile = true
            } label: {
                HStack(spacing: 12) {
                    AssetImage(match.characterID.portraitAssetID)
                        .frame(width: 40, height: 40)
                        .clipShape(Circle())

                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                        Text(match.characterID.displayName)
                            .font(CFFont.headline)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                        Text("Online")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                    }
                }
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)

            Spacer()

            Button {
                showProfile = true
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "person.crop.circle")
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                    .font(.system(size: 22))
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.7))
    }

    private var messageList: some View {
        ScrollViewReader { proxy in
            ScrollView {
                LazyVStack(spacing: 12) {
                    ForEach(messages) { message in
                        ChatBubble(message: message, character: match.characterID, onAcceptInvite: {
                            acceptDateInvitation(message)
                        }, onDeclineInvite: {
                            declineDateInvitation(message)
                        }, onAcceptDay7Meet: {
                            acceptDay7Meet(message)
                        })
                        .id(message.id)
                    }

                    if isTyping {
                        HStack {
                            TypingIndicator(character: match.characterID)
                            Spacer()
                        }
                        .id("typing")
                    }
                }
                .padding()
            }
            .onChange(of: messages.count) { _, _ in
                scrollToBottom(proxy: proxy)
            }
            .onChange(of: isTyping) { _, _ in
                scrollToBottom(proxy: proxy)
            }
        }
    }

    private var inputBar: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            TextField("Message...", text: $messageText)
                .textFieldStyle(.plain)
                .padding(10)
                .background(CFColor.ink)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 20))
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                .onSubmit(sendMessage)

            Button(action: sendMessage) {
                Image(systemName: "arrow.up.circle.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 32))
                    .foregroundStyle(messageText.isEmpty ? CFColor.ink : CFColor.primary)
            }
            .disabled(messageText.isEmpty)

            Button(action: toggleVoiceRecording) {
                Image(systemName: isVoiceRecording ? "stop.circle.fill" : "mic.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 28))
                    .foregroundStyle(isVoiceRecording ? CFColor.warning : CFColor.primary)
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.5))
    }

    private func loadMessages() {
        let threadKey = "match:\(match.characterID.rawValue)"

        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<ChatMessage>(
            predicate: #Predicate<ChatMessage> { $0.threadKey == threadKey },
            sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.sentAt, order: .forward)]
        )

        if let fetched = try? context.fetch(descriptor) {
            messages = fetched
        }
    }

    private func markAsRead() {
        let threadKey = "match:\(match.characterID.rawValue)"
        for msg in messages where !msg.isRead {
            msg.isRead = true
        }
        if let thread = gameState.run?.chatThreads.first(where: { $0.partnerKey == threadKey }) {
            thread.unreadCount = 0
        }
        try? context.save()
    }

    private func sendMessage() {
        let text = messageText.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard !text.isEmpty else { return }

        let threadKey = "match:\(match.characterID.rawValue)"
        let message = ChatMessage(
            threadKey: threadKey,
            senderKey: "player",
            text: text,
            sentAt: Date()
        )
        message.run = gameState.run
        context.insert(message)
        messages.append(message)

        if let thread = gameState.run?.chatThreads.first(where: { $0.partnerKey == threadKey }) {
            thread.lastMessageText = text
            thread.lastMessageAt = Date()
        }

        messageText = ""
        AudioEngine.shared.play(.messageSend)

        if onboarding.currentStep == .dmsAndVoice {
            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 1.5) {
                onboarding.advance()
            }
        }

        Task {
            await generateResponse(for: message)
        }
    }

    private func toggleVoiceRecording() {
        isVoiceRecording.toggle()
        if onboarding.currentStep == .dmsAndVoice && isVoiceRecording {
            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 1.5) {
                onboarding.advance()
            }
        }
    }

    private func generateResponse(for playerMessage: ChatMessage) async {
        let delay = Double(min(max(playerMessage.text.count, 20), 100)) / 50.0 * 1.5 + 0.5
        isTyping = true

        let response: String
        do {
            response = try await chatClient.nextLine(
                sceneID: "chat",
                partnerID: match.characterID.rawValue,
                playerInput: playerMessage.text
            )
        } catch {
            response = "..."
        }

        try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(delay))

        let threadKey = "match:\(match.characterID.rawValue)"
        let meta = response.contains("(connection unstable)") ? ChatMessageMeta(isConnectionUnstable: true) : nil
        let message = ChatMessage(
            threadKey: threadKey,
            senderKey: match.characterID.rawValue,
            text: response,
            sentAt: Date(),
            metadata: meta
        )
        message.run = gameState.run
        context.insert(message)

        await MainActor.run {
            isTyping = false
            messages.append(message)
            AudioEngine.shared.play(.messageReceived)

            if let thread = gameState.run?.chatThreads.first(where: { $0.partnerKey == threadKey }) {
                thread.lastMessageText = response
                thread.lastMessageAt = Date()
                if !message.isRead {
                    thread.unreadCount += 1
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func acceptDateInvitation(_ message: ChatMessage) {
        guard message.kind == .dateInvitation, let meta = message.meta else { return }

        if let sceneID = meta.sceneID {
            match.scheduleDate(sceneID: sceneID, day: gameState.currentDay)
        }

        let threadKey = "match:\(match.characterID.rawValue)"
        let acceptMsg = ChatMessage(
            threadKey: threadKey,
            senderKey: "player",
            text: "I'd love to! Let's do it.",
            sentAt: Date()
        )
        acceptMsg.run = gameState.run
        context.insert(message)
        messages.append(acceptMsg)

        try? context.save()
    }

    private func declineDateInvitation(_ message: ChatMessage) {
        let threadKey = "match:\(match.characterID.rawValue)"
        let declineMsg = ChatMessage(
            threadKey: threadKey,
            senderKey: "player",
            text: "Maybe another time.",
            sentAt: Date()
        )
        declineMsg.run = gameState.run
        context.insert(declineMsg)
        messages.append(declineMsg)

        match.dateInvitationPending = false
        try? context.save()
    }

    private func acceptDay7Meet(_ message: ChatMessage) {
        let threadKey = "match:\(match.characterID.rawValue)"
        let acceptMsg = ChatMessage(
            threadKey: threadKey,
            senderKey: "player",
            text: "I'll be there.",
            sentAt: Date()
        )
        acceptMsg.run = gameState.run
        context.insert(acceptMsg)
        messages.append(acceptMsg)

        AudioEngine.shared.play(.day7InvitationReceived)
        try? gameState.endRun(with: .metKiller)
        try? context.save()
    }

    private func scrollToBottom(proxy: ScrollViewProxy) {
        withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.3)) {
            if isTyping {
                proxy.scrollTo("typing", anchor: .bottom)
            } else if let last = messages.last {
                proxy.scrollTo(last.id, anchor: .bottom)
            }
        }
    }
}

struct ChatBubble: View {
    let message: ChatMessage
    let character: CharacterID
    let onAcceptInvite: () -> Void
    let onDeclineInvite: () -> Void
    var onAcceptDay7Meet: (() -> Void)? = nil

    var isFromPlayer: Bool { message.senderKey == "player" }

    var body: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 8) {
            if isFromPlayer { Spacer(minLength: 40) }

            if !isFromPlayer {
                AssetImage(character.portraitAssetID)
                    .frame(width: 32, height: 32)
                    .clipShape(Circle())
            }

            VStack(alignment: isFromPlayer ? .trailing : .leading, spacing: 4) {
                bubbleContent

                HStack(spacing: 4) {
                    if !isFromPlayer && !message.isRead {
                        Circle()
                            .fill(CFColor.cyan)
                            .frame(width: 6, height: 6)
                    }
                    Text(formatTime(message.sentAt))
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.6))
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: 260, alignment: isFromPlayer ? .trailing : .leading)

            if !isFromPlayer { Spacer(minLength: 40) }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var bubbleContent: some View {
        Text(message.text)
            .font(CFFont.body)
            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            .padding(12)
            .background(isFromPlayer ? CFColor.primary.opacity(0.8) : CFColor.ink.opacity(0.6))
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16))

        if message.kind == .dateInvitation {
            dateInvitationButtons
        }

        if message.kind == .day7MeetInvitation {
            day7MeetButtons
        }

        if let meta = message.meta, meta.isConnectionUnstable == true {
            HStack(spacing: 4) {
                Image(systemName: "wifi.slash")
                    .font(.system(size: 10))
                Text("connection unstable")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
            }
            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning.opacity(0.7))
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var dateInvitationButtons: some View {
        if let meta = message.meta, meta.sceneID != nil {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Button(action: onAcceptInvite) {
                    Text("Accept")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                        .padding(.vertical, 8)
                        .background(CFColor.primary)
                        .clipShape(Capsule())
                }

                Button(action: onDeclineInvite) {
                    Text("Decline")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                        .padding(.vertical, 8)
                        .background(CFColor.ink)
                        .clipShape(Capsule())
                }
            }
            .padding(.top, 4)
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var day7MeetButtons: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 6) {
            Text("⚠️ The killer wants to meet")
                .font(CFFont.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                .tracking(1)

            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Button(action: { onAcceptDay7Meet?() }) {
                    Text("Accept Meet")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                        .padding(.vertical, 8)
                        .background(CFColor.warning)
                        .clipShape(Capsule())
                }

                Button(action: onDeclineInvite) {
                    Text("Decline")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                        .padding(.vertical, 8)
                        .background(CFColor.ink)
                        .clipShape(Capsule())
                }
            }
            .padding(.top, 2)
        }
    }

    private func formatTime(_ date: Date) -> String {
        let formatter = DateFormatter()
        formatter.timeStyle = .short
        return formatter.string(from: date)
    }
}

struct TypingIndicator: View {
    let character: CharacterID

    @State private var dotCount = 0
    private let timer = Timer.publish(every: 0.5, on: .main, in: .common).autoconnect()

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            AssetImage(character.portraitAssetID)
                .frame(width: 32, height: 32)
                .clipShape(Circle())

            Text(String(repeating: ".", count: dotCount + 1))
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan.opacity(0.6))
                .padding(12)
                .background(CFColor.ink.opacity(0.6))
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16))
                .frame(width: 60)
        }
        .onReceive(timer) { _ in
            dotCount = (dotCount + 1) % 3
        }
    }
}

struct CharacterProfileSheet: View {
    let characterID: CharacterID
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                HStack {
                    Spacer()
                    Button("Done") { dismiss() }
                        .font(CFFont.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                }
                .padding()

                if let profile = ContentStore.shared.profile(for: characterID) {
                    VStack(spacing: 16) {
                        AssetImage(characterID.portraitAssetID)
                            .frame(width: 80, height: 80)
                            .clipShape(Circle())

                        Text(profile.displayName)
                            .font(CFFont.title)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)

                        Text("\(profile.age) · \(profile.archetype)")
                            .font(CFFont.headline)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)

                        Text(profile.bioLine)
                            .font(CFFont.body)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.8))

                        HStack(spacing: 8) {
                            ForEach(profile.badges, id: \.self) { badge in
                                Text(badge)
                                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                                    .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                                    .padding(.vertical, 4)
                                    .background(CFColor.ink)
                                    .clipShape(Capsule())
                                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Spacer()
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 24)
        }
    }
}

  "dayEvents": {
    "1": [
      {
        "type": "narrator",
        "voiceLineID": "narrator_d1_morning",
        "text": "Day one. Five profiles, one week, one of them is not who they say.",
        "sender": null,
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      },
      {
        "type": "friendMessage",
        "sender": "dev",
        "text": "You actually downloaded this? Bold move. I know three of them through friends. Seem normal. Seem.",
        "voiceLineID": "dev_d1_reality_check",
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      },
      {
        "type": "friendMessage",
        "sender": "nia",
        "text": "Don't overthink it. Just… keep your eyes open. Trust your gut if something feels off.",
        "voiceLineID": "nia_d1_encouragement",
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      }
    ],
    "2": [
      {
        "type": "narrator",
        "voiceLineID": "narrator_d2_intro",
        "text": "Day two. The first real conversation is always the most revealing.",
        "sender": null,
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      },
      {
        "type": "friendMessage",
        "sender": "dev",
        "text": "Here's my rule — if someone's story about where they were is too perfect, it's rehearsed.",
        "voiceLineID": "dev_d2_reality_check",
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      },
      {
        "type": "friendMessage",
        "sender": "nia",
        "text": "Check their socials again. People forget what they posted three days ago.",
        "voiceLineID": "nia_d2_encouragement",
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      }
    ],
    "3": [
      {
        "type": "narrator",
        "voiceLineID": "narrator_d3_midpoint",
        "text": "Midpoint. The stories are starting to diverge from the evidence.",
        "sender": null,
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      },
      {
        "type": "friendMessage",
        "sender": "dev",
        "text": "Something doesn't add up. I'm not saying who, but someone's timeline has holes.",
        "voiceLineID": "dev_d3_warning_generic",
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      },
      {
        "type": "friendMessage",
        "sender": "nia",
        "text": "How'd the date go? You learn more from what they don't say than what they do.",
        "voiceLineID": "nia_d3_support",
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      }
    ],
    "4": [
      {
        "type": "narrator",
        "voiceLineID": "narrator_d4_tension",
        "text": "Day four. Trust is a currency and someone is spending yours.",
        "sender": null,
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      },
      {
        "type": "friendMessage",
        "sender": "dev",
        "text": "Look, I'm not supposed to say this, but watch your back with the finance one.",
        "voiceLineID": "dev_d4_warning_miles_01",
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      }
    ],
    "5": [
      {
        "type": "narrator",
        "voiceLineID": "narrator_d5_tension",
        "text": "Day five. The masks are slipping.",
        "sender": null,
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      },
      {
        "type": "friendMessage",
        "sender": "dev",
        "text": "Things are getting real. If you're gonna dig, dig now.",
        "voiceLineID": "dev_d5_escalation",
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      },
      {
        "type": "friendMessage",
        "sender": "nia",
        "text": "I've been thinking about what you told me. Something's definitely off with one of them.",
        "voiceLineID": "nia_d5_gentle_warning",
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      }
    ],
    "6": [
      {
        "type": "narrator",
        "voiceLineID": "narrator_d6_tension",
        "text": "Day six. The clock is louder than the clues.",
        "sender": null,
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      },
      {
        "type": "friendMessage",
        "sender": "dev",
        "text": "Last chance to figure this out before tomorrow. What do you know for sure?",
        "voiceLineID": "dev_d6_push",
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      },
      {
        "type": "friendMessage",
        "sender": "nia",
        "text": "Whatever happens tomorrow, I'm proud of you for not just swiping and forgetting.",
        "voiceLineID": "nia_d6_final_support",
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      }
    ],
    "7": [
      {
        "type": "narrator",
        "voiceLineID": "narrator_d7_meetup_recap_01",
        "text": "Day seven. This is it. Time to name them.",
        "sender": null,
        "character": null,
        "metadata": null
      }
    ]
  },

    {"id": "vm_nia_d2", "sender": "nia", "day": 2, "text": "Just checking in. I noticed something about the photos people are posting. Timestamps can be tricky — people forget metadata is public. Stay sharp.", "factID": null, "duration": 35, "killerSpecific": null},
    {"id": "vm_dev_d3", "sender": "dev", "day": 3, "text": "OK so I did some digging. Someone's been off the grid for a few hours that night. Phone was off, not silent. That's a choice, not an accident.", "factID": "river_day3_unreachable", "duration": 48, "killerSpecific": null},
    {"id": "vm_nia_d3", "sender": "nia", "day": 3, "text": "Hey, you know how you said Sam seemed nervous? I looked at their Instagram again.     {"id": "vm_dev_d4", "sender": "dev", "day": 4, "text": "Listen, I know I keep saying this, but watch the finance guy. His story about that night is too clean. Every detail accounted for.     {"id": "vm_nia_d4", "sender": "nia", "day": 4, "text": "I've been thinking about Kai. A painter who's always up past 2 AM — that's a lot of unsupervised time.     {"id": "vm_dev_d5", "sender": "dev", "day": 5, "text": "Alright, I'll say it. You have enough to start narrowing down. The gallery parking record contradicts the studio story. The trail cam has a frame. The hospital log has a gap. Pick your angle.", "factID": "kai_d5_gallery_receipt", "duration": 58, "killerSpecific": null},
    {"id": "vm_nia_d5", "sender": "nia", "day": 5, "text": "Something's been bugging me. The venue schedule for The Hold says soundcheck at 9, but Jules was somewhere else at 8:52. Three blocks away. That's not just late — that's somewhere else entirely.", "factID": "jules_d5_venue_schedule", "duration": 52, "killerSpecific": null},
    {"id": "vm_dev_d6", "sender": "dev", "day": 6, "text": "Last night I pulled up the ranger station log. River's badge scanned at 10:47 PM. That's the service road gate. And the code he used? Not his assigned one. What was he doing on that road?", "factID": "river_d5_ranger_log", "duration": 56, "killerSpecific": null},
    {"id": "vm_nia_d6", "sender": "nia", "day": 6, "text": "I heard Sam asked to swap shifts two weeks before everything happened. Needed the night off for a 'personal appointment.'     {"id": "vm_dev_d7", "sender": "dev", "day": 7, "text": "This is it. Whatever your gut tells you, go with it. Don't second-guess the evidence. Someone has been lying since day one. Trust what you've found.", "factID": "day7_nia_warning", "duration": 40, "killerSpecific": null},
    {"id": "vm_nia_d7", "sender": "nia", "day": 7, "text": "Last voicemail. I believe in you. You've done the work. Now trust yourself. See this through.", "factID": null, "duration": 28, "killerSpecific": null},
    {"id": "vm_dev_d3_kai", "sender": "dev", "day": 3, "text": "Forgot to mention — that dropcloth from Kai's IG story at 1 AM? It was being loaded into a trunk that doesn't match any studio vehicle. <file path="catfish/Features/Date/DateSceneView.swift">
import SwiftUI
import SpriteKit

struct DateSceneView: View {
    var preloadedScene: DateScene?
    var preloadedContext: DateSceneContext?

    @StateObject private var runtime: DateModeRuntime
    @State private var scene = DateSceneSpriteHost()
    @State private var spriteController = SpriteAnimationController()
    @State private var showErrorOverlay = false
    @State private var showRestroomOverlay = false
    @State private var improvisedQuestion = ""
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    init(scene: DateScene? = nil, context: DateSceneContext? = nil) {
        self.preloadedScene = scene
        self.preloadedContext = context
        let s = scene ?? demoScene()
        _runtime = StateObject(wrappedValue: DateModeRuntime(sceneModel: s, context: context))
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            DateSceneContainer(scene: scene)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                header
                Spacer()
                transcriptPanel
                controls
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.vertical, 14)

            if showErrorOverlay {
                dateErrorOverlay
            }

            if showRestroomOverlay {
                restroomOverlay
            }

            if runtime.isComplete {
                dateCompleteOverlay
            }
        }
        .background(CFColor.background.ignoresSafeArea())
        .onAppear {
            guard runtime.sceneModel.beats.count > 1 else {
                showErrorOverlay = true
                return
            }
            scene.configure(
                sceneID: runtime.sceneModel.sceneID,
                partner: runtime.sceneModel.partner,
                environment: runtime.sceneModel.environment,
                controller: spriteController
            )
            startSceneAudio()
            runtime.startIfNeeded()
            syncScene(animated: false)
        }
        .onDisappear {
            runtime.stop()
            AudioEngine.shared.stopAmbience()
            AudioEngine.shared.stopVoice()
        }
        .onChange(of: runtime.currentMode) { _, mode in
            syncScene(animated: true)
            if mode == .firstPerson {
                AudioEngine.shared.play(.focusShift)
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: runtime.currentExpression) { _, expression in
            syncScene(animated: false)
            if expression == .neutralSaintmask {
                AudioEngine.shared.play(.saintMaskSubliminal, gain: 0.4)
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: runtime.isVoicePlaying) { _, playing in
            scene.setMouthOpenness(playing, amplitude: playing ? 0.8 : 0)
        }
        .onChange(of: runtime.transcript.count) { oldValue, newValue in
            if newValue > oldValue, oldValue > 0 {
                AudioEngine.shared.play(.dialogueAdvanceTap, gain: 0.6)
            }
        }
    }

    private var dateErrorOverlay: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.opacity(0.92).ignoresSafeArea()
            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                Image(systemName: "exclamationmark.triangle")
                    .font(.system(size: 48))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                Text("Date Interrupted")
                    .font(CFFont.title)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Text("Something went wrong. Try scheduling again later.")
                    .font(CFFont.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.7))
                Button("Leave") { dismiss() }
                    .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
                    .padding(.horizontal, 60)
            }
        }
    }

    private var dateCompleteOverlay: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.navyDeep.opacity(0.88).ignoresSafeArea()
            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                Image(systemName: "heart.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 48))
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.primary)
                Text("Date Complete")
                    .font(CFFont.title)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                if let outcome = runtime.outcome {
                    HStack(spacing: 16) {
                        Label("\(outcome.affinityDelta >= 0 ? "+" : "")\(outcome.affinityDelta)", systemImage: "heart.fill")
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(outcome.affinityDelta >= 0 ? CFColor.primary : CFColor.warning)
                        if !outcome.revealedFactIDs.isEmpty {
                            Label("\(outcome.revealedFactIDs.count) clue\(outcome.revealedFactIDs.count == 1 ? "" : "s")", systemImage: "magnifyingglass")
                                .font(CFFont.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
                        }
                    }
                }
                VStack(spacing: 10) {
                    Text("Ask one more question")
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.8))
                    TextField("Type your question...", text: $improvisedQuestion)
                        .textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder)
                        .autocorrectionDisabled()
                        .textInputAutocapitalization(.sentences)
                    Button(runtime.isImprovising ? "Thinking..." : "Ask") {
                        let prompt = improvisedQuestion.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
                        guard !prompt.isEmpty else { return }
                        AudioEngine.shared.play(.choiceButtonSelect)
                        runtime.askImprovisedQuestion(prompt)
                        improvisedQuestion = ""
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary, sound: nil))
                    .disabled(runtime.isImprovising)
                }
                .padding(10)
                .pixelChrome(fill: CFColor.ink)
                if let improvError = runtime.improvError {
                    Text(improvError)
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                }
                Button("Leave Date") {
                    AudioEngine.shared.play(.modalClose)
                    dismiss()
                }
                .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.cyan))
                .padding(.horizontal, 60)
            }
        }
        .transition(.opacity)
    }

    private func startSceneAudio() {
        let engine = AudioEngine.shared
        if let ambience = AudioAsset.Ambience.match(environment: runtime.sceneModel.environment) {
            engine.startAmbience(ambience)
        }
        engine.startBGM(.dateModeLoopWarm)
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack {
            Text(runtime.sceneModel.environment)
                .font(CFFont.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
            Spacer()
            Button("Restroom") {
                AudioEngine.shared.play(.modalOpen)
                showRestroomOverlay = true
            }
            .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.cyan))
            .frame(maxWidth: 170)
            if runtime.isTypingIndicatorVisible {
                Text("Typing...")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.cyan)
            }
        }
        .padding(10)
        .pixelChrome(fill: CFColor.ink)
    }

    private var restroomOverlay: some View {
        ZStack {
            CFColor.background.opacity(0.9).ignoresSafeArea()
            VStack(spacing: 14) {
                Text("Use the Restroom?")
                    .font(CFFont.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                Text("Step away for a minute, then decide if you're coming back to the table.")
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark.opacity(0.8))
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                Button("Back to table") {
                    AudioEngine.shared.play(.modalClose)
                    showRestroomOverlay = false
                }
                .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary))
                Button("Bail on date") {
                    AudioEngine.shared.play(.wrongChoiceWarn, gain: 0.7)
                    runtime.stop()
                    AudioEngine.shared.stopAmbience()
                    AudioEngine.shared.stopVoice()
                    dismiss()
                }
                .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.warning))
            }
            .padding(16)
            .pixelChrome(fill: CFColor.ink)
            .padding(.horizontal, 24)
        }
        .transition(.opacity)
    }

    private var transcriptPanel: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                ForEach(runtime.transcript) { line in
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                        Text(line.speakerName)
                            .font(CFFont.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(line.speakerName == "You" ? CFColor.cyan : CFColor.primary)
                        Text(line.text)
                            .font(CFFont.body)
                            .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                            .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                    }
                }

                if let errorMessage = runtime.errorMessage {
                    Text(errorMessage)
                        .font(CFFont.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(CFColor.warning)
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        }
        .frame(height: 220)
        .padding(8)
        .pixelChrome(fill: CFColor.ink)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var controls: some View {
        if let prompt = runtime.pendingPrompt {
            VStack(spacing: 8) {
                Text(prompt)
                    .font(CFFont.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(CFColor.textOnDark)
                ForEach(runtime.pendingOptions) { option in
                    Button(option.label) {
                        AudioEngine.shared.play(.choiceButtonSelect)
                        if option.affinityDelta <= -3 {
                            AudioEngine.shared.play(.wrongChoiceWarn, gain: 0.8)
                        } else if option.affinityDelta < 0 {
                            AudioEngine.shared.play(.affinityDown, gain: 0.6)
                        } else if option.affinityDelta > 0 {
                            AudioEngine.shared.play(.affinityUp, gain: 0.6)
                        }
                        runtime.choose(option)
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(PixelButtonStyle(tint: CFColor.primary, sound: nil))
                }
            }
            .padding(10)
            .pixelChrome(fill: CFColor.ink)
        }
    }

    private func syncScene(animated: Bool) {
        scene.applyMode(runtime.currentMode, animated: animated)
        scene.setExpression(runtime.currentExpression)
    }
}

private struct DateSceneContainer: UIViewRepresentable {
    let scene: DateSceneSpriteHost

    func makeUIView(context: Context) -> SKView {
        let view = SKView()
        view.ignoresSiblingOrder = true
        view.preferredFramesPerSecond = 60
        scene.backgroundColor = .black
        view.presentScene(scene)
        return view
    }

    func updateUIView(_ uiView: SKView, context: Context) {
        if uiView.scene !== scene {
            uiView.presentScene(scene)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    DateSceneView()
}
</file>

<file path="llm-wiki/_activity/changelog.md">
# Changelog

Session logs and activity records. Append newest entries at the top.

---

## 2026-04-30 — Journal discovery gating + unread clue badge

**Agent**: Codex (GPT-5)
**Session type**: Implementation

### What happened

- Removed automatic day-1 clue discovery during run bootstrap:
  - `RunBootstrapper.apply` no longer calls `autoDiscoverDayOneFacts`.
- Added per-run journal read state:
  - `CaseRun.journalLastSeenClueCount` (default `0`).
- Added journal unread logic in game state:
  - `GameState.newJournalClueCount` computes discovered-minus-seen.
  - `GameState.markJournalViewed()` updates `journalLastSeenClueCount` and saves.
- Wired Journal app icon badge:
  - `HomeScreen.badge(for:)` now returns unread clue count for `.journal`.
- Opening the Journal now clears unread clues:
  - `ClueJournalView.onAppear` calls `try? gameState.markJournalViewed()`.

### What was learned

- The immediate “12 clues discovered” state on a fresh run was caused by day-1
  auto-seeding of `DiscoveredFact` records, not by Journal rendering.
- Existing architecture supports badge behavior cleanly via `GameState` without
  introducing new global phone OS notification state.

### Files changed

- `catfish/Core/Content/RunBootstrapper.swift`
- `catfish/Core/Models/CaseRun.swift`
- `catfish/Core/GameState.swift`
- `catfish/Features/PhoneOS/HomeScreen.swift`
- `catfish/Features/Journal/ClueJournalView.swift`
- `llm-wiki/features/phone-os.md`
- `llm-wiki/architecture/data-models.md`
- `llm-wiki/index.md`
- `llm-wiki/_activity/changelog.md`

### Verification

- Xcode diagnostics check on edited files: no new errors.
- Full Xcode build: **SUCCEEDED**.

## 2026-04-29 — Phase 13: End-to-End Playtest Polish & Beta Release

**Agent**: opencode (glm-5.1)
**Session type**: Implementation

### What happened

- Created `Features/Ending/EndingOverlay.swift` — full-screen ending overlay with phased reveal animation for all 4 CaseEnding types
- Created `Features/Ending/Day7UrgencyBanner.swift` — journal urgency banner shown on day 7
- Added `EndingResult` struct to `GameState` — captures ending type, killer, narrative beat, evidence strength, fact count, days played
- Updated `RootView` routing — shows EndingOverlay when run ends (replaces inline AccusationView result overlay)
- Wired `.metKiller` ending — day 7 meet invitation now uses `ChatMessageKind.day7MeetInvitation` with Accept/Decline buttons in chat
- Updated `PhoneStatusBar` — day 7 shows warning color and "LAST DAY" sub-banner
- Added `Day7UrgencyBanner` to `ClueJournalView`
- Added `isDay7`, `canAdvanceDay` computed properties to `GameState`
- Updated `AccusationResolver` — added `isLuckyGuess` flag, evidence strength calculation
- Enhanced edge case: zero-evidence accusation shows warning before proceeding
- AccusationView auto-dismisses after 4 seconds to let EndingOverlay display
- Replaced all 18 `print()` statements with `os.Logger` across AudioEngine, VoiceManifest, ContentSchema, NarrativeHookRouter, DateSceneLoader
- Debug killer picker now hidden behind long-press gesture on splash screen
- Added `ChatMessageMeta.isDay7Meet` field for day 7 meet invitation identification

### What was learned

- `CaseEnding.metKiller` was defined but never triggered — now wired through day 7 chat invitation acceptance
- `EndingResult` decouples the ending display from the accusation resolution, allowing metKiller and killerEscaped endings to share the same overlay
- The day 7 meet invitation must use a distinct `ChatMessageKind` (not `.system`) so the ChatBubble can render Accept/Decline buttons
- VoicePlayer already handles audio interruption resume correctly — no changes needed
- SwipeView already has graceful empty state when all profiles swiped

### Files changed

- `catfish/Features/Ending/EndingOverlay.swift` (new)
- `catfish/Features/Ending/Day7UrgencyBanner.swift` (new)
- `catfish/Core/GameState.swift` (modified — EndingResult, narrativeBeat, evidenceStrength, isDay7, canAdvanceDay)
- `catfish/Core/AccusationResolver.swift` (modified — isLuckyGuess, evidenceStrengthFor)
- `catfish/RootView.swift` (modified — ending overlay routing)
- `catfish/Features/PhoneOS/StatusBar.swift` (modified — day 7 urgency display)
- `catfish/Features/Journal/ClueJournalView.swift` (modified — Day7UrgencyBanner)
- `catfish/Features/Journal/AccusationView.swift` (modified — auto-dismiss, zero-evidence warning)
- `catfish/Features/Matches/ChatView.swift` (modified — day 7 meet buttons, acceptDay7Meet)
- `catfish/Core/Models/ChatMessage.swift` (modified — day7MeetInvitation kind, isDay7Meet meta)
- `catfish/Core/Content/ContentScheduler.swift` (modified — day 7 meet uses day7MeetInvitation kind)
- `catfish/Audio/AudioEngine.swift` (modified — print → os.Logger)
- `catfish/Audio/VoiceManifest.swift` (modified — print → os.Logger)
- `catfish/Core/Content/ContentSchema.swift` (modified — print → os.Logger)
- `catfish/Core/Narrative/NarrativeHookRouter.swift` (modified — print → os.Logger)
- `catfish/Core/Date/DateSceneLoader.swift` (modified — print → os.Logger)
- `llm-wiki/features/ending-system.md` (new)
- `llm-wiki/index.md` (updated)
- `llm-wiki/_activity/changelog.md` (updated)

### Verification

- Build: **SUCCEEDED** (zero errors)

---

## 2026-04-28 — Phase 6: Narrative Hook Expansion + Arcade Polish

**Agent**: opencode (glm-5.1)
**Session type**: Implementation

### What happened

- Expanded `HookCatalog` from ~13 hooks to 72 hooks covering all 20 game×killer combinations
- Added `HookPriority` system to `NarrativeHook`: `.killerSpecific` (3), `.global` (2), `.generic` (1)
- Upgraded `NarrativeHookRouter` with priority sorting, kind deduplication, and 30-second cooldown per trigger source
- Created `ArcadeSharedUI.swift` with `ArcadeGameOverOverlay` and `ArcadeExitAlert`
- All 4 arcade games now use consistent game-over overlays and exit confirmation dialogs
- Created `PhotosGalleryView` — evidence gallery replacing the photos stub
- Wired Photos app into `PhoneShell` router

### What was learned

- `NarrativeHook` init needs a `priority` parameter — all existing call sites default to `.generic`
- The hook router's kind deduplication uses fingerprint strings ("toast", "wordSuggestion", etc.) to prevent multiple hooks of the same kind firing from one event
- Exit confirmation in arcade games requires showing the alert overlay above the game board, separate from the game-over overlay
- SugarCoat and SafeSpot both have `gamePhase` / `phase` state that affects exit behavior — the exit alert fires `didEnd(.exited)` on confirm

### Files changed

- `catfish/Core/Narrative/HookCatalog.swift` (rewritten — 72 hooks)
- `catfish/Core/Narrative/NarrativeHookRouter.swift` (rewritten — priority, dedup, cooldown)
- `catfish/Features/Apps/Arcade/ArcadeSharedUI.swift` (new)
- `catfish/Features/Apps/Photos/PhotosGalleryView.swift` (new)
- `catfish/Features/Apps/Arcade/WordLow/WordLowGame.swift` (modified — shared UI + exit alert)
- `catfish/Features/Apps/Arcade/EgoTrip/EgoTripGame.swift` (modified — shared UI + exit alert)
- `catfish/Features/Apps/Arcade/SugarCoat/SugarCoatGame.swift` (modified — shared UI + exit alert)
- `catfish/Features/Apps/Arcade/SafeSpot/SafeSpotGame.swift` (modified — shared UI + exit alert)
- `catfish/Features/PhoneOS/PhoneShell.swift` (modified — photos routes to PhotosGalleryView)

### Verification

- Build: **SUCCEEDED** (zero errors, zero warnings)

---

## 2026-04-28 — Phase 2: Fact Universe Authoring (Days 1-3)

**Agent**: opencode (glm-5.1)
**Session type**: Implementation

### What happened

- Implemented the full Clue Graph Schema v0.1 for the fact universe:
  - New enums: `FactKind` (static/variable/conditional), `FactSource` (with associated values), `FriendID` (dev/nia)
  - `FactPayload` upgraded with optional `voiceLineID`
  - `Fact` model rewritten: flat fields replaced with `kindRaw`, `sourceData` (encoded FactSource), `payloadData` (encoded FactPayload), `day`, `aboutCharacterRaw`
  - New `DiscoveredFact` model: `factID`, `discoveredAt`, `playerNote`, `linkedFactIDs` — the journal commit contract
  - `CaseRun` upgraded: added `rngSeed`, `discovered` relationship to DiscoveredFact, `discoveredFactIDs` computed property
  - `CaseEnding` aligned with schema: `caughtThem`, `wrongfulAccusation`, `metKiller`, `killerEscaped`
  - New `AccusationResolver` with evidence-based scoring: correct accusations get "evidence verified" vs "lucky guess" distinction; wrong accusations match red herring chains
- Updated `ContentSchema.swift`: `FactContent` now has `kind`, `source` (FactSourceContent), `payload` (FactPayloadContent) fields
- Rewrote `content.json` with full Days 1-3 fact universe (30 facts):
  - 12 Day 1 facts (bio profiles + friend observations) — all `staticFact`
  - 7 Day 2 facts (social posts + DMs + friend advice) — all `staticFact`
  - 11 Day 3 facts (investigation clues + conditional + variable + friend) — mix of `staticFact`, `variable`, `conditional`
  - Added missing facts: `jules_day2_late_reply`, `river_bootprint_size_swap`, `sam_medcart_log_edit`, `river_day3_unreachable`, `sam_pharmacy_receipt_odd`, `miles_cash_payment_note`, `kai_late_night_dropcloth`
- `RunBootstrapper` rewritten: properly handles three-layer fact system (static → always inserted, variable → payload overridden per killer, conditional → only inserted if killer's conditionalFactIDs contains the fact ID)
- `ContentScheduler` upgraded: auto-discovers day-gated facts by creating DiscoveredFact entries on advanceDay
- `GameState` upgraded: added `commitFact()`, `isFactDiscovered()`, `makeAccusation()` using AccusationResolver
- `ClueJournalView` rewritten: groups discovered facts by day, shows fact kind badge and source label
- `AccusationView` rewritten: uses AccusationResolver, shows evidence verification status
- `catfishApp.swift`: added DiscoveredFact to Schema, added automatic database recovery on schema mismatch (deletes old store and retries)

### What was learned

- SwiftData schema changes that remove/rename properties are destructive — the old database must be deleted. The ModelContainer now auto-recovers by deleting the old store on schema mismatch.
- `CFFont` only has `title`, `headline`, `body`, `caption` — no `caption2`. Use `caption` for small text.
- The three-layer fact system (static/variable/conditional) is fully functional: RunBootstrapper correctly applies variable overrides and filters conditional facts based on the active KillerIdentity
- The double-blind tell works: `miles_ig_window_reflection` is a variable fact whose payload changes per killer (suburban parking lot reflection when Miles is killer, generic downtown when others are killer)
- `FactSource` with associated values requires JSON encoding for SwiftData storage — stored as `Data` property, decoded via computed property
- Friend observations (`dev_d1_first_impression`, etc.) are now also facts with kind=`staticFact` and source=`friendText`, making them part of the evidence system

### Files changed

- `catfish/Core/Models/KillerIdentity.swift` (modified — added FactKind, FactSource, FriendID, updated FactPayload)
- `catfish/Core/Models/Fact.swift` (rewritten — schema-aligned with kindRaw, sourceData, payloadData)
- `catfish/Core/Models/DiscoveredFact.swift` (new)
- `catfish/Core/Models/CaseRun.swift` (modified — added rngSeed, discovered relationship, updated CaseEnding)
- `catfish/Core/AccusationResolver.swift` (new)
- `catfish/Core/Content/ContentSchema.swift` (modified — new FactContent, FactSourceContent, FactPayloadContent types)
- `catfish/Resources/Content/content.json` (rewritten — 30 facts with kind/source annotations)
- `catfish/Core/Content/RunBootstrapper.swift` (rewritten — three-layer fact system)
- `catfish/Core/Content/ContentScheduler.swift` (modified — auto-discover facts on day advance)
- `catfish/Core/GameState.swift` (modified — commitFact, makeAccusation, resolveAccusation)
- `catfish/catfishApp.swift` (modified — DiscoveredFact in Schema, auto-recovery on schema mismatch)
- `catfish/Features/Journal/ClueJournalView.swift` (rewritten — new model access)
- `catfish/Features/Journal/AccusationView.swift` (rewritten — AccusationResolver)

### Verification

- Build: **SUCCEEDED** (zero errors, zero warnings)
- Tests: **27/27 passed** (all existing tests still pass)
- Simulator: **App launches without crash** on iPhone 17 Pro

## 2026-04-28 — Phase 1: Content Pipeline Infrastructure

**Agent**: opencode (glm-5.1)
**Session type**: Implementation

### What happened

- Implemented the full content pipeline infrastructure:
  - `Core/Content/ContentSchema.swift` — `ContentStore` singleton + Codable types for JSON content universe
  - `Core/Content/RunBootstrapper.swift` — Seeds facts, friend threads, and day-1 events on new run creation
  - `Core/Content/ContentScheduler.swift` — Emits day-gated content (friend messages, match messages) on day advance

- Updated `catfishApp.swift`: Added `Fact.self` and `ChatMessage.self` to SwiftData Schema, removed `Item.self`, added `ContentStore.shared.load()` bootstrap
- Updated `GameState.swift`: Removed inline RunBootstrapper/ContentScheduler stubs (now in Core/Content/)
